nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, we're family. You're like my sister. I'll do whatever it takes to make sure you get into Kingston with me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... Let's scale back our expectations to something a little more state school. I'm definitely not Kingston material.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, you'd hate having me at Kingston. We'd probably be roommates, and you know that would make us `both` miserable...
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, you'd hate having me at Kingston. We'd probably be roommates, and you know that would make us [color=#3b78e2][i]both[/i][/color] miserable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only if you forget to pick up all your clothes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See? I hate you as a roommate already.
$ZOE laughs, and it cheers Sam up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, fine. Maybe not Kingston. But you can definitely get into Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now `that` sounds more my style...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] sounds more my style...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I could afford it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's got to be a way we can help you get into college. It's not hopeless. There are other loans we can help Aunt Cathy apply for...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you're talented! There must be a ton of scholarships for you to get!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? A scholarship for what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are scholarships for everything under the sun! We could do swimming...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but now that Emily Kessler's in this school, I don't think I'm going to be winning any swimming scholarships.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have `other` skills, Sam. And I know just the person to ask!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] skills, Sam. And I know just the person to ask!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're going to see Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee is... Insane.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, as the school counselor, unfortunately, she's the only one who has all the information we need...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because... Because you're already on track.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have cheerleading and Social Chair and baking, and the recruiter from Kingston University practically told you that you'd be accepted if you applied!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: While I'm just struggling to get into college in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why should that matter? That's just the stuff I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do plenty of things! You're on the swim team, aren't you? And didn't you just become captain last year?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, yes, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You seemed really distracted by the Paige and Owen stuff, and I didn't want to unload all my stuff on you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, it's not your fault, and you can't really do anything about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I admire your independence and your willingness to face this alone, but sometimes you're too stubborn for your own good.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously, you could have talked to me any time. Especially about something as important as college!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now are you going to tell me what's going on with you or what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen you look so depressed in my life!
Sam tries to tell $ZOE about her college problem, but instead launches into what happened with Nick that morning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...And he called me `Sara.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And he called me [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He called you `Sara?`
nodes.text_bbcode: He called you [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes. What did he say next? Did he apologize? Did he explain?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He tried to apologize, but I accidentally... Fled. I don't know! My brain just kind of shut down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, it's fine. It's just one more crappy thing to think about other than...
She trails off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other than what?
Sam shifts her weight from foot to foot then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Remember that loan my mom was applying for? It fell through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The one you were counting on to pay for college? When?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right after the Sectionals game...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you waited this long to tell me?!

options.label: I didn't want to ask for help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I already `told` you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, I already [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn was so devastated by the loss of her mother's camera that she just left Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Luckily, she was accepted into this elite school across town, but...
$ZOE's shoulders slump, and Sam feels bad making her cousin relive the sore memory.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't stop her. I feel so responsible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was my fault she was in the Art Showcase in the first place. I couldn't protect her, and I feel like I've totally failed her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, $ZOE looks so depressed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't meant to be such a downer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. I'm glad Lindsay got into trouble over it though. She's been suspended for two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Although a `two week suspension` is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.
nodes.text_bbcode: Although a [color=#3b78e2][i]two week suspension[/i][/color] is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, it's going to make cheerleading practice super awkward when she gets back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, `Lindsay.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, [color=#3b78e2][i]Lindsay.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, I've never heard you say anyone's name like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Probably because I've never been more disgusted by someone in my life!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe she destroyed Autumn's camera!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's been suspended. Principal McCormick made sure of that the day right after the Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Although a `two week suspension` is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.
nodes.text_bbcode: Although a [color=#3b78e2][i]two week suspension[/i][/color] is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it's something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I was hoping that'd be enough to lure Autumn back, but... She still left. Granted, it's for a better school with better resources... But still.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever then. It seems like that's a win for Autumn. She'll be happier away from Lindsay and in a great place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I'll have to be happy with that, I guess. Autumn is happy, and Lindsay is suspended.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Congrats to Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good riddance to Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Except that when she comes back, it's going to make cheerleading super awkward... But I'll deal with that later.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You called me `Sara.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You called me [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick thinks back to the seconds before the door closed and winces.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Did I?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure there's a perfectly good reason I said the name of my ex-girlfriend instead of your name...
But before he can say anything else, Sam storms off.
You are now playing as Sam.
Later that day, at lunch...
Sam avoids the topic of college while she and $ZOE go from bulletin board to bulletin board, changing out the flyers in each.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you don't want to talk about anything? You're awfully quiet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, no! I'm `great`... How's it going with you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, no! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color]... How's it going with you?

nodes.text: $ZOE gives her cousin a skeptical look, but continues switching out a flyer advertising the Art Showcase from last month and puts in another flyer about an upcoming play by the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be a honest, I'm glad you're here. I'm really bummed out that the Art Showcase didn't go as well as I wanted it to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... Whatever happened to...
Nick catches the door before it shuts completely on Sam.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you see that? I caught the door like some kind of... Superhero! Who'd have thought...
He trails off, his relief tempered by the distressed look on Sam's face.
Nick tries to catch the door, but his grip slips! He fumbles and watches the door close on Sam!
It hits Sam's arm, but she doesn't even blink. Casually, she steps outside, mute.
The distressed look on her face makes him freeze.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you okay? Please tell me you're okay! If you're in shock, blink once.
She shakes her head.
Nick tries to catch the door, but his grip slips! He fumbles and watches the door close on Sam!
It hits Sam's arm, but she doesn't even blink. Casually, she steps outside, mute.
The distressed look on her face makes him freeze.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you okay? Please tell me you're okay! If you're in shock, blink once.
She shakes her head.
Paralyzed, Nick just stands there, watching the door close on Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If I remember, you were the one who brought up studying for the S.E.T.s two weeks ago when you were concerned that $ZOE was going to...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How did you put it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: 'Kick your sorry butt' on the test.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't say 'sorry'. And that was two weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... What changed? You've been acting... Strange.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No I haven't! Strange is... Uh... How Ben and Emily are gone all the time ever since they made up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not strange. They're making out on the roof.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Bad example! What about Owen? He's been acting strange ever since the Sectionals game against Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a difference between `strange` and `mopey.` `Mopey` is how Owen's been since he found out Paige is under lockdown at the Monarch Prep detention center.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's a difference between [color=#e23b3b][i]strange[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]mopey.[/i][/color] [color=#e23b3b][i]Mopey[/i][/color] is how Owen's been since he found out Paige is under lockdown at the Monarch Prep detention center.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Strange` is what you are since the night of the basketball game. So what's up?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Strange[/i][/color] is what you are since the night of the basketball game. So what's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I just don't see the point of studying all the time for the S.E.T.s. They're just a bunch of stupid standardized tests.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I agree that they're stupid. But for whatever reason, colleges put a lot of stock in them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And we should probably take them a little more seriously right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen to yourself... Nerd much?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I prefer intelligent hipster who ironically believes in the institution of college. College is where all the hipster blogs say I'll really 'blossom.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you just put air quotes around 'blossom'?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I did say 'ironically.'
Sam rolls her eyes at him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But seriously, you can tell me what's wrong. I can tell you're acting funny. And not in the funny ha-ha way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about college.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nervous about where you're going to go?
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My mom got a letter in the mail the other day about a loan we'd applied for...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa, that's a lot more serious a conversation than I thought we'd be having.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Should I change the subject to lighten the mood?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam... Don't be angry. I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It turns out I'm not eligible. And that was the best loan I could have hoped to get.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There aren't other ways? Academic scholarships?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With my grades? No way. So I don't really have a way of getting funding for college.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which means that I'm not going away for college any time soon. Which `means` that all `this` doesn't matter.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means that I'm not going away for college any time soon. Which [color=#3b78e2][i]means[/i][/color] that all [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] doesn't matter.

nodes.text: She waves her hand over the S.E.T. preparation booklets.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just sucks because I thought I might have an opportunity to experience something special... And now it's gone...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure that's not true. There's got to be another way. Why don't you ask $ZOE about it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She's the Social Chair. I'm sure she knows other ways of getting funding...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to talk to $ZOE about it. She's all Little Miss Perfect, and she's definitely getting into a good college, and she has her life all planned out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, I didn't think you were the jealous type...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not jealousy... It's embarrassment. I don't want to talk to her about how hopelessly behind I am.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She's your cousin. She lives in your house. She's probably the person you `should` talk to about this.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's your cousin. She lives in your house. She's probably the person you [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] talk to about this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And on the bright side, if she's that on track, she probably has all the time in the world to help you. Which she will. Because she's your cousin...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And creepily nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, that's true.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Promise me you'll talk to her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure... I'll try to bring it up.
The bell warning the students that classes are about to start peals overhead. They gather their books.
Nick leads them out the double doors that open onto the main courtyard.
He walks through and holds the door open for Sam when a strong gust of cold wind catches Nick off guard. He loses his grip on the door handle, and the door begins to close!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh oh... `Sara!` Look out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh oh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara![/i][/color] Look out!

nodes.text: Nick jumps forward to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's try it and see.
Nick sets the timer on his phone for one minute.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready? Pencil's poised? Go!
They work on the questions from the standardized test booklet diligently for the next minute.
When the timer beeps, they sit up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How many did you answer?
Sam shows Nick her booklet... Only one question has been answered.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just one?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just one! But I did think of seven different ways to destroy my S.E.T. booklet! One involves Megan's butane torch!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd `you` do?
nodes.text_bbcode: How'd [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, four.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Let's face it. I'm going to suck at the S.E.T.s. And this just proves it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It doesn't prove anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It proves that I'm not as focused as everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: None of this matters anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really think that's going to make this more fun?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, try it before you knock it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If it's really bad, I'll knock `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If it's really bad, I'll knock [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick clears his throat and props the book up to read from it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wat eez ze ah ree ah of un sue kware eef ze side eez the sue kware voot of weigh tee vone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wat eez ze `ah ree ah` of un `sue kware` eef ze `side` eez the `sue kware voot` of `weigh tee vone`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wat eez ze [color=#e23b3b][i]ah ree ah[/i][/color] of un [color=#e23b3b][i]sue kware[/i][/color] eef ze [color=#e23b3b][i]side[/i][/color] eez the [color=#e23b3b][i]sue kware voot[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]weigh tee vone[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is the... Aria? Area! Of a sucker?
Sam gets halfway through the sentence before cracking up.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! Bzzt! Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha! What's the actual sentence?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is the `area` of a `square` if the side is the `square root` of `eighty one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is the [color=#e23b3b][i]area[/i][/color] of a [color=#e23b3b][i]square[/i][/color] if the side is the [color=#e23b3b][i]square root[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]eighty one![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ohhhh!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How could you `not` get that?
nodes.text_bbcode: How could you [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because it's totally lame?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So? What's the answer?
Sam takes a long time thinking about it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's 81.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After all that, I get it wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh well... Who cares?

nodes.title: The Play
nodes.subtitle: Can Sam land the role of her life?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nick.
It's the morning, right before school, and Nick and Sam are studying for the S.E.T.s in the bustling school cafeteria.
Nick takes a long sip of his favorite blend of fair-trade coffee and turns a page in his test preparation book.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay... Next question.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Another one? How many are there?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We have at least twenty more, and that's just the end of the math section.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great.
Sam tears off a piece of her scratch paper, balls it up, and tosses it against the wall where it falls to the ground and bounces away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, you know what would make this more fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Drilling screws into my brain?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, `no`, that sounds barbaric.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color], that sounds barbaric.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was `joking`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]joking[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I meant to say, before you so rudely interrupted me with your talk of medieval torture, was that we could make it a game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What kind of game?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, we can see how many questions we can answer...

nodes.prompt: We can see how many questions we can answer...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We can see how many questions we can answer...

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE practice lines, taking excerpts from the entire play to round out Sam's audition.
During the romantic balcony scene, Sam thinks of Zomebietown...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: During the happy wedding of Juliet to Romeo in secret, Sam thinks of meat pizza...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `But my true love is grown to such excess... I cannot sum up sum of half my wealth...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But my true love is grown to such excess... I cannot sum up sum of half my wealth...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And for the sad ending where Juliet finds Romeo has poisoned himself, Sam thinks of Nick and Sara together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam acts out the rest of the scene, finishing with a fake dagger to her heart.
As Sam pretends to collapse on her bed, $ZOE laughs and claps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was `so` good! You know, Sam... I didn't know you were so talented.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good! You know, Sam... I didn't know you were so talented.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talented? Are you kidding? During the entire wedding scene, I was thinking of meat pizza!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it clearly makes you happy because that was `great!` I don't think we even have to do another round!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it clearly makes you happy because that was [color=#3b78e2][i]great![/i][/color] I don't think we even have to do another round!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Music to my ears...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so excited to see the tryouts tomorrow. You'll blow everyone away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam continues to act out the rest of the scene while others start talking...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: She's `great`...
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, really...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O happy dagger! This is thy sheath...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O happy dagger! This is thy sheath...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam pretends to stab herself... And falls to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `There... Cough... Rust, and let me die.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]There... Cough... Rust, and let me die.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Silence falls across the stage. Then...
$ZOE starts clapping... And so do the rest of the people on stage!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'll applaud to that.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, she's great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did wonderful, Sam!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks!
She turns to Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Does that mean I'm in?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Because... Your audition...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Was awful!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I didn't think it was bad at all...
Andrew gives her a withering glare.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She was standing in the wrong place the entire time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can move around...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, Andrew. You'd think having a good Juliet opposite you would make your chances of getting that scholarship even better...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're trying for the scholarship too?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yes, but that has nothing to do--
Sam reflects over how he's been acting and what she said to him right before he turned hostile...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, I get what's going on here... You don't want me in your production because `you're` applying for the scholarship!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, I get what's going on here... You don't want me in your production because [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] applying for the scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's not... That's just... That's preposterous! It doesn't matter who's competing!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I didn't make this clear before, but you can't be in the play because...
Andrew shifts his eyes to the left.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Because we've already filled all the female roles!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: We did? I thought Sam would make a great Jul--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! We `filled` the roles! `Jenna` will be playing Juliet.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! We [color=#e23b3b][i]filled[/i][/color] the roles! [color=#e23b3b][i]Jenna[/i][/color] will be playing Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Ashley is the Nurse.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Hannah... Is everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I `am` versatile!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] versatile!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's bogus!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, really, Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I don't employ you to have an opinion. In fact, I don't even `need` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't employ you to have an opinion. In fact, I don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] you!

nodes.text: He turns to Sam with a smug smile.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's showbiz. Sorry. Too bad, so sad... Get mad?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That might need a little work... But thanks for trying out for `Romeo and Juliet`, directed by, produced by, and 100 percent all about `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That might need a little work... But thanks for trying out for [color=#e23b3b][i]Romeo and Juliet[/i][/color], directed by, produced by, and 100 percent all about [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE leave the theater, sadly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll figure something out...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...
The next morning, before school, Sam is sitting at a lunch table. She morosely pretends to do some homework.
But thoughts about her future swim in her head.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What am I going to do now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is there anything else? Maybe I should just postpone college for a year to earn money...
She flicks her pencil away from her book. It rolls down the length of the table and falls...
Into Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...Hey.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey.
He walks around the table so that he's directly across from her. Sam considers bolting, but he's in between her and the exit.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... I've been trying to call you. But I figured you weren't picking up your phone because... Well, because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You called me Sara?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was going to say 'because you were studying so hard for the S.E.T.s'... But I guess there is that.
He attempts a weak smile, but she doesn't smile back.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I've been thinking about what happened a couple days ago...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And even though you deserve it, I don't have a good explanation for why it happened other than that Sara used to be a big part of my life.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And sometimes I think about her--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is this supposed to reassure me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm getting around to it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sometimes I still think of Sara because I did care for her. But that doesn't mean I don't care for you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you're what's important to me now. And I want you to know that. So I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You only texted it about a billion times.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I also emailed you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're such a dork.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Am I forgiven?
Sam hesitates, not entirely sure how she feels. All she knows is that it hurts not having Nick in her life. She nods.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.
Nick sits down next to her and takes her hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And Sam, about Sara--
Sam turns to him, wondering what he's about to say... When Kevin walks up to the table.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, hey, Kevin... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I was looking for you... You were so great yesterday that I had to come and talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa, yesterday? What happened yesterday between you and this... Guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Slow your horses there, skinny cowboy. Kevin's a stagehand for the drama club. He was there when I auditioned for Andrew's production of Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? You auditioned for a play?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...I'll explain later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for the compliment, Kevin. You're a nice guy. Unlike that director of yours.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `Former` director. And it's lame that Andrew's shutting you out because you're competing for the same scholarship.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Former[/i][/color] director. And it's lame that Andrew's shutting you out because you're competing for the same scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, tell me about it. Well, it was a good move for him. I'm not competing now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't even know that I had that much of a chance.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That's not true. You can still do the play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Look, I like working with the theater department. I like music and tech. But Andrew's a controlling jerk. He won't let you join his play, and he won't let me do my job.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So far, he's the only one who's formed a group that puts on stage productions. But he doesn't have to be the only one.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `You` can put on your own play, your own version of Romeo and Juliet.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] can put on your own play, your own version of Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know the first thing about putting on an entire play...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I do. If you act, I do tech, and your Social Chair friend directs, then we've already pulled together the most important components of a stage team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I knew having $ZOE as my cousin would come in handy someday...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So, are you in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This might be my only chance this year to go to college... Of course I'm in!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 1: The Play!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 1: The Play![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
A long time ago, we asked our fans to vote on the genre we would focus on next...
The winner was `Magic School...` And now it's available in our store!
nodes.text_bbcode: The winner was [b]Magic School...[/b] And now it's available in our store!

nodes.text: Learn spells, encounter magical creatures, and explore the Wilde in this HUGE pack!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Acting isn't something you can just take up because you `feel` like it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Acting isn't something you can just take up because you [color=#e23b3b][i]feel[/i][/color] like it.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now if you don't mind... You're wasting everyone's time. Especially my brand new leading lady's... Isn't that right, Jenna?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: It is? I mean, I `am?` Yay!
nodes.text_bbcode: It is? I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]am?[/i][/color] Yay!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You know it... Now I believe we were just about to rehearse the kiss scene.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: What page is that again?
Jenna begins to leaf through the script, and Andrew takes it and tosses it aside.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forget the words. Just go with the emotion.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Oh... All right!
Andrew and Jenna furiously make-out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Blech! Talk about taking liberties with the text...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE. Forget it. It's over...
Sam walks sadly out of the theater.
Sam has failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam continues to act out the rest of the scene while others start talking...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: She seems a `little` fake...
nodes.text_bbcode: She seems a [color=#3b78e2][i]little[/i][/color] fake...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Or a little `too` happy that Romeo's dead... Of course, Romeo `is` Andrew...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or a little [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] happy that Romeo's dead... Of course, Romeo [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] Andrew...

nodes.text: When Sam acts out the rest of Juliet's death scene with a grin on her face, Andrew steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And cut! I think we've seen enough. You've had your little audition, and it sucked!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You did smile when you stuck an air dagger to your heart. It was creepy.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Get off the stage, Sam! Face it. If you can't even act out the right emotion during a `death` scene, then you're not cut out for acting.
nodes.text_bbcode: Get off the stage, Sam! Face it. If you can't even act out the right emotion during a [color=#e23b3b][i]death[/i][/color] scene, then you're not cut out for acting.

nodes.text: Sam can't remember what to think about...
So she thinks of Zombietown!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Wherefore art thou, Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wherefore art thou, Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deny thy father and refuse thy name...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deny thy father and refuse thy name...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam continues to read the rest of the line while Ashley, Kevin, and others from the drama club look over.
The auditorium has gone totally silent, all eyes on Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `And I'll no longer be a Capulet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And I'll no longer be a Capulet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Cut!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cut![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? that's the right line!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You aren't supposed to be, uh--

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I kind of want to hear more... It was pretty good...
Andrew turns to chide her, but notices that everyone is watching with rapt attention...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: All right... `Fine.` But we're changing scenes. The death scene. `Now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right... [color=#e23b3b][i]Fine.[/i][/color] But we're changing scenes. The death scene. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam looks to $ZOE who nods with encouragement.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is my moment... I'm supposed to be sad here because Romeo is dead, so I just have to think of...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Wherefore fart now, Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wherefore fart now, Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The theater company erupts into laughter, and Sam knows it's not because they're laughing `with` her.. .
nodes.text_bbcode: The theater company erupts into laughter, and Sam knows it's not because they're laughing [b]with[/b] her.. .

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess... I forgot the line.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's harder than it looks, isn't it? Face it, if you can't memorize the most important line in the play, then you're not cut out for acting.
Sam forgets the line! She stumbles to remember it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Wherefore... Are now?`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Wherefore... Brown cow?`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, wait, I know it...
Sam tries to leap next to Andrew, but her feet catch on the edge of the stage! She falls hard onto the stage floor, her feet throbbing and her head spinning.
Ashley and Kevin rush to help her up, but she waves them off.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was a nasty fall.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm fine. I just... Ow. May have sprained something...
She gets up awkwardly and limps.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: With the production in a few weeks' time, I can't have a Juliet that `limps.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With the production in a few weeks' time, I can't have a Juliet that [color=#e23b3b][i]limps.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Face it. If you can't make it onto the stage, then you're just not cut out for acting.
Sam tries to leap next to Andrew, but her feet catch on the edge of the stage! She falls hard onto the stage floor, her feet throbbing and her head spinning.
Ashley and Kevin rush to help her up, but she waves them off.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was a nasty fall.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm fine. I just... Ow. May have sprained something...
She gets up awkwardly and limps.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: With the production in a few weeks' time, I can't have a Juliet that `limps.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With the production in a few weeks' time, I can't have a Juliet that [color=#e23b3b][i]limps.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Face it. If you can't make it onto the stage, then you're just not cut out for acting.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `And sails upon the bosom of the--`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And sails upon the bosom of the--[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam jumps on stage, displacing Jenna.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `--of the air!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]--of the air![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What are you--
Sam steamrolls him, speaking over him in a loud clear voice with a happy look on her face...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, but the fact that you've never seen center stage means you know nothing about acting!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the director, producer, co-author, and star of this production, I will `not` have my Romeo and Juliet sullied by someone who doesn't know what they're doing!
nodes.text_bbcode: As the director, producer, co-author, and star of this production, I will [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] have my Romeo and Juliet sullied by someone who doesn't know what they're doing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That shouldn't stop me from trying.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And why should you get to `try` when everyone else here has `more` experience and `more` passion and has spent more `time` in the arts than you?
nodes.text_bbcode: And why should you get to [color=#e23b3b][i]try[/i][/color] when everyone else here has [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] experience and [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] passion and has spent more [color=#e23b3b][i]time[/i][/color] in the arts than you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... I... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's what I thought.
Satisfied that Sam is leaving, Andrew hops onto the stage and addresses the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: All right, actors, let's read the lines for the balcony scene. Of course as `Romeo`... I need a `Juliet` willing to do some kissing...
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, actors, let's read the lines for the balcony scene. Of course as [color=#e23b3b][i]Romeo[/i][/color]... I need a [color=#e23b3b][i]Juliet[/i][/color] willing to do some kissing...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Me!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And... Action!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `She speaks. Oh speak again, bright angel! For thou art as glorious to this night...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]She speaks. Oh speak again, bright angel! For thou art as glorious to this night...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the aisle, $ZOE turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened? You're not going to try out?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, Andrew is kind of right...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Unto the white-upturned wondering eyes...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Unto the white-upturned wondering eyes...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just kind of butting into his theater production...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not `right`, Sam... Andrew's just trying to `intimidate` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's not [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color], Sam... Andrew's just trying to [color=#3b78e2][i]intimidate[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You practiced all night for this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is your chance.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Of mortals that fall back to gaze on him...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Of mortals that fall back to gaze on him...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right. I have a right to try out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Are you going to get up there or not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am!
Sam turns around to face the stage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right, $ZOE. I did not read the entire play through three times, just to be rebuffed by a skinny geek in glasses!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam strides angrily up the aisle to the lip of the stage and...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you? I mean, isn't high school acting still amateur?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: All right, poor word choice! Have you ever done any acting before?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. So what? I didn't realize I needed a fine arts degree to do a `high school` production...
nodes.text_bbcode: No. So what? I didn't realize I needed a fine arts degree to do a [color=#3b78e2][i]high school[/i][/color] production...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what? Is that a requirement?
Sam gapes at Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I take it by your fish-like silence that you've never acted...
Sam and $ZOE practice lines. $ZOE has Sam practice the romantic balcony scene...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's `way` too angry, Sam!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too angry, Sam!

nodes.text: The secret wedding of Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `But my true love is grown to such excess... I cannot sum up sum of half my wealth...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But my true love is grown to such excess... I cannot sum up sum of half my wealth...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we do that again? This is supposed to be a `joyful` moment...
nodes.text_bbcode: Can we do that again? This is supposed to be a [color=#3b78e2][i]joyful[/i][/color] moment...

nodes.text: And at last, they reach the ending where Juliet finds Romeo has poisoned himself...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What's here? A cup, closed in my true love's hand?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's... Try that one more time. You look `way` too happy to find Romeo in the crypt...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's... Try that one more time. You look [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too happy to find Romeo in the crypt...

nodes.text: They practice again and again until both Sam and $ZOE are tired.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's... Stop... I'm... Yawn... So tired!
$ZOE stifles her yawn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you have a lot of natural talent... But if your face doesn't match your words, it's not going to show through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... I just can't concentrate... Maybe tomororow?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... Yawn... Good night, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night...
When $ZOE leaves the room, Sam lays back in bed. She tries to sleep, but has a hard time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is my only chance at a scholarship this far in the year...
Propping open the play, Sam studies her lines far into the night, trying to remember and follow $ZOE's advice as she reads through...
That night, Sam is practicing lines from 'Romeo and Juliet' with Zoe.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's go over the balcony scene one more time. I think you could do Juliet a little better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, the balcony scene? Can't we go back to the sword fight scene? `That` was cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, the balcony scene? Can't we go back to the sword fight scene? [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Juliet's the main female lead. She's the one you'll be auditioning for.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I'm Romeo. I say... `When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds and sails upon the bosom of the air...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm Romeo. I say... [color=#3b78e2][i]When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds and sails upon the bosom of the air...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, `bosom`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, [color=#3b78e2][i]bosom[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's your line, Sam?
Sam clasps her hands to her heart.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deny thy father and refuse thy name... Or if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deny thy father and refuse thy name... Or if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, you're really good! There's just one thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You look angry when you say them. If you want to be Juliet, you need to look like you're in love!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's hard to look love-struck with these flowery phrases.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Juliet is happy. This is the most romantic scene!
Sam rolls her eyes just as her phone buzzes with an incoming text from Nick. It reads, 'can we talk? please?'
She shoves her phone away without texting back, frowning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just not in the mood for romance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How long are you going to keep ignoring your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, let's not go there. Nick and I haven't had the boyfriend-girlfriend talk. All we do is hang out, and sometimes, we make out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm not 'ignoring' him... It's more like I'm putting off answering his texts until never.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, Sam... You really should talk to him and clear things up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I kind of don't want to 'clear things up'. What is he going to say? 'I'm sorry I called you the name of my perfect past girlfriend'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, $ZOE. This morning, when he called me Sara, it brought up all these feelings. I mean, the reason I broke up with him the first time is because of her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes... It is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And do you know what I said to him then? I said that we couldn't be together because I wanted to be `number one` in some guy's life for once. Not second place. Not `the other girl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And do you know what I said to him then? I said that we couldn't be together because I wanted to be [color=#3b78e2][i]number one[/i][/color] in some guy's life for once. Not second place. Not [color=#3b78e2][i]the other girl.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But since this morning, I keep wondering... Am I just the runner-up? Is he dating me because she's gone? Does he still love her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a lot of questions that I don't have answers for...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know. But you never will if you don't talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... But it's not going to be tonight. Can we go back to the play?
Sam props her play book open, studying it intently, and $ZOE does the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you still look angry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't `do` 'romance' well...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] 'romance' well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's `Romeo and Juliet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But it's [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo and Juliet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I just think Shakespeare should have gotten more creative and added zombies... It's hard to look 'in love' when you're fighting off the undead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... Unfortunately for you, it's just boring old Romeo and Juliet. Let's try this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it helps to have the right mindset when you're acting. So you should try to think of things that inspire certain emotions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you do the balcony scene, think of something you love... Like, uh, N--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say 'Nick'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wasn't! I was going to say, uh, '`Nightmare` in Zombietown'... Your favorite movie. That's something you love.
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't! I was going to say, uh, '[color=#3b78e2][i]Nightmare[/i][/color] in Zombietown'... Your favorite movie. That's something you love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay. When I see Romeo onstage, I'll think of `Zombietown.` Any other good advice? What do I do if I'm sad? Or really really happy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, okay. When I see Romeo onstage, I'll think of [color=#3b78e2][i]Zombietown.[/i][/color] Any other good advice? What do I do if I'm sad? Or really really happy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you're sad, then think of a sad thing like...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Nick and Sara?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nick and Sara?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That might be `too` sad, but... Sure.
nodes.text_bbcode: That might be [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] sad, but... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if you want to be happy, then think of something that brings you joy... Like... `Meat pizza!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you want to be happy, then think of something that brings you joy... Like... [color=#3b78e2][i]Meat pizza![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's getting pretty late. Let's run the three Juliet scenes one more time and then go to bed. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah!
Sam flips to the right page in the play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just do what $ZOE told you... To show the right emotions, think of the right cues...
Sam steps forward, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tryouts! Tryouts for 'Romeo and Juliet'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ever wanted to perform in a play before? Now's your opportunity!
She hands out flyers to people passing through.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A play? I'd love to do a play! The rush, the thrill, the excitement!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you been in one before?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, but I'm very versatile! I can be anything you want! Backup dancer, unassuming janitor, a wall...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we do need side characters... Take one!
Erik takes his happily, and Sam continues to pass out flyers!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'Romeo and Juliet'? Isn't that the romantic one?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That means there's kissing! And wherever there's kissing, I'm in!
He takes one before Sam can retract it. The cheerleaders come up...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, free stuff. Great!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay, paper! I love paper!
By the time everyone's come through the doors, Sam has handed out most of her flyers!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm almost out. How'd everyone else do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm nearly to the bottom of my stack as well. Kevin?
He thumbs through a still-thick stack of flyers.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm not going to say that being an attractive girl is an advantage when it comes to handing out flyers but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you think we're attractive?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What... No? I mean, yes! I was just trying to say, uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... At least we have some to staple on the bulletin boards in the school hallway.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: They're not interested.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They can decide for themselves.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, it... It doesn't matter! Whether or not they want to, they'll be `busy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it... It doesn't matter! Whether or not they want to, they'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]busy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: With what?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There's a rehearsal today after school.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What? But that's not on the sched--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's an `emergency` rehearsal, and if you still want to be in `my` production, then you'll `be there.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's an [color=#e23b3b][i]emergency[/i][/color] rehearsal, and if you still want to be in [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] production, then you'll [color=#e23b3b][i]be there.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just made that up right now!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Or...` I just happened to think of something I wanted to change right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Or...[/i][/color] I just happened to think of something I wanted to change right now!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And you can't prove otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ha! You can try to best me, shrew! But, like Shakespeare's Petruchio before me, call me `shrew-tamer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! You can try to best me, shrew! But, like Shakespeare's Petruchio before me, call me [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew-tamer![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Consider yourself `tamed.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Consider yourself [color=#e23b3b][i]tamed.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With that, Andrew turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `that` catch-phrase isn't going on any billboards anytime soon.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] catch-phrase isn't going on any billboards anytime soon.

nodes.text: Ashley and Hannah look mournfully at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam...
Sam looks at Ashley and Hannah who sigh in relief.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I told him that they'd approached me, they'd get in trouble with him... Good thing I kept my mouth shut.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I find that incredibly hard to believe.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Actually, it's true. Sam and I are total `swim teammates` on the `swimming team,` aren't we?
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it's true. Sam and I are total [color=#3b78e2][i]swim teammates[/i][/color] on the [color=#3b78e2][i]swimming team,[/i][/color] aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, total `swim`mates. And Ashley's cool too.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, total [color=#3b78e2][i]swim[/i][/color]mates. And Ashley's cool too.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh-huh. I'm `sure.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]sure.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, even if we were talking about plays...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which we `weren't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which we [color=#3b78e2][i]weren't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not against the rules for them to be in `two` productions.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not against the rules for them to be in [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] productions.

nodes.text: Ashley and Hannah's eyes widen, and Sam realizes she should have probably kept that information to herself.
Andrew turns to them furiously.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Did you approach her?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It was Ashley's idea!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Was it really? You know, Ashley, you're the Nurse because I know you're a good actress...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But it won't take more than a penstroke to take that all away!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And while I'm at it, I could make sure that you never work in the drama club again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Andrew, stop it... It's not against the rules for them to be in `two` productions.
nodes.text_bbcode: Andrew, stop it... It's not against the rules for them to be in [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] productions.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They, uh... They came to me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm game! Besides... Basketball's over, and football's not here yet. I won't have to think of sports if I'm sword-fighting!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And maybe we can find some tights that you'll like!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No tights!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just come to auditions! We'll worry about costumes later!
They finish up their lunches, talking with the students at other tables, encouraging them to come.
As they walk to their lockers, Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think everyone will come? What if there aren't any good actors?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We'll deal with it when we deal with it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hm. Strangely truthful.
They're about to head out when Hannah and Ashley find them in the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... Can we talk with you for a second?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll see you after school, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ditto.
Sam steps aside to talk with Hannah and Ashley.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We saw some flyers you were passing out today about the auditions.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Would you be okay if we tried out?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd be fine! You guys are in the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about Andrew? Did you guys quit his play?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, no, we're still in it. I want the experience.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So do I. That... And it's kind of covering one of my electives. If I drop it, I fail 'Independent Study'.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: But Andrew's a little bit overbearing...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: An actual `bear` couldn't be more overbearing!
nodes.text_bbcode: An actual [color=#3b78e2][i]bear[/i][/color] couldn't be more overbearing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I got that.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: It'd be nice to be in a production where I'd have some more say as an actress... And I'd like a chance to be a star.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I just don't want to be `Jenna's backup.` It's just sad.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just don't want to be [color=#3b78e2][i]Jenna's backup.[/i][/color] It's just sad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You guys want to tryout for my play, but you need to be in his too? I could `try` to work around that...
nodes.text_bbcode: So... You guys want to tryout for my play, but you need to be in his too? I could [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to work around that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you'd really need to run it by Andrew first. I don't want him to think that I'm poaching any of his--

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, great! We knew you could keep it a `secret!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, great! We knew you could keep it a [color=#3b78e2][i]secret![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! That's the opposite of what I--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `What is this?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What is this?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew steps in Sam's face.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Shrew! It's already bad enough that you're gunning for my scholarship...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now you're trying to sabotage me by tearing my entire production apart! You're poaching my actors!
Behind Andrew's back, Hannah and Ashley shake their heads frantically.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not poaching them! They...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you trying to say?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That I need a `play` to meet girls? I know cute girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: That I need a [color=#e23b3b][i]play[/i][/color] to meet girls? I know cute girls.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They were all over me after we won Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? Where are they now?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They're, uh, they all go to Willow Glen. You don't know them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But what I'm saying is that I don't need help getting a girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just thought you might like `hanging around them` while you're swinging a sword at me as Tybalt--
nodes.text_bbcode: I just thought you might like [color=#3b78e2][i]hanging around them[/i][/color] while you're swinging a sword at me as Tybalt--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Sword?!` Did you say `sword?` I'm there.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sword?![/i][/color] Did you say [color=#e23b3b][i]sword?[/i][/color] I'm there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll probably get one of the really awesome parts where you can have a choreographed stage fight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know `I'm` excited. Since I'm Tybalt, I'll be in one of those fight scenes too.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] excited. Since I'm Tybalt, I'll be in one of those fight scenes too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the prop swords in the drama department are nothing to laugh at. They `look` real!
nodes.text_bbcode: And the prop swords in the drama department are nothing to laugh at. They [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] real!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can stop talking now. You had me at 'sword'!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I should have known. Well, it's good to know that I can still guess what you like.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So are you in or not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So the flyers are out. What now?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, like I was saying before, you should start recruiting your friends. That's how most plays are made.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kevin's right. We should start talking to people personally, starting with the Center Table. Ready to go on over?
They grab their lunches and walk to the Center Table in the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, I'll try to catch you guys later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: This isn't really my scene. I belong over there.
He points at a table of nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I summon a fireball against your face!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: See there? That fireball's supposed to be in `my` face.
nodes.text_bbcode: See there? That fireball's supposed to be in [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize there was a proper seating order.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Popular girls usually don't.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Besides, I don't want to crowd you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, come sit with us now. You're our producer and stagehand. It's only for a day. I'm sure it won't kill you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Much.
Kevin shrugs and sits with them at the center table.
Around them, the cheerleaders and the jocks chatter happily. $ZOE slides in with Ben, Emily, Kimi, and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Sup, Samface!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, Sam...
He looks over and sees Kevin. He brightens.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kevin, you don't normally come around here...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We can't all be scientists turned superstars...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm surprised you're turning down that ogres game you always play with Dex...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We can't all be ogres either.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, it's good to see your face again. What are you up to?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can answer that. He's helping me with a production of 'Romeo and Juliet'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, we kind of need your help. It's really important that Sam puts on this play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Would you guys be interested in trying out?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It kind of sounds fun...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And by 'it kind of sounds fun', she means 'heck yeah, we'd `love` to be in a `play!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And by 'it kind of sounds fun', she means 'heck yeah, we'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to be in a [color=#3b78e2][i]play![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Er, yeah, what she said.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! And maybe now that basketball season's over, Ben and Spencer would want to join too?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben would love to!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, you were just telling me the other day that you kind of missed basketball. This could be fun for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's for a good cause...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I can't turn it down now... I'm game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, you can count me out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're not getting me onstage! Not in those girly tights!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Spence. I need the help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it'll be fun. 'Romeo and Juliet' is a romantic play set in medieval times.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That means there'll be...
Sam steps forward... But panic seizes her, and she forgets what to do!
People start streaming past her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Take this!
She tries to hand out a flyer, but accidentally grabs several at once and throws them at a passing student.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, hey!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry!
Realizing it's Sam, Ryan smooths his hair down.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nah, it's okay, Sam... You can throw your papers all over me whenever you--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just keep walking, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Walking!
Angry at herself for fumbling, Sam doesn't realize she's scowling at everyone who passes by.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Take a flyer! It's for a play, you idiots!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wuhh... I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, scary paper monster lady!
Erik ducks under her and runs away. Sam turns to others to hand out more flyers with an angry expression on her face.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa boy, Sam's on a rampage! It's a `Sampage!` Out of the way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa boy, Sam's on a rampage! It's a [color=#e23b3b][i]Sampage![/i][/color] Out of the way!

nodes.text: The people filing in behind Hector avoid her at all costs!
By the time that everyone's come through the doors, Sam is still carrying a thick stack of flyers!
She, $ZOE, and Kevin meet up to talk about how they managed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm nearly to the bottom of my stack. How did everyone else do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not that well... I kind of froze up there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I didn't do much better than Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, well that's okay... I guess we can always staple the extras to bulletin boards...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope people will come...
Later that day...
$ZOE and Sam find that no one's made it to their rehearsal!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, I can't believe this is happening!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it's because everyone's running a little late? I mean, class did just get out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Class got out twenty minutes ago.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just wait a little longer...
Twenty more minutes pass...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe people have other clubs they're in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe.
An hour passes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some people could have gotten lost...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They'd have to be `blind` not to see the auditorium from the main buildings...
nodes.text_bbcode: They'd have to be [color=#3b78e2][i]blind[/i][/color] not to see the auditorium from the main buildings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Still...
And soon, it's twenty minutes to five o'clock. Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Forget it, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No one's coming.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, it's not over yet. You still have time. There are other scholarships...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. It'll be fine...
But Sam knows in her heart...
She has failed.
