menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Excellent idea! Oh, I'm very pleased all around. These will be `wonderful` essays and even more wonderful performances!
nodes.text_bbcode: Excellent idea! Oh, I'm very pleased all around. These will be [color=#3b78e2][i]wonderful[/i][/color] essays and even more wonderful performances!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Anyway, that's it for this meeting. I just need to collect your initial paperwork, and we'll be set.
Andrew and Sam both hand in their paperwork. Ms. Macbeth thumbs through both applications.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Great, Andrew. You're all ready to go.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: But Sam... You're missing a cast list. I need that from you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A cast list?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Yeah, a list of everyone who'll be in your performance and their roles.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You `do` know that you can't be the `only` actor in your play, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] know that you can't be the [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] actor in your play, right?

nodes.text: Sam fixes him with a withering look before answering Ms. Macbeth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't know we had to turn that in, and I'm still finalizing some casting, so...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the deadline is today, so I'll need that from you by 5pm, if that's all right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, of course! No problem!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Great.
Sam rushes out of the conference room and runs straight into $ZOE and Kevin who are waiting outside.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Big problem!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Problem? What problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth needs a cast list by the end of today. I haven't even had enough time to get a cast together, much less to know what everyone's role is!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This entire play idea is a train wreck... No, it's a plane collision on top of a train wreck!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Actually, no... Your play is more like a `cataclysmic intergalactic war` on top of a plane collision on top of a train wreck.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, no... Your play is more like a [color=#e23b3b][i]cataclysmic intergalactic war[/i][/color] on top of a plane collision on top of a train wreck.

nodes.text: Sam whips around to glare at Andrew, who's just walked out of the conference room behind her. He chuckles at his own joke.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geek.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Jock.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not as much of an insult as you think it is.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Fine. But you trying to skate by and win this scholarship `is` an insult. You made up 'role reversal' on the spot just to impress her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. But you trying to skate by and win this scholarship [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] an insult. You made up 'role reversal' on the spot just to impress her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't make it less of a topic. And I happen to `like` the idea of playing as Tybalt. His part's going to be a lot more fun than `Juliet's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That doesn't make it less of a topic. And I happen to [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] the idea of playing as Tybalt. His part's going to be a lot more fun than [color=#3b78e2][i]Juliet's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, right. You don't fool me. You're not even taking this seriously. Before this, you couldn't care less about the drama club!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I `would` have cared if pompous jerks like `you` weren't in charge.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] have cared if pompous jerks like [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] weren't in charge.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In fact, I think I'm taking this more seriously than you.
Sam rips a poster for Andrew's production off the wall and holds it up so that Andrew can see it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look at these credits... You're the director, the star, and `co-`writer? Your production of 'Romeo and Juliet' might as well be called 'Romeo and Andrew's Big Fat Ego.'
nodes.text_bbcode: Look at these credits... You're the director, the star, and [color=#3b78e2][i]co-[/i][/color]writer? Your production of 'Romeo and Juliet' might as well be called 'Romeo and Andrew's Big Fat Ego.'

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: At least I `have` a production.
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] a production.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ohhh, `burn.` It's going to be hard putting on 'Romeo and Juliet' without any actors.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohhh, [color=#e23b3b][i]burn.[/i][/color] It's going to be hard putting on 'Romeo and Juliet' without any actors.

nodes.text: Andrew puts up his hand, waiting for Kevin to high-five it... But Kevin just glares at him.
Shrugging, Andrew high-fives himself.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Good luck putting together your cast list before the end of the day!
He strolls off.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Don't let him get to you. He doesn't even have a henchman to high-five with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's right though. There's not a lot of time. What if I can't get a cast list together?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, don't get down about it now... We still have `some` time to find a cast.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, don't get down about it now... We still have [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] time to find a cast.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. Okay. What should we do first?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we need a cast list by 5pm. And the earliest time we can hold tryouts is after school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if we want anyone to actually show up, we'll need to get the word out `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But if we want anyone to actually show up, we'll need to get the word out [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you have free period first, right? We should print out a bunch of flyers... And then hand them out at lunch.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, let's `do` this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, let's [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] this!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Wow, I'm part of a plan that was hatched in a huddle. This is, like, the closest I'll ever get to a sport! Break!
Right before lunch, $ZOE, Sam, and Kevin stand behind a table, each holding a stack of flyers for the auditions that afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The bell's going to ring in a minute... What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First, you're going to relax... When the bell rings, we're going to hand out flyers as people come in. Just smile and tell people it's a great opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are the chances we'll get enough people to try out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Our chances are solid. People `love` drama.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our chances are solid. People [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] drama.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...Yeah, we're always kicking people out of auditions, the lines are so long.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Do you really want to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't tell me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: But surely you two have `some` friends you can try to get onboard, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: But surely you two have [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] friends you can try to get onboard, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Riiight...
The bell for lunch rings, and as students flood the cafeteria, $ZOE and Sam step forward.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look alive!

options: Sell the play as an opportunity!

nodes.text: Uh... Romeo and maybe Juliet?

nodes.text: I don't understand. Can you... Be more specific?

nodes.text: I'm afraid... That I can't.

nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It's always lovely to see a girl in the arts because as you know Shakespeare's plays were done mostly by men in his time.

nodes.text: Iambic pentameter?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: All of Shakespeare's work is written in iambic pentameter... I don't understand. Could you be more specific?

Something sparks inside Sam's brain.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm doing more of a role reversal thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And for my creative element, I'm casting myself as a male character!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Role reversal...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: How wonderful! It's one of the topics I love exploring. Did you know that all the actors in Shakespeare's plays were male?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Back in his day, even Juliet and Lady Capulet were both played by men!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha...
And something sparks in Sam's mind...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, that's exactly what my creative element has to do with. I'm casting myself as a man!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that...

nodes.text: I'm doing more of a role reversal thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And for my creative element, I'm casting myself as a male character!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Shakespearean stuff?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Your creative element has to do with 'Shakespearean stuff'... Could you be more specific?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm afraid... That I can't.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It's always lovely to see a girl in the arts because as you know Shakespeare's plays were done mostly by men in his time.
Something sparks inside Sam's brain.

nodes.text: Actually, Ms. Macbeth, I've been explaining it all wrong.

nodes.text: I'm doing more of a role reversal thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And for my creative element, I'm casting myself as a male character!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Yes... Let's move on, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I'm sure you all know what winning this scholarship means. Not only would you have contributed a wonderful, original vision of Shakespeare to the masses...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: But you'll also get a four-year ride to an institution that supports the fine arts!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: My role is to act as mentor and judge. I'll be walking you through the process and determining which production is the most worthy of the scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And might I say that it's delightful to work with a school putting on not one, but `two` productions of 'Romeo and Juliet'! How perfectly unique!
nodes.text_bbcode: And might I say that it's delightful to work with a school putting on not one, but [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] productions of 'Romeo and Juliet'! How perfectly unique!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yes... `Unique.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes... [color=#e23b3b][i]Unique.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's how much we love Shakespeare around here!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Wonderful. Well, I look forward to seeing the two different interpretations.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The first thing I want to do is to find out what your essay topics are going to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Essay? We didn't have to write anything for today, did we?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Oh no. You turn in the essay after your production is finished. But I want to know what is different about the Romeo and Juliet production that `you're` putting on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. You turn in the essay after your production is finished. But I want to know what is different about the Romeo and Juliet production that [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] putting on.

nodes.text: Andrew jumps in.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The drama club and I are putting a new spin on 'Romeo and Juliet' as Shakespeare envisioned it. We've decided to incorporate `zombies` into the work.
nodes.text_bbcode: The drama club and I are putting a new spin on 'Romeo and Juliet' as Shakespeare envisioned it. We've decided to incorporate [color=#e23b3b][i]zombies[/i][/color] into the work.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Zombies?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, we can `do` that? How does that not change the play?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, we can [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] that? How does that not change the play?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If you'd `bothered` to read the scholarship rules, you'd know that applicants must include a `creative element.` You know, the concept we have to add to the play to make it different from the original?
nodes.text_bbcode: If you'd [color=#e23b3b][i]bothered[/i][/color] to read the scholarship rules, you'd know that applicants must include a [color=#e23b3b][i]creative element.[/i][/color] You know, the concept we have to add to the play to make it different from the original?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoops! I didn't know we had to change the play in some way!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er... I knew that! I just didn't think `zombies` applied.
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... I knew that! I just didn't think [color=#3b78e2][i]zombies[/i][/color] applied.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew can use the undead if he wishes. The rules only state that each applicant's 'Romeo and Juliet' production has to be an original adaptation.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: You have to change an aspect of the play in some way to emphasize a theme or an idea in Shakespeare's work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So he can seriously put zombies in?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Having zombies in my play will change the entire dynamic between Romeo and Juliet. Will death keep them separate? Or will it bring them closer `together?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Having zombies in my play will change the entire dynamic between Romeo and Juliet. Will death keep them separate? Or will it bring them closer [color=#e23b3b][i]together?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That seems a little silly if you ask me...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's not silly. It's romantic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it romantic if Romeo rises again demanding Juliet's brains?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Before you jump on my idea, how's `yours` coming along?
nodes.text_bbcode: Before you jump on my idea, how's [color=#e23b3b][i]yours[/i][/color] coming along?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Crap.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, what's your creative element?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's, uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I can say something to get on Ms. Macbeth's good side... What were the things she loved about Shakespeare?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, uh, my creative element has to do with...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: His work has really inspired me to perform.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's sad that I didn't really discover this passion until now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But better late than never, I say.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Yes! Exactly!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Enough about me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Shakespeare has really irritated you?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I don't understand... What didn't you like? Was it his inspiring prose? His complicated, three-dimensional characters? His innovative plots or ingenious narrative twists?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You hate Shakespeare?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't `hate` Shakespeare. I just... Find his work so... Irritating that I have to find out more about it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] Shakespeare. I just... Find his work so... Irritating that I have to find out more about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm very interested in him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Can we switch to a different topic?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, uh... Irritated me?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And for either of you, what's your experience like with the theater?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, unlike `some` people, I've devoted a great deal of time and energy to the drama club.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, unlike [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] people, I've devoted a great deal of time and energy to the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: 'Romeo and Juliet' is the fifth performance I've had the pleasure of acting in.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And Sam, how about you? Have you had experience with the stage?
Sam gulps as Andrew tries to disguise his derisive snort as a cough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually... I don't have that much experience. This will be my first time in a play.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: How unusual! What drew you to this scholarship?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... I'll admit my first passion wasn't the arts, but since I auditioned, I discovered Shakespeare has really...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll introduce myself next!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Yes, of course...
Andrew's glare makes her feel more confident.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm Sam, and I'm athletic. I used to be on the cheerleading team, but quit that in favor of swimming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I love to swim. I'm the captain of the team at the moment, and though it's a hard discipline, it's been fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Plus, I find the idea of being on stage as thrilling as participating in a swim match!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: That's exceptional. Not very many athletes go into the fine arts. I'm exuberant to see a student who's more well-rounded.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: More often than not, we have more creative types like writers and actors. This is refreshing.
She gestures to Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And you? What do you do?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Er... I'm one of those 'common' creative types you mentioned. I'm a writer.
Caught off-guard, that's all Andrew says about himself.
As Sam sits there, Andrew jumps in.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm Andrew. I'm a prolific writer of no less than seven as-of-yet unpublished novels...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And I've done some work for the newspaper club, writing articles and conducting interviews.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Some say my coverage of the election for Student President last year was `inspired`, but you know, I try not to take `too` much stock in popular opinion.
nodes.text_bbcode: Some say my coverage of the election for Student President last year was [color=#e23b3b][i]inspired[/i][/color], but you know, I try not to take [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much stock in popular opinion.

nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth nods thoughtfully as she jots a few notes down. She looks to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Crap. How am I supposed to follow that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, I'm Sam. That's short for Samantha. And I enjoy a lot of things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not really that creative... But I like swimming.
Ms. Macbeth nods, but doesn't write anything down.
Sam tries to speak, but chokes up!

nodes.title: Casting Call
nodes.subtitle: Will Sam and $ZOE pull together the right cast?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Before school, Sam sits nervously in a conference room with Andrew and Ms. Macbeth, a representative from the Shakespeare Scholarship Foundation.
Under the table, Sam nervously rubs her sweaty palms on her jeans.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't have enough time to prepare for this. Heck, I barely got the paperwork done. But this scholarship is my ticket to college... I have to try to make a good impression...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or, at least, a better impression than `Andrew.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or, at least, a better impression than [color=#3b78e2][i]Andrew.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth clears her throat and throws her hands out in greeting.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Excellent morning! Thank you for joining me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, Andrew, I'm `most` enchanted to meet you both! How could I not be when meeting the two enterprising students who are working so diligently to earn the 'Romeo and Juliet' scholarship?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, Andrew, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]most[/i][/color] enchanted to meet you both! How could I not be when meeting the two enterprising students who are working so diligently to earn the 'Romeo and Juliet' scholarship?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm quite enchanted to meet you too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, me three!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Great! Let's go around with introductions. I'll go first. I'm Beth Macbeth, and I love studying all things Shakespeare.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The themes of political transition, his extensive use of free form iambic pentameter, the role reversal when female characters were portrayed by men...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It's all so intellectually stimulating!
She stops and gestures to Sam and Andrew. Sam sees Andrew open his mouth to jump in...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Colt is `arrogant`, then he can be the `proud` Count Paris.
nodes.text_bbcode: If Colt is [color=#3b78e2][i]arrogant[/i][/color], then he can be the [color=#3b78e2][i]proud[/i][/color] Count Paris.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Erik is `truthful,` then he can be the `honest` Friar Lawrence.
nodes.text_bbcode: If Erik is [color=#3b78e2][i]truthful,[/i][/color] then he can be the [color=#3b78e2][i]honest[/i][/color] Friar Lawrence.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if Spencer is `athletic`, he'll probably make the best `swordsman` Mercutio.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if Spencer is [color=#3b78e2][i]athletic[/i][/color], he'll probably make the best [color=#3b78e2][i]swordsman[/i][/color] Mercutio.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds perfect.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Everything is going to be fine.
$ZOE and Sam walk back into the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen up! We're going to do a quick line-reading just to make sure the roles are right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have the cast list, and I'll be giving out all the roles... Ben is Romeo, Emily is Juliet, Colt is Count Paris...
She runs down the list, naming each role.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If everyone's got their role, I want each of you to read a couple of lines when I call on you.
Everyone grabs a copy of the play, and $ZOE starts calling on people to read lines.
Ben and Emily shine as Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `But soft! What light through yonder window breaks?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But soft! What light through yonder window breaks?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `It is the east, and Juliet is the sun...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It is the east, and Juliet is the sun...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father, and refuse thy name... `
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father, and refuse thy name... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt, Erik, and Spencer play their parts perfectly. Colt as Count Paris...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Sweet flower, with flowers thy bridal bed I strew...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sweet flower, with flowers thy bridal bed I strew...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer as Mercutio...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Tybalt, you rat-catcher, will you walk?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Tybalt, you rat-catcher, will you walk?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And Erik as the noble Friar Lawrence...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `The grey-eyed morn smiles on the frowning night... Chequering the eastern clouds with streaks of light...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The grey-eyed morn smiles on the frowning night... Chequering the eastern clouds with streaks of light...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At the end, $ZOE, Kevin, and Sam applaud!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How much swimming would she be missing if I gave her permission to do this play?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not that much... The production shouldn't take more than a couple weeks to pull together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I can work around her practices if we need to...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can she do it?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Well, there's kind of a deadline--

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Give a coach time to think. I'll let you know when I know.
Sam trudges out of the swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll have to be good enough for now...
Back in the theater...
The cast waits around as Sam and $ZOE frantically fill out the casting sheet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's fill in the easy ones then. I'm Tybalt. Spencer is Mercutio. Colt is Paris. Erik is Friar Lawrence...
She fills in the rest of the names from least important to most.
When Sam gets to the top of the list, she hesitates before writing anything in the blank spaces next to 'Romeo' and 'Juliet'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If Emily doesn't come and Ben doesn't want to participate... What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's always Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, I'll be `anyone's` Romeo...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone's[/i][/color] Romeo...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, he's a notch better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We don't have a choice, Sam... Let's put 'Kimi' down for 'Juliet' for now... And 'Colt' down for Romeo...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're serious? I'm Juliet? That would be... That would be amazing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'd be the best fit for it behind Emily...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah!
$ZOE fills in the blanks, shuffling people's roles around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There. It's not ideal, but... What do you think?
Sam's about to respond when they both hear Ms. Macbeth and Andrew coming into the studio.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth, I wouldn't be surprised if Sam has been having some trouble with casting. All the talent is in `my` play...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Macbeth, I wouldn't be surprised if Sam has been having some trouble with casting. All the talent is in [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] play...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Nonsense. Everyone has a little bit of an actor in them, even if they are acting in the play that is their life.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess this list is as ready as we're going to get...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Andrew, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just wanted to see `how successful` your casting was, considering...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just wanted to see [color=#e23b3b][i]how successful[/i][/color] your casting was, considering...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam! The office told me that you'd be in here. You have a cast list for me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, uh... Kind of do...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, we were just putting the finishing touches on it...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Can I see it?
Sam starts to hand over the paper when...
The door to the back of the theater bursts open!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But soft!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What `Emily` through yonder window breaks?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]Emily[/i][/color] through yonder window breaks?

nodes.text: Still in her swim suit with water in her hair, Emily runs down the aisle.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm in! I'm in! My dad said I'm in! Am I too late?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, you're right on time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just have a few adjustments to make to the cast list...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Grr...
Sam yanks the cast sheet out of Ms. Macbeth's reach.
She shuffles the names around so that everyone is back in their proper roles... At the top, she writes Emily for Juliet and Ben for Romeo.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here you go, Ms. Macbeth!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Thank you, Sam. I can't `wait` to see your play...
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you, Sam. I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] to see your play...

nodes.text: As she leaves, Sam, $ZOE, and Kevin slump into the seats of the first row.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe we did it! One day, and we got our entire cast in place! Things are looking up!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This is far from over, shrew!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You may have found some buffoons to say your lines... But that doesn't mean your play is going to be as good as mine!
He turns and storms out, muttering under his breath...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'll make `sure` of it...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll make [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] of it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously. Andrew needs to get over himself.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: He's right though. Casting is only half the battle... We still have set design, costume workups, rehearsals, you name it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's making my head spin...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we'll find a way to do it!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 2: Casting Call!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 2: Casting Call![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Denni and Colt are being featured in our sister game, `Cause of Death!` Get Cause of Death from the app store to see what they're up to!
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni and Colt are being featured in our sister game, [b]Cause of Death![/b] Get Cause of Death from the app store to see what they're up to!

nodes.text: Want to see how Denni and Colt got together? Check out the `Denni and Colt Classic Set` and `What Happened to Colt, Part 1`, available now under 'More Episodes' in the SHS store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Want to see how Denni and Colt got together? Check out the [b]Denni and Colt Classic Set[/b] and [b]What Happened to Colt, Part 1[/b], available now under 'More Episodes' in the SHS store!

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
He walks away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no... Without Emily, Ben won't want to perform...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And if Ben doesn't perform, neither will Spencer or... Or anyone else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is all falling apart!
And in her sinking heart, Sam realizes...
She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What you'd said before made sense, but I'm not sure about this one.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Playing 'Juliet' in a one-off play isn't going to be as useful as breaking the national high school record for swimming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, definitely not when you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now if we're done here... I'd like to make sure Emily gets her full practice in since she was late.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why is that important?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's the most important part of it, Coach Kessler... If she's only done swimming her entire life, how will she know what makes her happy?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm not sure I like the idea of her questioning swimming as her passion. What if she quits?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that is a risk... But if acting is her true passion, then she probably shouldn't be swimming anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And on the other hand, if she hates acting, she'll be able to say definitely that swimming is for her. Her one true passion.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Put this on her resume?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not only is she learning a play that will be assigned reading next year...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But she's also gaining the valuable skill of speaking in front of an audience with confidence.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Does she need that skill?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if she's going to be famous, she'll probably be giving press conferences and speeches. Why not start now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And she can also...

options.label: Determine whether acting is for her!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: 'Fun' is not the criteria by which I judge my daughter's extracurriculars.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If she wants to have 'fun', she has friends to hang out with.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She doesn't have to make a commitment that will take several hours of practice out of her week.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now if we're done here...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You mean, her college? Because Emily's swimming is her ticket to a full scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, beyond that. I'm talking about her future...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right. You've got my attention. Go on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Emily should join my stage production because it's...
Coach Kessler shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily won't have to worry about getting into college if she plays her cards right and swims well.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She's on track to be a professional athlete. Any college would kill to have her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now if we're done here... She has practice to start.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is going to be great! You play all the parts so well!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now that `that's` settled, let's try again from Juliet's line... Emily, will you--
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] settled, let's try again from Juliet's line... Emily, will you--

nodes.text: $ZOE is cut off by the slamming of the doors in the back. Coach Kessler walks down the aisle towards the stage.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Eep! Dad!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `Coach.` You were supposed to be in the pool twenty minutes ago!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Coach.[/i][/color] You were supposed to be in the pool twenty minutes ago!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, no!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? The swim team has practice?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, it's just personal training...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad, I'm sorry! I didn't realize auditions would go so long...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I can `see` that... And what are you doing onstage in that ridiculous curtain?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] that... And what are you doing onstage in that ridiculous curtain?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's a bolt of cloth... And, Dad, you see... I'm in this play.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You absolutely are not.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Coach.` Can we talk about this later?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach.[/i][/color] Can we talk about this later?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You shirk off training without telling me like an immature teenager, and then you want to have an open conversation about this?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How can you expect me to treat you with respect when you don't respect the time we've set aside for your future?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Coach...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Fine. We'll talk about it during your `practice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. We'll talk about it during your [color=#e23b3b][i]practice.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily steps offstage, looking sadly at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Do you think she'd be able to come back?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Just because I've realized that her social life has afforded her a certain focus doesn't mean I want her `further` distracted from her swimming.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because I've realized that her social life has afforded her a certain focus doesn't mean I want her [color=#e23b3b][i]further[/i][/color] distracted from her swimming.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Joining the theater is a waste of her time, as far as I'm concerned.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Come along, Emily.
They walk off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now what can go wrong?
Ben approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry to say this, Sam, but I wouldn't feel comfortable acting as Romeo if Emily isn't Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. That's just fantastic. We can change the play from Romeo and Juliet to Nurse and Mercutio!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It just wouldn't feel right to me. You understand, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We do... But we only have half an hour until the cast list is due... What should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stay here, Ben. I'm going to have a talk with Coach Kessler. Any advice?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... He doesn't like jokes, and he doesn't believe in fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. Wait here. I'll be back.
You are now playing as Sam.
Sam bursts out of the auditorium and races to the swim center.
Coach Kessler is writing things down on his clipboard while he waits for Emily to change in the locker rooms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach Kessler? If I could have a word?
He looks up.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What do you want, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, Coach, you pulled Emily out of my auditions fast. Let me explain the situation to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd like to have Emily join my production of Shakespeare. She's a `great` actress.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd like to have Emily join my production of Shakespeare. She's a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] actress.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Absolutely not.
In the face of his resistance, Sam nearly backs down...
But then she thinks of all her dreams and what she wants... And she sets her teeth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach Kessler, Emily's acting may seem like a distraction to you, but it's something that will help her later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is about Emily's...
$ZOE tries to match the character to the person, but has some trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So if Colt is `arrogant`, then he can be the honest Friar Lawrence.
nodes.text_bbcode: So if Colt is [color=#3b78e2][i]arrogant[/i][/color], then he can be the honest Friar Lawrence.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Erik is `truthful,` he'll probably make the best `swordsman` Mercutio.
nodes.text_bbcode: If Erik is [color=#3b78e2][i]truthful,[/i][/color] he'll probably make the best [color=#3b78e2][i]swordsman[/i][/color] Mercutio.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if Spencer is `athletic`, then he can be the `proud` Count Paris.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if Spencer is [color=#3b78e2][i]athletic[/i][/color], then he can be the [color=#3b78e2][i]proud[/i][/color] Count Paris.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if that's right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you are the casting director...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whatever. The roles can't matter that much in the end. As long as they get the lines right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's have everyone run through the roles, and we'll see how it goes.
$ZOE and Sam walk back into the auditorium.
$ZOE gets everyone to read through their roles. While Ben and Emily shine as Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `But soft! What light through yonder window breaks?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But soft! What light through yonder window breaks?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `It is the east, and `Juliet` is the sun...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It is the east, and [/i][/color]Juliet[color=#e23b3b][i] is the sun...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father, and refuse thy name...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father, and refuse thy name...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt refuses to follow his lines...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `The grey-eyed something does another thing to something else...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The grey-eyed something does another thing to something else...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stick to the script, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't help it that the script's impossible to read!
Spencer flubs all of Count Paris's lines...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Sweet flower, with flowers thy bridal bed I strew...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sweet flower, with flowers thy bridal bed I strew...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why am I talking about `flowers?` I didn't sign up for this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why am I talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]flowers?[/i][/color] I didn't sign up for this!

nodes.text: And Erik hurts himself. Severely.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Tybalt, you rat-catcher, will you walk?! Draws sword and advances on Tybalt.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Tybalt, you rat-catcher, will you walk?! Draws sword and advances on Tybalt.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! I'm supposed to `draw my sword` when it says 'Draws sword.' How silly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I'm supposed to [color=#e23b3b][i]draw my sword[/i][/color] when it says 'Draws sword.' How silly.

nodes.text: Erik draws his sword... And his plastic sword catches in his pants as he steps forward! Erik falls, stumbling straight into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ah! Nerd attack!
Erik and Spencer go down in a flail of arms. When they try to stand up again, Erik has broken his glasses, and there's a large bruise on Spencer's face.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think acting is too dangerous for me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And if `I` don't get to sword fight, then why am I even here?
nodes.text_bbcode: And if [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't get to sword fight, then why am I even here?

nodes.text: Erik and Spencer leave... Sam sighs, cradling her head in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...What are we going to do now? We've lost half the boy leads... And there's only thirty minutes until I have to turn in the cast list!
$ZOE hangs her head, unsure of what to do... Her cousin's future in her hands...
And she knows with quiet certainty...
She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: They keep acting out the scene. Even from afar, Ben and Emily's chemistry is clear. When Emily winds the scene down...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `My only love sprung from my only hate! Too early seen unknown, and known too late!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My only love sprung from my only hate! Too early seen unknown, and known too late![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...$ZOE and Sam know who their Romeo and Juliet are going to be.
A couple minutes later, $ZOE calls everyone back to announce the cast.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're proud to say that we're keeping... Everyone who auditioned!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Even Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Even Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All right! Who's the lucky Juliet I'll be tongue-gargling with?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And don't worry, ladies, I promise to smooch all the understudies too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ryan? Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though he's really sketchy, he's got a sleaziness that will work really well with some characters... Who `aren't` Romeo.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even though he's really sketchy, he's got a sleaziness that will work really well with some characters... Who [color=#3b78e2][i]aren't[/i][/color] Romeo.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So thanks, everyone, for such great auditions! Sam and I are going to consult in the hallway for a few minutes on who gets which parts.
$ZOE and Sam move to the hallway to talk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's clear that Ben and Emily are Romeo and Juliet. Their chemistry is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, amazingly nauseating!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not in a `romantic` play. What do you think of the others?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not in a [color=#3b78e2][i]romantic[/i][/color] play. What do you think of the others?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... We're going to have an inexperienced cast. But if we match everyone to the right roles, I think we'll be okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi will probably make a good Nurse character.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Amanda can be Romeo's mother, Lady Montague. She doesn't have very many lines, and she's mostly surprised throughout the entire thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor can be Juliet's mother, Lady Capulet. She's mostly upset at Juliet. I think Taylor can pull off 'upset' pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know when Taylor `isn't` pulling off upset.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know when Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] pulling off upset.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you think about the boys?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's tougher. The male characters have a bigger role than the female characters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The three biggest male roles in the play after Romeo are the `proud Count Paris,` the `honest Friar Lawrence,` and the `sword-fighting Mercutio.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The three biggest male roles in the play after Romeo are the [color=#3b78e2][i]proud Count Paris,[/i][/color] the [color=#3b78e2][i]honest Friar Lawrence,[/i][/color] and the [color=#3b78e2][i]sword-fighting Mercutio.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think Colt, Erik, and Spencer are our best bets for these roles. But which one should be which?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We can't just do a random shuffle?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Since no one here has formal experience, we have to make sure they are the right characters, so it's easy for them to act out the role.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are everyone's traits?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, Colt is `arrogant,` Erik is `truthful`, and Spencer is `athletic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Colt is [color=#3b78e2][i]arrogant,[/i][/color] Erik is [color=#3b78e2][i]truthful[/i][/color], and Spencer is [color=#3b78e2][i]athletic.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you put it like that, we can match them up easily enough...

nodes.prompt: Pick the words that mean the same thing!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll probably act better if you relax. So let's try some relaxation exercises. Close your eyes.
Emily and Ben cooperate and close their eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Take a deep breath... Think of a happy place...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The science room...
Emily opens her eyes and smirks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The `science room` is your happy place?
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]science room[/i][/color] is your happy place?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, no judging! Relaxation exercise time is a safe place!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How can I not make fun of you for choosing the chemistry lab as your place of relaxation?
They burst into laughter, and $ZOE sees that she's lost them again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `that` didn't seem to help them any... Got any other ideas?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] didn't seem to help them any... Got any other ideas?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben and Emily's laughter dies down. At this point, Ben leans over to pick up a prop sword and brandishes it with a flourish.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, I'm Romeo... `Sin from thy lips? O trespass sweetly urged!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I'm Romeo... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sin from thy lips? O trespass sweetly urged![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Give me my sin again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Give me my sin again![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily grabs a piece of cloth from a table and wraps it around her waist like a skirt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `You kiss by the book!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You kiss by the book![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How are we going to do that? Do we have costumes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but we do have props...
$ZOE takes a bolt of cloth sitting on a table. With deft movements, she wraps the cloth around Emily like it's an extravagant robe.
Next, she wraps a prop sword around Ben's waist.
Ben draws the sword and flourishes it with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right. Now this is more like it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's try this again...
Ben and Emily face one another, their eyes focused on one another, intense and in love.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like it worked!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This scene is from the party where Romeo has first met Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Sin from thy lips? O trespass sweetly urged! Give me my sin again...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sin from thy lips? O trespass sweetly urged! Give me my sin again...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He kisses Emily with passion, and she seems to swoon.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `You kiss by the book.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You kiss by the book.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll think about it...
Sam comes back and sits down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We should probably start up again. Nice seeing you, Owen.
As he walks away, Sam whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Recruiting Owen? Are you sure you're not gunning to be the next Romeo and Juliet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Sam!` It's not like that. He's hung up on Paige.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] It's not like that. He's hung up on Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Speaking of which, what about you? Where's Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are we even talking? Auditions are starting up again!
$ZOE and Sam call the rest of the names on the list...
From Amanda's...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: For my audition, I'm going to tell you the very scary story...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of `The Irrational Fraction`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#3b78e2][i]The Irrational Fraction[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `OoooOooOoooo...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OoooOooOoooo...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: To Taylor's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's get one thing straight... I deserve to be in this play because...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm the one that signs the sheets that allow you to practice in this auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... It's hard to argue with that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you, thank you! I know my performance was wonderful. You don't have to say a thing!
To Kimi's...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I'm ready for this. I'm psyched!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Deny`... Uh...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deny[/i][/color]... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Deny thy, uh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deny thy, uh...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Line?
After Kimi's audition, Sam and $ZOE talk with one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't happen to have anyone else coming in, do you? As much as I appreciate everyone's effort today... Well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not everyone here is the `best` actor?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not everyone here is the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] actor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's more than that... I haven't seen a great fit for `Juliet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's more than that... I haven't seen a great fit for [color=#3b78e2][i]Juliet.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you have to play Tybalt? If you were 'Juliet', I'd feel a lot more confident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I already told Ms. Macbeth that I'd play Tybalt. There's no backing out of it now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we don't have a good Juliet `or` Romeo. And we've only got an hour and a half left!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, we don't have a good Juliet [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] Romeo. And we've only got an hour and a half left!

nodes.text: $ZOE grimly scans the audition list. 'Ben' and 'Emily' are the last two names on it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe these two'll fit. Ben, come up!
Ben walks on stage with Emily on his heels.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is Ben, trying out for the role of Romeo! Emily here is going to be auditioning with me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yep! But I'm really just here to make him look good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's see it...
Ben and Emily stand across from each other... And start laughing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think there's any laughter in this scene...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, it's just... Hard to get into the part. Have any suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you're having trouble getting into the part, then why don't you try...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe I don't want to move on...
Owen shifts back in his seat, and $ZOE immediately realizes she's said something wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen. I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just meant that it's probably not good for you to obsess over it all the time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just don't want to forget about her.
She lays a hand on his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you will.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Join the play, Owen. At least you can hang out with your friends and people who can be there for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we could definitely use your help...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's awful that you can't see Paige...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I think it'll be good for you to have a place where you can distract yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least if you're working on the play, you can hang out with friends and the people who care about you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess it's something to do while I try to figure out a better plan to break into Monarch Prep.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we could always use a strong guy like you to help build the sets.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I am a strong guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're in?
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Later that afternoon...
Kevin adjusts lights and microphones while, onstage, $ZOE and Sam speak to a group of people who have shown up for the auditions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello everyone, and welcome to the auditions for Romeo and Juliet! We're so happy you can make it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In case you don't know, this play is the story of two star-crossed lovers, Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet, who are kept apart by their warring families.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're casting all the roles today. If all of you could just be patient, we'll call you up when we're ready.
$ZOE and Sam leap offstage and sit in the front row of seats, facing the stage.
$ZOE nods at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, we can start calling in people whenever you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First on the list... Erik Ericson!
Erik stumbles onstage and nervously adjusts his glasses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heya, everyone... For my audition, I've been practicing some jokes I found in an old book! Here goes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Knock, knock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A guy who looks just like me! What a coincidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No? Not funny? Well, they're not for everyone! Next joke!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How many Twin Branches students does it take to change a lightbulb?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Probably one! After all, we are pretty strong in the sciences.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is the mic on? Whatever! Here's another one for you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, uh, I haven't spoken with my `wife` in twenty years... It's not that we've fought. I just don't like to interrupt her.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, uh, I haven't spoken with my [color=#e23b3b][i]wife[/i][/color] in twenty years... It's not that we've fought. I just don't like to interrupt her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, your `wife?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yikes, your [color=#3b78e2][i]wife?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Sam try to listen, but his jokes get worse and worse...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I've been trying to grow a beard... But my timing's off. My five o'clock shadow's more of a half past six!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Next up we have... Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: As a professional flirter, I brought in some original one-liners... The best of my best!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `can't` wait. Go on...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] wait. Go on...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: How's it going, Sam? Has anyone ever told you that you're like a bump in the carpet?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Because you made me trip and fall hard... For `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you made me trip and fall hard... For [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right... Spencer's here for his audition.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know I'd make a good actor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: When I'm playing defense in football, you know, it's all about psyching the other person out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it was nothing to do with the fact that you're a hundred pounds heavier than everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That too, but to really tackle someone, they have to see pain in your eyes. The pain you're going to inflict on them once the play starts.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm good at projecting that pain.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's in the `eyes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's in the [color=#e23b3b][i]eyes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'll take it... Next!
Colt and Denni walk onstage next.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt! What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can have more than one ex-boyfriend on this cast at a time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... That's what I thought. I'll just be going then...
He tries to walk off, but Denni hooks him back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sam, I have a favor to ask... Colt needs one last thing to round out his application for community college, and this could be his best chance...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And it sounds like you needed some help, so we wanted to try out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I have an internship that I'm involved with, but other than that, I'd be entirely devoted to the play! We both would.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You understand, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. Go ahead. Try out...
Denni nods at Colt who clears his throat, puts on his best face, and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `To be... Or not to be... That is the question...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]To be... Or not to be... That is the question...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer, the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer, the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After Denni and Colt step offstage, $ZOE calls for a break.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's... Take five. That was way too intense.
As Sam and Kevin get up to talk to people and get water, $ZOE leans back in her chair and sighs, contemplating the cast list.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds like you've got the weight of the world on your shoulders there, $ZOE.
She turns around to see that Owen has slipped into the seat behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen! You're here! Are you going to try out?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, uh... I was here to watch Spencer. I'm not really an... On-stage person. Besides, I have other things to do, like, um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like what? Football's over. And so is basketball. What else do you do? Bake?
Owen snorts with laughter, and the sound warms $ZOE's heart.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just because I leave the baking up to you, Miss Cupcake, doesn't mean that I can't make a good muffin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, really? I'm going to need you to prove that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You doubt my muffin-making capabilities?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just say I saw what you donated to my bake sale when I was becoming Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There is just no love at all with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But really... If you have time, we could really use your help in this play... I'd be happy to work with your schedule. Is it your grandmother?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it school?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're spending all your time thinking of ways to free Paige from Monarch Prep...
She smiles, but her smile fades when she sees the look on his face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe it's a stupid idea, but I want to see how she's doing. I've even driven up there a couple of times by myself to look for a way to sneak in. But it's like a fortress...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, join the play. It will...
She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You could be lying, but what's the alternative? Staying here and being one of your doormats?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one steps on me. `I` do the stepping.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one steps on me. [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] do the stepping.

nodes.text: Before Jessica can reply, Paige runs for the door, flinging it open!
She finds herself in a hallway, looking at another door, just as Jessica described!
She sprints to it and tries to pull it open...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Locked! I guess Jessica wasn't lying!
Paige turns back around, but the first door is now blocked by Brock!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Come. You. Trouble.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know.
Brock marches Paige out through the cafeteria, past Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Told you so! Maybe, oh, I don't know, `listen` to me next time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Told you so! Maybe, oh, I don't know, [color=#3b78e2][i]listen[/i][/color] to me next time?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How about never?
Paige notices several of the other girls smile and whisper as she passes them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Enjoy your punishment!
Paige sits back down...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Good.` Very good. You totally would have been caught!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Good.[/i][/color] Very good. You totally would have been caught!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How am I supposed to escape then?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Haven't you been listening? If everything `I've` done has been designed to get revenge on $ZOE, don't you think I would have escaped by now?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haven't you been listening? If everything [color=#3b78e2][i]I've[/i][/color] done has been designed to get revenge on $ZOE, don't you think I would have escaped by now?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There `is` no escape. Brock is `always` there. Always watching.
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no escape. Brock is [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] there. Always watching.

nodes.text: As if on cue, Brock returns to his post at the door, as menacing as ever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You just have to serve out your term until you graduate from this place.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which is why I say...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Make the most of it! Be a lion with me, Paige! We could have `so` much fun together!
nodes.text_bbcode: Make the most of it! Be a lion with me, Paige! We could have [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much fun together!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I become like you, it's like I'm admitting that I'll never get out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Duh! That's exactly what I'm saying! Just come to my party next week, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, since I'm, like, replacing someone on the guest list with you, it's only fair that you do me a little favor, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What kind of favor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Relax... It's nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll make sure Whitford knows!
Before Paige can summon the will to protest, Jessica sashays off.
That night...
Principal Whitford is standing in the doorway of the restroom in front of Paige.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm surprised you volunteered to take over Jessica's bathroom cleaning duties!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe Jessica suckered me into this!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh well, it's not so bad. It's not like a bunch of rich, spoiled girls are going to cause that big of a mess.
Whitford steps aside, and Paige gasps!
Lipstick graffiti plasters the walls, damp hair coats the sink like a giant spider web, and an unbelievable stench emanates from the stalls.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're done when I can see my reflection in every surface!
Whitford closes the door behind her.
As Paige dumps her mop into a trough of dark-colored soap water, she knows...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that we've settled that nasty chair situation, we can talk about who we both are and the friendship we'll be forming together!
Paige's eyes flitter towards a door in the back of the cafeteria. Brock stands next to it, his arms crossed over his chest.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If Brock wasn't there, I bet I could escape through that door! Why guard it unless there's something to guard, right?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It may seem totes boring, but it's important that you pay attention to me, okay?
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I used to go to your stupid school, back when it was actually cool and called Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The mascot wasn't super lame, either. We were the Lizards.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, I was pretty much the biggest deal ever `ever.` I was Head Cheerleader, `and` I was about to become First Lady.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I was pretty much the biggest deal ever [color=#3b78e2][i]ever.[/i][/color] I was Head Cheerleader, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I was about to become First Lady.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were going to marry, like, the president?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?! No! I was going to be the girlfriend of the `school` president!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! I was going to be the girlfriend of the [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] president!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: In case you don't know, that means high-limit credit cards, limo rides, meeting celebrities... Oh, and...
As Jessica continues to list perks, Brock suddenly hurries off down the hall, leaving the door unprotected!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet he's going to the bathroom! This is my chance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey! Are you paying attention to me?!
Jessica leans in her chair, blocking Paige's view of the door.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I am!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah, then what was the name of your stupid school called back when I went there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? You think back when I went to your school it was called the same thing it's called `now?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? You think back when I went to your school it was called the same thing it's called [color=#3b78e2][i]now?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not my best answer, but whatever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Normally, I'm not all that big on education, but you should, like, totes study more. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, where was I? Oh yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not it! I knew you weren't paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was paying attention, I just got bored!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! I'll sum it up for you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The school used to be awesome. Now it sucks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was going to own everyone and everything!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, I'm totes sorry! I thought you weren't listening.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well I `was.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well I [color=#3b78e2][i]was.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyways, where was I? Oh yeah...
Paige is about to bolt for the door when...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I would have been First Lady if it wasn't for that goody-goody princess, `$ZOE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I would have been First Lady if it wasn't for that goody-goody princess, [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The mention of $ZOE's name is enough to make Paige settle back into her chair...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I `so` knew that would get your attention!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] knew that would get your attention!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: After all, she's, like, the one that's been after your guy, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How do you know about that?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I get visitors.
Jessica leans forward in her chair.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been in this dump for a long time, and the one thing that's kept me going is the thought of getting even with that goody-goody princess!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why are you telling me this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because you and I are a lot alike.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft. Doubtful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not only do we both hate $ZOE, but we're both lions. We dominate and conquer.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You used to rule this place back in the day, so I'm letting you know two things...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: One, this school is mine now! And two, that doesn't mean I can't share a small piece of my territory.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's the saying? Keep your friends close, and your best friends closer?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not interested.
Paige's eyes land on the door again. She stands up, poised to make a break for it, when Jessica grabs her by the wrist!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not interested?! So the rumors are true! That Owen guy has made you weak and soft-hearted.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The Paige `I` heard about never would have refused a chance for power.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Paige [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] heard about never would have refused a chance for power.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, like I said I'm `not` like you. So let go of me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, like I said I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like you. So let go of me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I tried to escape through that door during my first breakfast, too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How did you know I was--?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I told you, we're a lot alike.
Jessica lets go of Paige's wrist.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Through that door is another locked door. Even if you have the key to it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: By the time you think you've finally made it, Brock will grab you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But, hey, I could be lying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ice queen?! You'd better think twice about who you insult!
Jessica nods to Amber.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like Amber here, who called me bossy and lost her blanket privileges!
Paige can see Amber shivering.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who am I dealing with?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go sit somewhere else, Amber!
Amber scurries off, and Jessica gestures to the now empty seat. Paige sits.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going to like you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amber, go sit anywhere else!
The girl sitting next to Jessica sadly leaves.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like a seat just opened up for you, Paige.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I noticed.
Paige sits down in Amber's old seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever I say?! Where's your backbone?! Where's the fiery girl I've heard, like, `so` much about?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever I say?! Where's your backbone?! Where's the fiery girl I've heard, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a `hint` of her. Amber, scram!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]hint[/i][/color] of her. Amber, scram!

nodes.text: The girl sitting next to Paige sadly leaves.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sit.
Paige does what Jessica says.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've become kinda pathetic, huh? That's what happens when you start acting `nice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've become kinda pathetic, huh? That's what happens when you start acting [color=#3b78e2][i]nice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway...
She flops down on the bed and tries to block out the cold, tries to remember a happy memory with Owen...
But all she can remember is the conversation they had on their picnic...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
She's brought out of her memory by the sounds of crying coming from some of the other girls' rooms.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now that I think about it... It's weird how the clouds came in so quickly after that!
Paige panics!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not my coat!
Brock reaches her and holds out one of his large, bear-sized hands.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Jacket.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr! Do `not` get any of your oaf-sweat on it, got it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] get any of your oaf-sweat on it, got it?!

nodes.text: She reluctantly hands it to him.
For a second, she catches an odd look on Brock's face... But she can't place it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was that? It almost looked like... `Disappointment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was that? It almost looked like... [color=#3b78e2][i]Disappointment.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After Paige finishes her last push up, she slowly rises to her feet.
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You owe me `ten!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `ten!` No less! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. I'll do the stupid push-ups!
Paige gets down into a push-up position.
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
