nodes.text: You owe me `ten!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `ten!` No less! Start over!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I'm not some slave! And I don't belong here!
For one second, Brock smiles. Then Whitford nods at him, and the smile disappears!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Want. Worse?
Paige sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Fine! I'll do the stupid five push ups!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Because you refused, there are now ten to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Awesome.
Paige gets down into push-up position. With her knees still touching the ground, she starts her first push-up.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: No. `Real` push-up.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. [color=#e23b3b][i]Real[/i][/color] push-up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, come on! I've lived a sedentary lifestyle!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Fine!
She lifts her knees up off the ground, her arms wobbling.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
Outside, Tad holds onto Paige even tighter than before... She knows there will be no escaping.
He forces her into the backseat of their towncar, and Margot enters from the other side, sandwiching her in.
Margot addresses the driver.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: To Monarch Prep. The Butterfly Detention Center Wing. The faster the better.
As they leave behind the estate and speed down the road toward Monarch Prep, they pass a lone figure, walking with a bounce in his step!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's Owen on his way to the bus stop!
They whip past him without him ever knowing Paige is in the car, and all Paige can think is...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Will I ever see him again?
Later that night...
Owen steps through the front door of his grandma's house, whistling! Grandma Betty shuffles into the kitchen to meet him.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, well, Owie! Look what's gotten into you!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I've never seen you in this good a mood, and I was there when you had your very first piece of cake!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: It was your first birthday, and you were as naked as the day you were born.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's really weird that I never have clothes in these stories, Grandma.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Never mind that! Spill the beans, kid! What's got your goose a-gandering?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell you what happened exactly. But I can say that it was--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `--The best thing that's ever happened to you!` Monarch Prep is for the best and brightest. The Butterfly Detention Center is for those who've... Lost their shine.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]--The best thing that's ever happened to you![/i][/color] Monarch Prep is for the best and brightest. The Butterfly Detention Center is for those who've... Lost their shine.

nodes.text: Paige stands inside the Monarch Prep Detention Center in front of a heavy door with a single barred window.
She's in the middle of a long line of girls, all facing forward, standing shoulder to shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But, with discipline and time, we can mold each of you back into an epitome of grace, beauty, and prestige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What happened to this place?! Where are all the fancy butlers?! The beautiful fountains?! The gold-plated... `Everything?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What happened to this place?! Where are all the fancy butlers?! The beautiful fountains?! The gold-plated... [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Principal Whitford paces back and forth along the corridor. Her eyes lock on Paige for a second.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I see some familiar faces... So, let's get one thing straight!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is not the four-star hotel you might have been expecting!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You've been brought to me because you are `troubled.` And I have ways of dealing with trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've been brought to me because you are [color=#3b78e2][i]troubled.[/i][/color] And I have ways of dealing with trouble.

nodes.text: A tall, muscular man emerges from the shadows and cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Really subtle.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A chatty volunteer! Brock, please show Paige how we deal with trouble nowadays.
Brock takes two hulking steps over to Paige and looms over her.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Five push-ups.
Brock extends an astonishingly muscular finger and points down at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Down. Five. Now.
She grabs the coat off the bed! A second later, Tad bursts into the room!
Paige hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess I'll grab the coat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No time! Gotta grab something!
Paige scans the room quick, her eyes catching on two things: her favorite coat and a flower Owen gave her!
At the top of the stairs, Paige bursts into her room!
Paige spins, wrenching her shoulder free of Tad's vicegrip!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow!
She bolts up the stairs, Tad right on her heels!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Get back here!
Paige spits on Tad's hand!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: `Yiiiiiick!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yiiiiiick![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He releases his grip on her shoulder, and she bolts up the stairs!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Get back down here!
Margot turns to Tad...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Why aren't you going after her?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Because she just spit on me like some barbarian camel!
Paige tries to think of a way out, but she freezes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know I should do `something!`
She points at a painting on the wall!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that a painting of you, Tad?
Tad turns his head for one second...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: That? No, that's a donkey! Don't be--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You guys talked about disciplining me on your Valentine's Day getaway?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Romance ever?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Young lady, as you know, Tad and I have decided that this recent behavior of yours needs to be corrected.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And we both agree that the best way to do that is to place you in Monarch Prep's Butterfly Detention Center!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I'm `really` looking forward to that!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] looking forward to that!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I think this recent outburst is grounds for accelerating when that happens...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And it should happen... It should happen...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Immediately.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! When?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What part of `immediately` don't you understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: What part of [color=#e23b3b][i]immediately[/i][/color] don't you understand?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All of it! Sure, Owen doesn't bathe as much as he should, but that doesn't mean he's bad for me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If anything... He's the only `good` thing in my life.
nodes.text_bbcode: If anything... He's the only [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] thing in my life.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Our decision is `final!` Go to your room, gather your essentials, and I'll have one of the servants bring around a towncar.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our decision is [color=#3b78e2][i]final![/i][/color] Go to your room, gather your essentials, and I'll have one of the servants bring around a towncar.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!` This is completely unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color] This is completely unfair!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Have it your way then!
Margot snatches Paige's phone from her hands!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We'll skip getting your stuff and leave at once!
Tad places a heavy hand on Paige's shoulder and marches her toward the front door.
She tries to wiggle free, but his hand clamps down even tighter!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh, we are `far` past sorry, Paige Eloise!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, we are [color=#3b78e2][i]far[/i][/color] past sorry, Paige Eloise!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Good! Way to be firm. Just like we discussed this afternoon.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This isn't you, Mom. You've always been way `way` too strict, but you've never been this `unfair.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't you, Mom. You've always been way [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too strict, but you've never been this [color=#3b78e2][i]unfair.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: For one second, Margot's anger breaks...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry for being so harsh, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ahem. Remember what we talked about today. You have to be firm.
Margot straightens up, her moment of compassion gone.

nodes.title: Paige Against The Machine
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige escape from Monarch Prep?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Back in time, on the night of Valentine's...
After her `outing` with Owen, Paige is caught by her mother, Margot, and Margot's fiance, Tad...
nodes.text_bbcode: After her [b]outing[/b] with Owen, Paige is caught by her mother, Margot, and Margot's fiance, Tad...

nodes.text: Paige twists out of her mother's hold and glares at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can ground me, you can cancel my credit cards, you can send me away to Monarch Prep, but you can't take today away from me. Especially not after this!
Paige ducks under Tad's hand and runs after Owen.
She grabs his hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, so you're a jerk with a two-dollar hair cut and a terrible fashion sense...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? You ran after me to tell me that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why else would I do it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For this.
He pulls her into a tender, passionate, and powerful kiss, his hands warm against her neck and waist.
Their lips part, catching breath, and as they converge to kiss once more--
Tad grabs Paige and yanks them apart!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Catch you later!
He runs off, and Paige smiles wickedly as she follows her parents into the house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `So` worth the grounding I'm about to get!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So[/i][/color] worth the grounding I'm about to get!

nodes.text: Once inside, Margot whirls on Paige angrily, the veins on her forehead throbbing!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I have never been more embarrassed in my life than by that willful display you just put on!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Entirely too willful, this one!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You made me feel like a bad mother, when `you're` the one who violated `my` trust with that awful party!
nodes.text_bbcode: You made me feel like a bad mother, when [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the one who violated [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] trust with that awful party!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Dreadfully low class.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `You're` the one who disobeyed `me` by violating your punishment today!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] the one who disobeyed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] by violating your punishment today!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Disobedient indeed!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And `you're` the one on my own foyer kissing that raggedy-looking `boy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the one on my own foyer kissing that raggedy-looking [color=#3b78e2][i]boy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: He even `smells` poor!
nodes.text_bbcode: He even [color=#e23b3b][i]smells[/i][/color] poor!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. Spare me the melodrama and just tell me how long I'm grounded for!
Margot's eyes spark with a fury that unsettles Paige... As if they say: `This will be more than just a grounding.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Margot's eyes spark with a fury that unsettles Paige... As if they say: [b]This will be more than just a grounding.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mom...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm dating a linebacker!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, and you're a creeper!
Bryce backs away from Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Plus, you need to shower... Soon!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You're not interested in me, are you?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You got that hint all by yourself!
Unable to contain her disgust, Paige lets out the tiniest scream!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Eep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eep![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Did you hear that?! This way!
Adrenaline shoots through Paige! Her freak out over, she scrambles out of the mud!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Finally! I'm out!
And then, just when she can take no more, it begins to recede! She slowly climbs her way out!
The mud clears away from her face, then her waist, then her elbows, and finally...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm out!
Ahead, she can see the lights of the city!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I'm almost there!
But the lights are suddenly blotted out by the imposing silhouette of Brock!
She has failed.

nodes.text: And deeper still, the mud rising to her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not in my nose... Not in my nose...
She crawls deeper, the mud inching up to her waist!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've never wanted to scream more quietly in my life!
Paige crawls forward...
The farther she crawls through the mud, the deeper it gets...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew! Ew! Ew!
It slurks up to her elbows...
Just then, she hears a voice call from above!

nodes.speaker: Whitford

nodes.text: I. Find. Girl.

nodes.text: Brock will catch me!
Paige rushes out of the bramble patch!
Suddenly, the ground beneath her feet gives way!

nodes.text: `Aaah!`

When she reaches the bottom...
`Squick!`

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh! Come on!
She hears Whitford above her!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: She's down there somewhere, Brock! Find her! And bring her back to me!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Yes. Bring. Girl.
Paige can hear twigs and branches snapping as Brock lurches through the woods.
She bides her time, careful not to cut herself on the thorns.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Easy, Paige. Now is not the time to sacrifice your perfect face... Or your dress.
She rushes through the brambles, cutting her arms and face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow! Why are these thorns so thorny?!
Just when she thinks she's out of the brambles, part of her dress snags on a thick vine!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stupid dress! Come on!
She tugs at it, trying to get free! Finally it tears off!
She bursts out of the door and onto the front lawn of Monarch Prep! The automatic floodlights turn on!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ack! Too bright!
As her eyes adjust, she races across the grass...
Her shoe pops loose, but she doesn't stop to get it! Instead, she pulls the other one off and throws it away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr! Those `were` designer!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! Those [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] designer!

nodes.text: Running to the end of the lawn, the blades of grass poking at her bare feet, she leaps over a wooden fence...
And lands in a nest of thorny brambles!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!
She crawls through them...

She can hear Brock fiddling with the key in the door behind her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm seeing something, er... Someone!
Bryce scoots closer.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What you're seeing is masculine beauty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're, um, not my type!
Closer...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Types. Labels. Shackles, really.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Set your true feelings free!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, you smell! Like cologne!
Closer... Bryce is now right up next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You mean... The musky scent of love?
He leans in and kisses her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hmmmmmpfff!
Paige shoves Bryce back and slaps him!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, what was that for?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Take a hint! I'm not interested!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm super glad you asked!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Friends of mine get exclusive invitations to Jessica parties, immunity from harsh punishments...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And all kinds of privileges! And yes, that includes access to phones that work!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And in return?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A favor here, a favor there. It's a `good` deal. Trust me. Ask anyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: A favor here, a favor there. It's a [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] deal. Trust me. Ask anyone!

nodes.text: Paige looks out across the cafeteria at girls who quickly avert their eyes in fear, not wanting to be noticed by Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't think so.
Paige gets up to eat at another table...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: By the way, I noticed when Owen came to visit, $ZOE was right there with him...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wonder how sad he is without you... And how much she comforts him...
Paige's fists clench with anger!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you change your mind, I'm having a party next week. You should totes come!
Paige storms off without another word!
On the last day of rehearsals, the crew packs up their things for the day and heads out of the theater...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great job, everyone! The play's looking amazing! Romeo never, uh, Romeo'd better!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks! But I wouldn't be half as good without my crazy awesome, crazy beautiful Juliet!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Flattery by any other name... Is still pretty effective no matter what you call it.
As the last of the crew leaves, $ZOE turns around and finds Owen standing there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen! How's my favorite understudy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Overwhelmed! Are you sure I'm supposed to know `all` the guy parts? That's like the whole play!
nodes.text_bbcode: Overwhelmed! Are you sure I'm supposed to know [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the guy parts? That's like the whole play!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll be fine. Most likely someone with a really small role will be sick the day of the show, and you'll only have to say a couple lines.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That prediction doesn't make me exempt from knowing everyone's parts though, does it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unfortunately, no.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Tough director. You'll understand if I wish a plague on both your houses, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've only got one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Consider it doubly cursed then!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for giving me this understudy thing. It's exactly the distraction I needed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anything to keep my mind off Paige, and whatever she must be going through...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen...
$ZOE puts a comforting hand on Owen's shoulder...
The next night...
During lights out, Jessica and some of the Monarch Prep girls sneak into the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I can't see a thing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! Wait until the door closes!
Jessica closes the door behind her and flips on the light!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Guys? You in here?
A bunch of college guys peek their heads out from behind the counter.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: The things we do for girls!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I was two seconds away from bailing. This place is creepy.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Oh please! Would you listen to yourself? It's a party!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the attitude I like to hear!
Jessica sets up a tiny stereo system with the letters `J.B.` glued on the side in glitter.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My custom set.
She's about to press play when Paige walks in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: OMG! You came!
Jessica runs over and gives Paige a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew you'd change your mind!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just here for the phone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure you are!
Paige takes in the party.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How can you get away with this? Won't Brock catch you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Brock and I have an arrangement. He gets tips from me on escape attempts, I get sweet parties!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We're like friends who don't like each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... You didn't rat on any of my escape attempts did you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, no! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And hello! Let's not forget what's important. Party!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Paige, meet, uh...
Jessica gives the guys a quick once-over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Meet Bryce! The rest of you, come dance on this table with me!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I haven't danced in forever!
Jessica presses play on the stereo. While she dances on the table, Bryce saunters over to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, so, I go to college. You ever seen a college dorm before?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look. Bryce. You're cute and all, but...
Bryce takes this as a cue to move in really close to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I don't really need to hear the rest of that sentence.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, you do. See...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow. First, want to do us a favor and `not` expose the phone I risked my fab neck getting you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. First, want to do us a favor and [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] expose the phone I risked my fab neck getting you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And second...

nodes.text: Lighten up! Aren't you even interested in knowing what my friendship means?

nodes.text: Will everyone stop distracting me?! I'm trying to be the lookout!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can stop, Caroline. This escape attempt failed before it even started...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I don't understand. If you really wanted to contact Owen, why don't you just call him?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great idea! Let me just use my hand phone to place a call!
Paige mimics a phone call with Owen on her hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Owen! I'm in high school prison! Life sucks. Stay in touch.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Wow. Technology is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Prissy

nodes.text: It's hard to imagine that, but yeah!
Paige calmly manages to get the last of the screws out...

nodes.text: There's no way I'll be able to get past those things!
Paige gives up on the vent shaft, and Madisenn lowers her back down to the ground.

As Paige does her push-ups...

nodes.text: Rain check on those flowers, Owen. Score a lot of rebounds tonight... Or whatever it is you do in basketball...
That night, Owen and $ZOE arrive at Monarch Prep and see Paige being marched into a windowless building...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There she is! Paige! Paige!
Paige turns toward them...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?!
For one moment, their eyes meet...
Then Principal Whitford gives Owen an acidic glare right before she pushes Paige in and slams the door shut behind her!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe it! Paige is like... Like a prisoner here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay, $ZOE? You look like you've seen a ghost!

nodes.text: It's nothing... I just... Thought I recognized one of the other girls. Someone from my past.

nodes.text: But I'm... I'm `really` sorry about Paige! There must be something we can do!

nodes.text: I'm--

nodes.text: `--Not sure there is` anything more pathetic than you right now.

nodes.text: It's the next day, and Paige is standing on Madisenn's shoulders in the girls' bathroom, trying to pry open an air vent with a makeshift screwdriver.
Below her, Prissy files her nails while Caroline stares at the door.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: No offense, Paige, but you need to lay off the gray slop!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How are you not holding me up? Haven't you done `any` push-ups since you've been here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How are you not holding me up? Haven't you done [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] push-ups since you've been here?!

nodes.text: Misbehavior has consequences...

nodes.text: Brock's just going to catch you again. Or `us` if you keep making so much noise with that screwdriver!

nodes.text_bbcode: I have to contact Owen. [color=#3b78e2][i]He's[/i][/color] obviously trying to contact [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, but did you not see who he was with? Jessica's right. Owen's just going to end up with $ZOE.
Paige shimmies astoundingly fast, grabbing onto the vertical portion of the pipe before the horizontal piece breaks off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Phew! I made it!
Paige descends down with ease...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, if you can somehow hear this, you owe me `so` many flowers!
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen, if you can somehow hear this, you owe me [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many flowers!

nodes.text: When she reaches the bottom, she turns toward the main road...
And runs smack into Brock's chest!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Move fast. Escape no. Push-ups...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Escape no. Push-ups yes.
Paige panics, freezing in place!
The pipe pops loose, teetering away from the building, and finally swinging down in a collision course with the ground!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pipe catches just a few feet off the ground. From her upside-down vantage point, she can see Brock looming over her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Brock.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Break. Pipe. Many. Push-ups.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, I know.
That afternoon, at Paige's estate...
After climbing a trellis in search of Paige, Owen comes back down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No sign of her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, it's going to be okay...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is it? 'Cause it doesn't seem like things are okay...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She didn't show up to school, she sent me an insulting text that doesn't sound like her, and from the looks of things...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her house is abandoned. What about this makes you think--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `--Things are going to be okay!` Things are going to be okay! Just don't look down!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]--Things are going to be okay![/i][/color] Things are going to be okay! Just don't look down!

nodes.text: Paige is dangling from a gutter pipe high above the campus grounds! She closes her eyes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you make it, you can see Owen at the basketball game tonight, and everything will be back to normal!
Paige opens her eyes and starts shimmying along the pipe! A few yards ahead, the pipe curves down to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Almost there! Almost there! Almost there!
Just then, a bolt pops loose!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no! Oh no! Oh no!
When Paige gets up, Brock is giving her a look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's that look again! Is Brock expecting something from me?
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You owe me `five!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `five!` No less! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: At least you're finally starting to respect my authority. Five push-ups!
Paige gets down into push-ups position...
When she gets up, Brock is giving her a look.
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Start over!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You owe me `ten!` In a `row!` Start over!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Can you count?! You will give me `ten!` No less! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? I'm just repeating what you said. I'm lucky Brock caught me when he did!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Ten` push-ups! And don't test me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ten[/i][/color] push-ups! And don't test me!

nodes.text: Paige gets down into push-ups position.
Over the next few weeks, time marches on for Paige and Owen, marked not by minutes, but by mysteries, near misses, and frustrations.
On the day after the Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...You didn't happen to hear anything about Paige, did you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... She didn't show up last night?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, she didn't.
He looks at his phone like he's lost a lifeline.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen--
The sound of Owen's phone beeping interrupts her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's from Paige... 'Owen, stop texting. I don't ever want to talk to you again. Delete my number.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She must... She must have changed her mind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Changed her mind about what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: About me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The text `is` pretty mean. She might be joking.
nodes.text_bbcode: The text [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] pretty mean. She might be joking.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm not accepting this. If she doesn't like me, then she has to--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `--'Tell me to my face?'` Are those not the words you shouted back at me during your latest escape attempt?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]--'Tell me to my face?'[/i][/color] Are those not the words you shouted back at me during your latest escape attempt?

nodes.text: Paige is in Principal Whitford's office. Brock looms behind her, his breathing audible.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Not going to answer? I'll refresh your memory. You were about to leap into the school dumpster from a second-story window!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I said, 'If you dive into that dumpster, you'll regret it!' And then you said, 'Why don't you tell me to my face?'

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, here I am, and you `are` going to regret it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, here I am, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] going to regret it!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're just lucky Brock caught you where he did.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Had you made it outside, your punishment would be far more severe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The way you handled everything else, I'm sure it'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean the way you handled everything else?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's our first big performance, Sam. Things never go smoothly...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry. You're right. I'm nervous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll catch you on the other side.
Sam takes a deep breath and enters stage left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Haven't you heard? 'Good luck' is bad luck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right. Sorry! I meant 'break a leg'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too late now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're just words, Sam. You go out there and do great, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll handle anything that goes... Awry back here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if anything else comes up, I'll take care of it.
The words catch in $ZOE's throat. She clears it then speaks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Good luck?
And Erik, the duct tape around his waist, tries to act with confidence...
But when Erik's hand brushes past his waist, the end piece of the duct tape attaches itself to his finger!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I would I knew not--Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I would I knew not--Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bringing his hand up to his face, Erik gets the tape stuck in his hair!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I knew not why it should be--Agh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I knew not why it should be--Agh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik yanks, trying to free himself from the tape and gets his sleeve caught in it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... I can't watch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Erik!
Erik shakes his sleeve hard and ends up with both of his arms taped flat against the side of his head. His ripped pants drop down to his ankles!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoops!
Erik shuffles back and forth across the stage, while the audience laughs uproariously.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tighty McWhitey! Um, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that the, um... Lady who doth come toward your cell?
Emily strides on, and Sam turns back to $ZOE as the play goes on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was a `disaster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That was a [color=#3b78e2][i]disaster![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam pushes Erik and Colt back onstage and watches the scene unfold...
Colt as Count Paris speaks authoritatively...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Now, sir, her father counts it dangerous that she doth give her sorrow so much sway...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Now, sir, her father counts it dangerous that she doth give her sorrow so much sway...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `And in his wisdom hastes our marriage, to stop the inundation of her tears...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And in his wisdom hastes our marriage, to stop the inundation of her tears...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE goes for the boa and wraps it around Erik's waist.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A boa? That's not very Elizabethan, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's what we have. A line of duct tape around the middle wouldn't look very natural. At least they used feathers back in the day.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like it. It makes me look very distinguished. And it works!
He releases his hands, and the outfit stays intact.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now go back out there!
$ZOE grabs the duct tape, tears off a long length of it, and wraps it around Erik's waist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There. Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Except for the gray line going around his waist...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least it'll stay on. Being slightly historically inaccurate isn't going to matter if Erik flashes his underwear to the entire crowd.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I should probably warn you that me and tape don't get along well together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too late for that. You need to get out there!
$ZOE is wracked with indecision!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need, uh... The uh, tape! Get the tape!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What were you saying about things not going wr--
Colt and Erik come up to $ZOE and Sam. Erik is bunching up the fabric of his costume at his waist.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE! Sam! I hast doth tripped upon a strange bough...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Translation, please?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ericson tripped over one of the beams holding up the set and ripped the bottom clear off his pants.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Where?
Erik starts to let go of the bunched up cloth in his hand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. Stop. I don't want to see your... Unmentionables.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I too would prefer to keep my unmentionables uncommented on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't we all? Now what do we do?
$ZOE looks around and spies some duct tape and a thin, white feather boa.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should I grab?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Naked?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Naked. You know, so they're less intimidating!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... But they'll be `naked` and judging me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huff... Huff... Huff... But they'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]naked[/i][/color] and judging me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll be able to read the judgement... Huff, huff... In their eyes even more!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's getting worse, not better!
Sam steps in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kimi, you're going on in one minute. You have to. If you can't stand people watching you, then you're in luck. You can't see them.
Sam gestures to a gap in the curtain that looks out to the audience.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you see anyone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, huff, huff... It's, huff, dark...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then you can just imagine there's no one there, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... I, huff, guess so!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Get on out there!
Sam pushes Kimi out onstage at her cue. Kimi stumbles onstage, clearly flustered.
There's silence for ten seconds before Kimi pulls it together enough to fumble through her lines...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... `O, huff, woe! Huff! O woeful, woeful, huff, woeful, day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Uh... [color=#3b78e2][i]O, huff, woe! Huff! O woeful, woeful, huff, woeful, day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She can say that again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just... Huff... You and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, like in practice. You delivered all your lines perfectly in practice, and the only audience was me and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the same thing. No one will be there to judge you or anything.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Isn't it... Huff... Going to be kind of hard to do that... Huff... When there are other people in the audience?
$ZOE smiles and gestures to a gap in the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, look through here. Can you see anyone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, it's really dark out there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So it should be pretty easy to imagine that it's me and Sam in the darkness, right?
Kimi nods.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great. You ready to go on?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah!
She walks on stage right on cue and starts performing her lines without hitch!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `O woe! O woeful, woeful, woeful day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O woe! O woeful, woeful, woeful day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Sam gives $ZOE a pleading look.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just pretend everyone's naked!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means, we need Friar Lawrence, Montague, Lady Montague, Capulet, and Lady Capulet out there right now, mourning for their children.
The named actors start filing out of the dressing room. Spencer lumbers up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not you, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes!
Sam plucks Erik out of the crowd of actors moving to the front.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik Ericson! Can you just do me a favor and give Spencer a signal when he needs to get onstage? He's on when you're not.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm happy to be of service! You know my mother says I've always been helpful...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Thanks!
The next ten minutes hurry by as Kevin coordinates the opening sets and cues up the music.
When the curtain opens, everyone is in place!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `For I will raise her statue in pure gold... That while Verona by that name is known, there shall no figure at such rate be set...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]For I will raise her statue in pure gold... That while Verona by that name is known, there shall no figure at such rate be set...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `As that of true and faithful Juliet`...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]As that of true and faithful Juliet[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: While the play happens smoothly onstage...
Backstage, Sam is all nerves. $ZOE pats her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... You okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm great, I'm fine, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, no. I'm terrible! I hate this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My stomach's tied in knots. And there's this pounding in, like, my `brain.`
nodes.text_bbcode: My stomach's tied in knots. And there's this pounding in, like, my [color=#3b78e2][i]brain.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you upset about? Is it the play? Because that's pretty normal...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not just about that. It's about Nick and the play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... He and I... Haven't really been talking. I mean, I forgave him for calling me 'Sara', but I don't know if I can ever `forget` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... He and I... Haven't really been talking. I mean, I forgave him for calling me 'Sara', but I don't know if I can ever [color=#3b78e2][i]forget[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... I'm sure you'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure... `Maybe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, sure... [color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And of course with all this play stuff... I just keep thinking about Andrew's play and how good it was. What if mine doesn't measure up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if I don't win? My mom's out there, and she's going to be so disappointed if the play's a mess. What if changing up the play is a bad idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Changing the play around wasn't a bad idea, Sam. It shifts the focus. It makes it less about Romeo and Juliet's destiny, and more about their romance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: By focusing on the kiss, you're focusing on a love so powerful, it changed two houses for the better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Yeah. You're right. Ms. Macbeth will appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope that the play goes smoothly, and nothing goes wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... Nothing's going to go wr--
Suddenly, Emily races over to them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily? What's wrong? You're supposed to be 'dead' on the bed! You're going on again in ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know, but there's kind of a problem! I'm not sure what happened, but Kimi suddenly has a bad case of nerves. She doesn't want to go on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She and I both.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily, get ready for your next scene. We'll find her.
It takes $ZOE and Sam a few precious minutes to find Kimi, but they track her down near the rack of prop weapons.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, guys... I really want to go out, but I just think of all those people out there, and... It's just so embarrassing!
Kimi starts hyperventilating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's she doing? What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, just relax...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... Huff... Tried that! Being relaxed is... Huff... Hard when you're, uh, not! So many people... Huff... Out there, watching me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, you know all the lines. You've been practicing really hard. Just because there are people out there doesn't mean you'll do badly...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Doesn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... Ben just 'killed' Colt. The scene's wrapping up. We're going to a flashback with Juliet and the Nurse. I need her to go on in two minutes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff! Huff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, just imagine that...

options.label: It's just me and Sam watching!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Deaths... Kiss... `Jokes?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Deaths... Kiss... [color=#e23b3b][i]Jokes?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jokes? There are jokes in the play?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! That's new!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did any of my audition material make it in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jokes?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Samface, $ZOEperson, I don't want to annoy you, but... The only person who tells jokes is Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And they're not funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are no jokes! $ZOE is just being really confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deaths. Duel. Kiss.` Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss.[/i][/color] Got it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kiss... Duel... Death?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, yeah! I remember how the play goes now! Romeo and Juliet kiss, I duel you, and then they die!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, wait a minute...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's the original version of the play. We changed it. $ZOE is just being really confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You lost me again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deaths. Duel. Kiss.` Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss.[/i][/color] Got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unlike the original script, instead of ending with Romeo and Juliet's deaths, we're `starting` with them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlike the original script, instead of ending with Romeo and Juliet's deaths, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]starting[/i][/color] with them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now repeat after me... `Death. Duel. Kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now repeat after me... [color=#3b78e2][i]Death. Duel. Kiss![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A chorus of 'Deaths, duel, kiss!' rises from the assembled crowd, and $ZOE nods. Sam looks visibly relieved.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And one last time... `Deaths. Duel. Kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And one last time... [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And of course there's always the theme of missed communication. I get weird messages from Paige's phone... I can't talk to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Romeo and Juliet couldn't get ahold of each other... And we all saw how that ended. Romeo poisons himself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dark stuff.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, I know that you're trying to reach her. I'm sorry that you can't seem to get close enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Try not to get hurt, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't. I know she's trying to reach me too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just hope she's more successful.
While Sam and her group break before the big play that evening...
Across the city, Paige finally reaches the borders of the city of Centerscore!
Having just crawled through mud to escape Monarch Prep, she sets off in the direction of Owen's house, each step taking her closer and closer...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm coming, Owen... And you'd `better` be ready for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm coming, Owen... And you'd [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be ready for me!

nodes.text: That evening, at the theater...
It's absolute chaos backstage as everyone in Sam's production scrambles around in the dressing room, preparing for their first and only show!
Some people get ready in front of the mirror...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Makeup emergency! I need red lipstick over here, stat!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have red `hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have red [color=#3b78e2][i]hair![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, not now, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I have lipstick, Taylor!
Taylor gives Kimi the once-over and scowls.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not you either. I wouldn't want to end up in one of your spreadsheets.
While others put on their costumes...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, Denni... Need any help zipping up that dress?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't touch me, Ryan, or I'll zip `you` up, and it won't be pleasant.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't touch me, Ryan, or I'll zip [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] up, and it won't be pleasant.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Also, dude! I'm `right` here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, dude! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] here!

nodes.text: Colt stands up menacingly and edges towards Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay. You're very macho. Now let's get you into these tights.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously? I'm not wearing any stockings unless it's on my face.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do I even want to know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Has anyone seen my minstrel's lute?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you need a lute for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been doing method acting, Benjamin Kale, and in my heart, I know that Friar Lawrence desperately wants to be a bard. He was born to it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think that's what he does after he accidentally helps kill Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
And at the helm of the ship, $ZOE and Sam try to get everyone organized.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen up! Ten minutes to showtime! Anyone acting in the first scene needs to report backstage!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Is that me and Ben?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This question again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got this, Sam.
She turns to the assembled actors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's confusing, but please try to pay attention to the order of the play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though I'll be cuing people to go on, I won't be able to pull this off without your help. Now the general order of the play is...

nodes.prompt: The general order of the play is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: The general order of the play is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Unrequited?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that what it's called when you're pining away for someone, but you don't know how they feel?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know how she feels about me. She likes me. She has to.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige can come off as mean and cruel, but I know what we have is real.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Of course Paige likes you. It's just that you two can't be together right now even though you want to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what Romeo and Juliet is all about. That's why it speaks to you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, you and Paige are two people in love, separated by circumstances beyond your control.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That about sums it up...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. No wonder the play makes so much sense.
$ZOE trails off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The theme of what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, unrequited love?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys know your parts backwards and forwards... Well, by tonight, you'll know them `forwards and backwards!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys know your parts backwards and forwards... Well, by tonight, you'll know them [color=#3b78e2][i]forwards and backwards![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And of course, I'll be backstage making sure everyone gets to their parts on time and everything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're sorry to spring this on you at the last moment, but we'll all do great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's do a run-through, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First, the `deaths` of Romeo and Juliet... Next, the infamous `duel` between Tybalt, Romeo, and Mercutio...
nodes.text_bbcode: First, the [color=#3b78e2][i]deaths[/i][/color] of Romeo and Juliet... Next, the infamous [color=#3b78e2][i]duel[/i][/color] between Tybalt, Romeo, and Mercutio...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And `then` the `kiss` at the party! Places everyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] the [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] at the party! Places everyone!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
Backstage, $ZOE looks at the new notes on the script that Sam has made.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Deaths, duel, kiss... Deaths, duel, kiss...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths, duel, kiss... Deaths, duel, kiss...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Quite a lethal combination of words there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, Owen... Just trying to make sure `I` know the order before I tell other people to get on stage and perform.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, Owen... Just trying to make sure [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know the order before I tell other people to get on stage and perform.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll do great. Being organized is what you do best.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I just hope we'll all be able to pull off the new order of this play...
$ZOE and Owen look back at the stage where Sam is yelling at Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Leaping out to attack you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not supposed to leap out during the `balcony scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not supposed to leap out during the [color=#3b78e2][i]balcony scene![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How am I supposed to know that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have a `cue.` Don't come out until Erik leaves the stage.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have a [color=#3b78e2][i]cue.[/i][/color] Don't come out until Erik leaves the stage.

nodes.text: Sulkily, Spencer walks backstage, and Sam turns to Emily and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now you two, kiss!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait, that's right `now?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, that's right [color=#3b78e2][i]now?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE sighs heavily.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, a few more run-throughs, and it'll be natural, I'm sure.
They look back at the stage and see Emily and Ben kiss on the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like that. That's completely natural.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `More` passion!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]More[/i][/color] passion!

nodes.text: Ben tilts his head and frames Emily's face with his hands. The kiss is tender and deep.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...They are `way` too good.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...They are [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad it's convincing. It's good Ben and Emily agreed to be the stars of the show.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Because they're not afraid to kiss onstage?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, that's exactly it. They throw so much of themselves into that kiss. It really sells to the audience how strong their love is.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. That's deep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. I try. So how's learning the lines? Being the understudy for every guy isn't an easy task. You said you were having some trouble last time we talked.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... I've read the play the entire way through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, that's a good start... But what about the memorization?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's going surprisingly well. It `was` rough at first, but it got a lot easier since Ben and Spencer keep asking for prompts every scene. I know both their parts really well.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's going surprisingly well. It [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] rough at first, but it got a lot easier since Ben and Spencer keep asking for prompts every scene. I know both their parts really well.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...As for the others, well, if something bad happens then I'm pretty sure I can write them on my hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay. I'm sure this must be your favorite play by now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's kind of a depressing play. But in a weird way, it speaks to me. It reminds me of Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it would make sense that you would say that given the theme of...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, Amanda, really?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If we're keeping our roles, then are our lines changing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't memorize `another` set of lines! No one has time for that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't memorize [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] set of lines! No one has time for that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think what Sam means is that you already know your lines!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So it'll be pretty easy to act once you know where to start.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're not asking you to relearn an entirely new play...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just to recite the lines you already know in different places!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So it'll be pretty easy to act out the rest of the scene once you know where to start.
Sam blanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... It'll be easy because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because you know your roles!
The gathered actors are quiet... Then all of them burst into chatter!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Out of order? What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the `theme` of reversals.
nodes.text_bbcode: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the [color=#3b78e2][i]theme[/i][/color] of reversals.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be `reversals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be [color=#3b78e2][i]reversals![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, uh-oh! I don't deal well with sudden change!
Erik begins breathing heavily.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is it too bright in here? Am I still human? Where am I!
Owen claps Erik hard on the back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Breathe, Ericson. Breathe. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Change! I love change!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So with this new script... Does this mean we can put in a scene where I kiss Lady Capulet?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `wish.` There is `nowhere` in the play where you'd be kissing my character!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]wish.[/i][/color] There is [color=#3b78e2][i]nowhere[/i][/color] in the play where you'd be kissing my character!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As if I'd let him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does that mean we'd be switching roles too? I can be other things than just the Nurse, I promise!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I am a little confused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What does that even mean? How are we doing that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, the theme of my play is about 'reversals'. But the only reversal in my play is that I'm playing the male character Tybalt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to rearrange the play so that the deaths come first, and then we recount the story of Romeo and Juliet's love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last and most important scene will be their `kiss` on the balcony.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last and most important scene will be their [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] on the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Do I still get to do my sword-fighting scene?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! And don't worry too much guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it'll be easy because you already...
That night, Sam and the rest of the troop put on 'Romeo and Juliet With Vampires: And Sam'!
Onstage, Emily as Juliet soliloquizes above Ben as Romeo. Ben lies still in a fake tomb, pretending to be dead.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `This... Is my sheath!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This... Is my sheath![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Emily's about to plunge the prop dagger into her heart, Ben snaps up from the tomb he lays on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Uhn... Uhhhhhnnnn...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uhn... Uhhhhhnnnn...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My heart!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My heart![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Hark, thy blood... Thy blooooodddddd...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hark, thy blood... Thy blooooodddddd...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Ben hisses at Emily in what sounds like Shakespearean pentameter, Sam watches nervously from just behind the curtains.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do you think it's going? I can't tell. I'm so nervous...
$ZOE scans the faces of people in the audience. Ms. Macbeth, in particular, looks unimpressed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Sam. I just don't know.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Thy disgusting teeth, thy undead hunger... Taste the flesh of your living Juliet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thy disgusting teeth, thy undead hunger... Taste the flesh of your living Juliet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `So you taketh love... To immortal end!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So you taketh love... To immortal end![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Bloooodddd... Loveth thy blood...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bloooodddd... Loveth thy blood...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben bites Emily's neck as the curtain closes over them.
When the curtain rises and the actors take a bow, there is lukewarm reception from the audience.
Ms. Macbeth and Andrew approach Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what'd you think?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, it's clear you put a lot of effort into your production.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: ...But it lacks originality.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It is indeed a play most foul! Your entire ending is just a farce, a copy of the ending to my play!
Ms. Macbeth silences him with a look.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: While I don't approve of Andrew's strong wording, he is correct. Your interpretation, Sam, has nothing new to offer.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I have no choice but to name Andrew the winner of the scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But--!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I won? I won!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course I won!
Andrew turns to Sam with a smirk.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'd say it was a pleasure, but it was the exact opposite.
Sam doesn't even have a witty quip back as Andrew smugly goes on about the superiority of his play.
In her heart, Sam knows that...
She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vampires?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Vampires? That's so... Four years ago.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, Andrew pulled off his play with supernatural creatures really well last night.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I figure that I can do that too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where is the vampire plot in Romeo and Juliet?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, it's like the Montagues and the Capulets are two warring vampire houses... We put in a couple battles, it'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YEAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YEAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And for the next several hours, they practice with the new vampire plot element...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yours? Pfft! Please! The only thing you've got going is role reversal, and `you're` the only one in the entire cast with a reversed role.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yours? Pfft! Please! The only thing you've got going is role reversal, and [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] the only one in the entire cast with a reversed role.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're a washed up hack!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... `One` of us has a successful play to celebrate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now if you'll excuse me... [color=#e23b3b][i]One[/i][/color] of us has a successful play to celebrate.

nodes.text: He walks away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That guy!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah. He seems to get worse every time I see him. Does he ever stop talking?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Probably not... But what he said is right... My play's just `me` doing a role reversal.
nodes.text_bbcode: Probably not... But what he said is right... My play's just [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] doing a role reversal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I need to change things up... And quick!
The next morning, at the afternoon rehearsal right before the show...
Sam and $ZOE stand on the stage in front of the assembled actors. $ZOE clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen up, everyone... You've all done a great job these last couple weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But as of last night, we realized that we have to make a couple changes to the script...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No... I barely know my part as it is!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This has to do with Andrew's play, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. If we're going to do better than Andrew's production--

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which was `awesome...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which was [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: --Then we're going to have to change things around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I decided that we're going to perform Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.prompt: We're going to perform Romeo and Juliet...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We're going to perform Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was a lot of fun! I thought zombies made the entire action of the Romeo and Juliet story more intense and exciting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the ending was just great! It was brilliant that the zombies talked in the same style!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It was a challenge encouraging my zombie cast to only moan in ten syllables!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The level of detail in your play shows an enthusiasm for both the art and the prose. Well done, Andrew. I'm quite impressed.
Andrew shoots Sam a smug smile.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Maybe I `shouldn't` have been so nice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't[/i][/color] have been so nice...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: At any rate, I must jot down some notes for the scholarship. Sam, I am very excited to see how your play fares.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Especially after Andrew's `brilliant` production!
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially after Andrew's [color=#3b78e2][i]brilliant[/i][/color] production!

nodes.text: She waves good-bye to both of them and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Did you hear that? It was `brilliant.` Thanks for putting the words right in her mouth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you hear that? It was [color=#e23b3b][i]brilliant.[/i][/color] Thanks for putting the words right in her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, Sam, you could have been a little less effusive with your enthusiasm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. Just because Andrew's play was good doesn't mean mine isn't going to be `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. Just because Andrew's play was good doesn't mean mine isn't going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was a pretty good adaptation, and the zombies were a fun addition...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But the ending seemed to confuse the theme of the entire play. Their deaths were supposed to heal the rift between the two houses... But instead, the plague plunged everything into chaos.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What was the new theme? It wasn't as clear to me.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Interesting! I do think you're right. While the technical aspects of the play and the smaller details were well done...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It does seem to undermine the main spirit of the play. Thank you for that critique.
Andrew shoots Sam an angry glare.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Grrr...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: At any rate, I must jot down some notes for the scholarship. Sam, I am very excited to see how your play fares.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: We shall see how well `you` capture Shakespeare's main theme.
nodes.text_bbcode: We shall see how well [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] capture Shakespeare's main theme.

nodes.text: She waves good-bye to both of them and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Thanks a `lot`, Sam.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color], Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was my pleasure.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I don't need your smug pleasantries. And your opinion's worth nothing to me! My play is a masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And yours will be a `joke.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And yours will be a [color=#e23b3b][i]joke.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It will not! It's going to be `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It will not! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam rails against Andrew's play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think it was all that great. The zombies were a horrible addition to the entire play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it didn't make that much sense. Come on, a plague in that era? There weren't any zombies!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The entire play just seemed like a superficial shrine to showcase Andrew's otherwise lame talents.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I didn't find it to be 'lame' as you say. I thought it was very well done and true to the Shakespearean spirit.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And while I understand that Andrew is your competition, Sam, it's very `unsportmanlike` of you to tear apart his production.
nodes.text_bbcode: And while I understand that Andrew is your competition, Sam, it's very [color=#3b78e2][i]unsportmanlike[/i][/color] of you to tear apart his production.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I only hope yours fares better.
Ms. Macbeth turns and leaves them. Andrew smiles smugly at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Looks like `someone` was put in their rightful place.
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] was put in their rightful place.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh yeah, it's you. It was you all along, `shrew.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, it's you. It was you all along, [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up. Maybe I went a little overboard, but what I said is based off the truth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your opinion's worth nothing to me! My play is a masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And yours will be a `joke.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And yours will be a [color=#e23b3b][i]joke.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It will not! It's going to be `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It will not! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.title: The Show Must Go On
nodes.subtitle: Can Sam beat Andrew and win the scholarship?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Sam, $ZOE, and Kevin are sitting front and center at the stage production of 'Romeo and Juliet With Zombies: And Andrew'!
Onstage, Jenna as Juliet soliloquizes above Andrew as Romeo. Andrew lies still in a fake tomb, pretending to be dead.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `This... Is my sheath!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This... Is my sheath![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Jenna's about to plunge the prop dagger into her heart, Andrew lumbers up from the tomb he lays on...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Un... Uhnnn...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Un... Uhnnn...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: While Andrew makes zombie moans in iambic pentameter, $ZOE leans over to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I literally have no idea where the end of this play is going to go...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shhh! This is exactly the part I've been waiting to see...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `So plague taketh love... To its timely end!`
