nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew shuffles over to Jenna and pretends to consume her brains...
And the curtain closes.
Applause resounds loudly through the theater.
Ms. Macbeth stands, excitedly bringing her hands together.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Bravo!
A few seats down, $ZOE, Sam, and Kevin stand up and head into the lobby of the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was `so` gruesomely realistic!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] gruesomely realistic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The part where Hannah says, `an undead plague upon both your houses`, was a pretty good line.
nodes.text_bbcode: The part where Hannah says, [color=#3b78e2][i]an undead plague upon both your houses[/i][/color], was a pretty good line.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And the way the zombies shambled after their victims and fed on their heads...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `So` surprisingly good.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] surprisingly good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, great.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You didn't like it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I `loved` it. I `love` zombie anything, really. But... It's `Andrew's play.` This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] it. I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] zombie anything, really. But... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Andrew's play.[/i][/color] This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And everyone was so into it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: His play wasn't `that` great...
nodes.text_bbcode: His play wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] great...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you're trying to make me feel better, $ZOE. It's okay that Andrew's play was successful.
There's a slow clap behind her, and Sam glares at Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Admitting your defeat already? You can always withdraw. It's never too late.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Andrew, how do you keep slithering up that way?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, `shrew!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam bites back whatever choice words she has to say to Andrew when she spots Ms. Macbeth walking over to them.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew, congratulations on a theatrical success!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why, thank you, Ms. Macbeth! I strive for excellent theater.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unlike `others` in my peer category...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlike [color=#e23b3b][i]others[/i][/color] in my peer category...

nodes.text: He sneers at Sam, and $ZOE puts her arm on Sam's hand to stop her cousin from growling.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, what did you think of the play?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I `probably` shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]probably[/i][/color] shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?

nodes.text: $ZOE and Owen look at one another, breathing hard and taking everything in. Owen whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How do you think we did?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, lovebirds! Hurry up and come down for the final bow!
$ZOE and Owen carefully scramble down from their places on the balcony and join the other actors.
When the curtain rises and the actors take a bow, there is a loud and thunderous applause from the audience!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
Owen bows, grinning at the crowd... And he notices a familiar figure storming up the aisle towards the doors...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Paige?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the matter? Did you see someone?
Owen looks back to the crowd again, but the figure is gone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought I did... But I guess not...
Then the curtain closes.
You are now playing as Sam.
Backstage, Sam waits anxiously with $ZOE and Kevin as the auditorium empties out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you think? It wasn't too dramatic, was it?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Are you kidding? They loved it! I can still hear the applause! This was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have a good feeling about this...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha! Look who I found!
Sam turns to see her mom, Ms. Macbeth, and Andrew approach. Sam's mom puts a supportive arm around her daughter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time to face the music...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what'd you think, Ms. Macbeth?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was wonderful! Spectacular! The inversion of the play was unique and entertaining!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was so well put together! It really highlighted the love between Romeo and Juliet as the core emotion of the play.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Having watched both your plays, I'm honored to announce that the Shakespeare Scholarship Federation is proud to honor Sam with the distinguished 'Romeo and Juliet' award!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: This is such great news, Ms. Macbeth! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, thank you, thank you, thank you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did it, Sam! Congratulations!
Sam, $ZOE, and her mother hug each other, as Andrew fumes beside them.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?! But what about the commotion in the final act? The switching of the players?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I admire the ability to move on despite setbacks. And switching the actors out... Well, it was an inspired move that emphasized the universality of the play.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Aren't we all Romeo and Juliet in our own way with our own tragic backstory and our own romances and escapades?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I can't believe this! Spencer missed his cue and destroyed half the set! It was... It was simply unprofessional!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd you know Spencer missed his cue?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Anyone could have guessed with that `fool` in the wings. And with Erik giving him stage directions, it's like the blind leading the buffoon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyone could have guessed with that [color=#e23b3b][i]fool[/i][/color] in the wings. And with Erik giving him stage directions, it's like the blind leading the buffoon!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd you know Erik was in charge of giving him stage directions?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Er... Anyone... Could... Guess?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew... I'm afraid we're going to have to have a `long` chat about what is professional... And what is `not.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Andrew... I'm afraid we're going to have to have a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] chat about what is professional... And what is [color=#3b78e2][i]not.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth hauls Andrew away with her.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I did nothing that Iago wouldn't have done!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good morrow to you, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah! You deserved it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if it weren't for you guys... None of this would have happened...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if I can ever repay you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can start! Who wants a meat pizza? My treat!
The next morning, before school, Sam is sitting at a lunch table, trying to muster some excitement for her S.E.T. prep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm thrilled I can afford college now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that means I actually have to `try` to get a good score on the S.E.T.s.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that means I actually have to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to get a good score on the S.E.T.s.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course, I don't know why that can't wait until tomorrow...
She throws her pencil into the crack of her book, but misses. It rolls down the length of the table and falls...
Into Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Aren't you forgetting something?
Nick stands across from her, a bouquet of red roses in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey. What are `those` for?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey. What are [color=#3b78e2][i]those[/i][/color] for?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For being the prettiest Tybalt to ever grace a production of Romeo and Juliet. I watched your play last night. It was great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I tried to look for you after the show, but I didn't see you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I went out with $ZOE and Kevin. Sorry, I know we haven't really been hanging out--
He shakes his head and puts a hand on her arm.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't have to apologize. Actually, I kind of get it. I wouldn't want to hang out with me either if you called me 'Sara'...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha. I said you were forgiven.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sometimes we forgive, but we're still hurting.
Sam looks down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's just... I don't want to be the runner-up. I don't want to be the girl that you turn to just because Sara isn't here.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know `exactly` what you're saying... But dealing with this... There isn't a manual. There isn't any hard and fast rule about how long I'm supposed to feel this intense sadness, about how long I'm supposed to love her, about how I feel for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what you're saying... But dealing with this... There isn't a manual. There isn't any hard and fast rule about how long I'm supposed to feel this intense sadness, about how long I'm supposed to love her, about how I feel for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You still love Sara?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes. Of course. And a part of me `always` will.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. Of course. And a part of me [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] will.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I have `new` feelings for you, Sam. How I feel about you now is different than how I felt for you before. Different from how I felt about Sara.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I have [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] feelings for you, Sam. How I feel about you now is different than how I felt for you before. Different from how I felt about Sara.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's not just that you make me happy when we're together... It's that I feel happy even when we're apart... Just thinking about you.
Sam gives him a small smile.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And contrary to what came out of my mouth, I don't confuse the two of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? You don't mistake me for some overly ambitious, sweet, `red-roses-winning` swimmer?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? You don't mistake me for some overly ambitious, sweet, [color=#3b78e2][i]red-roses-winning[/i][/color] swimmer?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, the red roses are because you're an awesome actress. But these...
From his backpack, he pulls out a copy of `Nightmare in Zombietown` and a small box of truffles from the chocolate shop they visited on Valentine's Day.
nodes.text_bbcode: From his backpack, he pulls out a copy of [b]Nightmare in Zombietown[/b] and a small box of truffles from the chocolate shop they visited on Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `These` are because I like you, and I want you to feel good about us.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]These[/i][/color] are because I like you, and I want you to feel good about us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw, Nick... It's like you do know me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're Sam... A girl who loves meat pizza, is `too` passionate about everything, and expresses her affection with punching.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're Sam... A girl who loves meat pizza, is [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] passionate about everything, and expresses her affection with punching.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're the one I want to be with.
Sam punches Nick's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know... And despite whatever messed up history you and I have together, I think we actually have a shot this time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You do? What changed your mind?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, it was Romeo and Juliet that helped me out...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've had a lot to think about the play, and every time I watched it, I just kept wishing that they weren't such dumb idiots!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's a new interpretation...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, they just gave up! Why wouldn't you `fight` to be with the person you really want to be with?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, they just gave up! Why wouldn't you [color=#3b78e2][i]fight[/i][/color] to be with the person you really want to be with?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When you put it that way, they do seem like quitters...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is... I know we had a setback, but I'm not giving up on `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What I'm trying to say is... I know we had a setback, but I'm not giving up on [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Aw, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now come on, we're going to class.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But the bell doesn't ring for another twenty minutes...
She leans over and kisses him lightly on the lips.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't say anything about going to class to `study.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't say anything about going to class to [color=#3b78e2][i]study.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is one of those veiled metaphor things about how we're going to make out, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up, and come on already!
She takes his hand, and they leave the lunchroom, laughing.

nodes.text: `By a name, I know not how to tell thee who I am...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]By a name, I know not how to tell thee who I am...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `My name, dear saint, is hateful to myself, because it is an enemy to thee...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]My name, dear saint, is hateful to myself, because it is an enemy to thee...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Owen act out the rest of the scene, remembering all the lines and cues perfectly...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!
Owen can't stop his forward momentum! He takes $ZOE down in a near-tackle!
There's a fierce scuffling while $ZOE and Owen disentangle themselves. From her place backstage, Sam buries her face in her hands.
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Owen pop back up and start the scene over, their focus broken.
Owen lands practically on top of $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh!
Owen manages to catch himself before he trips over her! Righting himself, he launches into the correct line!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `By a name, I know not how to tell thee who I am...`

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `My name, dear saint, is hateful to myself, because it is an enemy to thee...`
$ZOE and Owen act out the rest of the scene, remembering all the lines and cues perfectly...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!
Owen can't stop his forward momentum! He takes $ZOE down in a near-tackle!
There's a fierce scuffling while $ZOE and Owen disentangle themselves. From her place backstage, Sam buries her face in her hands.
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Owen pop back up and start the scene over, their focus broken.
Paralyzed, $ZOE doesn't know what to do! She stays on the square!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Shall I hear more or shall I speak at this?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Shall I hear more or shall I speak at this?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `'Tis but thy name that is my enemy... Thou art thyself, though not a Montague...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]'Tis but thy name that is my enemy... Thou art thyself, though not a Montague...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE continues, each line coming to her bit by bit...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is much easier now... We're almost there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Romeo, doff thy name, and for that name which is no part of thee, take all myself...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo, doff thy name, and for that name which is no part of thee, take all myself...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `I take thee at thy word... Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized. Henceforth, I will never be Romeo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I take thee at thy word... Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized. Henceforth, I will never be Romeo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh shoot! Owen's supposed to leap onto the balcony with me! Am I even standing in the right place?
Mid-line, $ZOE glances down at the ground and sees she's standing on a `square`. There's a `circle` next to it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mid-line, $ZOE glances down at the ground and sees she's standing on a [b]square[/b]. There's a [b]circle[/b] next to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `What man art thou that thus bescreen'd in night so stumblest on my counsel?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What man art thou that thus bescreen'd in night so stumblest on my counsel?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen climbs to the top of the ladder and leaps over the fake balcony! $ZOE...
Owen gives $ZOE a shocked expression.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Capulet! I'll no longer be a Capulet! `
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Capulet! I'll no longer be a Capulet! [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `But, see? Nothing is in name... I can't remember my own!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But, see? Nothing is in name... I can't remember my own![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Some chuckles rise in the audience, and $ZOE flushes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `...Capulet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Capulet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, er... I'll no longer be a... Montague?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! wherefore art thou Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! wherefore art thou Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Or, if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love... And I'll no longer be a...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Or, if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love... And I'll no longer be a...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the name of Juliet's house?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ay me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ay me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `She speaks: O, speak again, bright angel! For thou art as glorious to this night, being o'er my head...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]She speaks: O, speak again, bright angel! For thou art as glorious to this night, being o'er my head...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: For the next few minutes, everything goes smoothly until...
Owen opens his mouth to speak, but realizes she's said the wrong line.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, er... What?
$ZOE scrambles to think of a way to save the script.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Pay me no more mind, cruel Fate... You sent him. That is punishment enough for poor me...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Pay me no more mind, cruel Fate... You sent him. That is punishment enough for poor me...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen nods and continues on. For the next few minutes, everything goes fairly smoothly until...
$ZOE blanks on her line!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, er... `Pay me?`
As people file out of the auditorium, $ZOE and Sam stare at one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So much for nothing going wrong...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... `What are we going to DO?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE... [color=#3b78e2][i]What are we going to DO?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Finally having reached Twin Branches, Paige searches frantically for the auditorium...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Where is that stupid building?!
When she runs across the lawn, she catches her reflection in a fountain on the school's quad... And stops short.
Brambles are sticking out of her hair at odd angles, trails of mud coat her arms and dress, and she's still barefoot...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of all the times to see Owen... It's right now! Definitely not my best moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But at least Owen won't care! He's used to rags... It's basically what he wears anyway!
She smiles at the thought as she turns around a corner and spots some bright red lights on the other side of the football field. The auditorium is right next to them!
She runs towards it...
Backstage, $ZOE, Sam, and Emily dig Ben out of the ruins of the stage set.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! Cough! Ben! Cough, cough!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Over here! Cough!
They lift a beam that's fallen on him and try to help him up. Ben tries to stand, but falls back to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhh!` That `hurts!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhhhhhhhh![/i][/color] That [color=#e23b3b][i]hurts![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cough... Ben! What's the matter?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know. My leg... I'm sure I'll be okay in a sec. I just need to walk it off...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Walking` is the last thing you should do, Ben! Cough... You need to stay off that leg until we can get it x-rayed...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Walking[/i][/color] is the last thing you should do, Ben! Cough... You need to stay off that leg until we can get it x-rayed...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It could be... `Cough...` Broken!
nodes.text_bbcode: It could be... [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough...[/i][/color] Broken!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Broken?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stay down, Ben... I'm calling an ambulance!
She runs off, dialing the number, while Emily hovers over Ben.
A few minutes later, $ZOE comes back with Coach Kessler and an EMT on her heels.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Ben, your ride is here. Emily, we're following him. Get in the car.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But the, `cough,` play... I should, `cough,` stay...
nodes.text_bbcode: But the, [color=#3b78e2][i]cough,[/i][/color] play... I should, [color=#3b78e2][i]cough,[/i][/color] stay...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: With that voice? I think not. You need to get checked out as well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's right, Emily... We'll think of something. You go now, okay?
As Coach Kessler, Ben, and Emily take their leave with the ambulance, $ZOE and Sam address Kevin and the rest of the actors.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So what's happening? The audience is getting restless. Are we calling the entire thing off?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! We can't! There's only one scene left...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's going to be kind of hard to win a Romeo and Juliet scholarship when you don't have a Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Owen `is` Ben's understudy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Owen [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] Ben's understudy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me? I... I'll need a minute to look at the script, but I... I know the part.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And Juliet?
$ZOE glances around, and her gaze lands on Kimi. Kimi shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... I want to, but I don't know the lines or where to stand. I'm breaking out just thinking about it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't suppose Hannah or Ashley is in the crowd, are they?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I remember Hannah saying that their drama group was going out to celebrate tonight. I don't think they're around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I don't know what to do then...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... Can we talk?
Sam pulls $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to hate this idea, but `you` have to be Juliet. You're the only one who knows the lines and cues!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to hate this idea, but [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] have to be Juliet. You're the only one who knows the lines and cues!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! No! I'm not going out there and... And `kissing` Owen!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! I'm not going out there and... And [color=#3b78e2][i]kissing[/i][/color] Owen!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have to! There is `no` one else! I know you and Owen have some unresolved stuff--
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to! There is [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] one else! I know you and Owen have some unresolved stuff--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's putting it mildly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to mention Owen has his heart set on Paige now! What if this kiss ends up meaning something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, please... The scholarship deadline's up. This is my last chance!
$ZOE nods grimly, and Sam announces the role changes to the cast.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Congratulations to our new Romeo and Juliet... Owen and $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE is Juliet? Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't forget where to stand! Juliet stands on `circles,` and Romeo stands on squares.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't forget where to stand! Juliet stands on [color=#3b78e2][i]circles,[/i][/color] and Romeo stands on squares.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now, you two! Go change!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Great. The production's starting in five minutes! Stand by!
Kevin hurries to organize the other actors into recreating the balcony scene with the stage sets that are left.
And a few minutes later, the show is nearly ready to go on! $ZOE and Owen stand nervously in the wings, waiting for Kevin to cue them on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is... Unexpected. Who would have thought that it'd be you and me doing the ending scene? Heh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. This gigantic, totally romantic scene...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...That totally depends on this emotionally charged kiss. No pressure.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I pity the fools who have to pull that off...
$ZOE looks over at Owen... And grins.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Us. I pity us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pity? I should think you'd be honored to stage kiss me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course I am... I just hope that we can... Pull it off. As well as Ben and Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, just think of the greatest kiss you've ever had...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Will do.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ten seconds to showtime!
$ZOE takes Owen's hand and squeezes it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Break a leg.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, but after tonight, I'm not sure that's good luck.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, well, good luck then.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You too.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And go!
$ZOE steps onstage as the new Juliet, perching on the 'balcony', a high platform on the stage. She looks down and feels her stomach turn from the height.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay... I just need to focus on the lines... I'm Juliet `Capulet,` and my first line is 'Ay me!'
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay... I just need to focus on the lines... I'm Juliet [color=#3b78e2][i]Capulet,[/i][/color] and my first line is 'Ay me!'

nodes.text: Owen enters from the other side as the new Romeo. He scales the ladder, stopping halfway to gaze at $ZOE.
Seeing $ZOE and Owen step onstage, a murmur goes through the audience, and for a second, $ZOE worries their appearance is unwelcome.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope they don't mind that we're not Ben and Emily...
But all her worries are replaced with sheer nervousness when Owen starts soliloquizing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `See, how she leans her cheek upon her hand!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `O, that I were a glove upon that hand... That I might touch her cheek.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]O, that I were a glove upon that hand... That I might touch her cheek.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, he's really good!
Owen stares at her, and $ZOE realizes it's her line!
$ZOE freezes, her feet rooted firmly to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I... Don't know what to do!
By now, whispers and hushed concerns are floating around the audience members...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Snap out of it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get the curtains! You're closest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right!
$ZOE adjusts the pulleys, closing the curtains on the stage.
The curtains shut, Kevin's voice picks up on the sound system in the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sorry about that, folks. The show will resume in a little bit. Please enjoy a short intermission in the lobby...
$ZOE freezes, her feet rooted firmly to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I... Don't know what to do!
By now, whispers and hushed concerns are floating around the audience members...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Snap out of it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get the curtains! You're closest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right!
$ZOE adjusts the pulleys, closing the curtains on the stage.
The curtains shut, Kevin's voice picks up on the sound system in the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sorry about that, folks. The show will resume in a little bit. Please enjoy a short intermission in the lobby...
Before the audience can register what's happened, $ZOE dives for the pulley, adjusting the gears so that the curtain falls, shielding the audience from the sight.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew! One crisis averted!
The curtains shut, Kevin's voice picks up on the sound system in the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: The show is going into a brief intermission. Please enjoy refreshments in the lobby...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But what are you doing here? You're supposed to be onstage! Right now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's why I'm here, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought I already did my last scene...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The play's out of order, remember? You're doing it again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know if that's right... But I can't let Samface down!
Spencer hurries out...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Tybalt! I'm coming!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Mwa ha ha ha...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mwa ha ha ha...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
Onstage, Ben climbs halfway up a ladder representing the ivy trellis of the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `But, soft! What light through yonder window breaks?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But, soft! What light through yonder window breaks?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `It is the east, and Juliet is the sun...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It is the east, and Juliet is the sun...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer rushes in, bumping into the ladder and throwing it off-balance!
The ladder pitches backwards! Ben leaps off, trying to make a grab for something, `anything`, and his hand closes on the wooden frame of a fake building.
nodes.text_bbcode: The ladder pitches backwards! Ben leaps off, trying to make a grab for something, [b]anything[/b], and his hand closes on the wooden frame of a fake building.

nodes.text: He catches it, but his momentum cracks the wood holding it together! The frame cracks ominously...
`HRRRKKK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]HRRRKKK![/b]

nodes.text: With one loud splinter, the entire set and Ben plunge to the ground, a fine dust encapsulating everyone on stage!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aghhhhhhhh!
Hearing Spencer's shouts, $ZOE and Sam come running out of the dressing room, just missing Andrew escaping into the audience.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What just happened?!
$ZOE sees the commotion onstage, and her eyes widen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
$ZOE looks for the pulleys that control the curtains. She...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you call yourself?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Erik`son`! Ha! That's what I meant. Ha ha. `Joke.` Heh.
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik[color=#e23b3b][i]son[/i][/color]! Ha! That's what I meant. Ha ha. [color=#e23b3b][i]Joke.[/i][/color] Heh.

nodes.text: Spencer glares at him... Then shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you call yourself?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Erik`son`! Ha! That's what I meant. Ha ha. `Joke.` Heh.
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik[color=#e23b3b][i]son[/i][/color]! Ha! That's what I meant. Ha ha. [color=#e23b3b][i]Joke.[/i][/color] Heh.

nodes.text: Spencer glares at him... Then shrugs.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Heh. Erik Ericson. What a stupid name, am I right?
Spencer shrugs.
Andrew stumbles!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Erik, uh... Uh... Erikface!
Thinking fast, Andrew grabs a brown cloak with `duct tape` on it from a costume rack and dons it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thinking fast, Andrew grabs a brown cloak with [b]duct tape[/b] on it from a costume rack and dons it.

nodes.text: And elsewhere...
Paige says good-bye to Grandma Betty and steps out of Owen's house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A play? Owen's in a play? This sucks! Of all the stupid nights for him not to be home, right where I want him.
Sucking in a deep breath, Paige turns onto a main road...
And runs as fast as she can towards Twin Branches...
You are now playing as Andrew.
Andrew watches the play with incredulity.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She is actually pulling the role reversal thing off! That shrew and her stupid troupe are actually managing to perform a half decent play!
He looks over at Ms. Macbeth who is watching the play intently, stopping to scribble notes.
Glancing at the paper, Andrew can make out words like 'wonderful' and 'splendid!' written in the column.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I didn't come this far to see her win!
Right before the play's final scene, Andrew sneaks out of his seat...
...And slips backstage. He hides behind a curtain as Sam and $ZOE pass by.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did great out there! The best female Tybalt there ever was.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! I'm just glad that Spencer came out at the right time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Honestly, he never did get the entire putting the play out of order idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... But so far so good. Nothing's gone wro--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say it, $ZOE!
They walk past Andrew's hiding place and into the dressing room. Andrew walks out and nearly runs into Spencer stabbing his swords into imaginary objects...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I have a feeling she'll be delayed by... Unforeseen circumstances.
Wes shoots $ZOE a quick wink before closing up another locker and disappearing around the corner.
$ZOE returns to the table as Emily and Kimi are talking...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So what's the story with you and Kevin? Is that happening?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I can sum it up for you... For the Spring Break Robo-Con, I'll be riding up to the convention center in his van with him!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And, if that weren't enough, the convention center is located in a hotel that overlooks Centerscore Beach!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, that all sounds serious!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's what I thought... Until I realized that he also offered rides to the entire Robotics Club!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm... Confused again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Story of my life, Em. Story of my life.
$ZOE sits down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where'd you go off to, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about that... I think I figured out how to get you to see Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `And` I've got a task we really need you for, Kimi!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] I've got a task we really need you for, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it has to happen tonight!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seriously. I'm not even going, but if I don't get details `now,` I will `walk` out of here on my broken leg!
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously. I'm not even going, but if I don't get details [color=#e23b3b][i]now,[/i][/color] I will [color=#e23b3b][i]walk[/i][/color] out of here on my broken leg!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right, sorry...
$ZOE leans in and tells the group her plan...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I understand how much that might appeal to you. Meet a new person, share some pastries, make a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds great! I'm good at all those things!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But you don't have time for courtship! The meeting takes place at 6:00 tonight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Well, what are we supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `Impersonate Abigail.` You're not really good at this kind of thinking, are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Impersonate Abigail.[/i][/color] You're not really good at this kind of thinking, are you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't consider it because it seems wrong...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Morally questionable, yes. Then again, how guilty are you feeling?
$ZOE mulls this over for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so, how does this work? If she's going to be there at 6:00, what good will it do to impersonate her?
Wes smiles.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Didn't know you had this shady kind of thinking in you...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm full of surprises.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Abigail and Whitford are supposed to meet at Monarch Prep at 6:00 tonight. Hope you come prepared.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... What about Abigail?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Still, you'd have to be `pretty` desperate to go further into debt with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Still, you'd have to be [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty[/i][/color] desperate to go further into debt with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no other way we could get the code.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Because there's no other factor at play here? Nothing you feel guilty about?
Wes bangs open another locker. $ZOE can't hide her feelings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, fine! Paige might have seen us kiss! And if I'm the one who drives the two of them apart...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't handle that...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Very well. In order to disable Monarch Prep's alarm system, you have to know the 5-digit keycode.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: For tonight only, that keycode is `88775.` After tonight, the code changes, and then I can't help you.
nodes.text_bbcode: For tonight only, that keycode is [color=#e23b3b][i]88775.[/i][/color] After tonight, the code changes, and then I can't help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where's the keypad?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's where things get mighty tricky. It's at the heart of a security center that Principal Whitford guards like a hawk's mother.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do we get past her?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `That` was not part of our deal.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was not part of our deal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it?! That's all you're giving me?! A five-digit code that expires in a few `hours?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it?! That's all you're giving me?! A five-digit code that expires in a few [color=#3b78e2][i]hours?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's all you `asked` for.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's all you [color=#e23b3b][i]asked[/i][/color] for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, what about schematics or spy equipment or a device that turns off all the power for a whole city block?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: An EMP bomb? You know I'm a high school student, not a military organization, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine... I guess I was just... Hoping for something more.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, look, you were honest with me about Owen, and I feel `almost` bad about tricking you for information on Autumn and Lindsay...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, look, you were honest with me about Owen, and I feel [color=#e23b3b][i]almost[/i][/color] bad about tricking you for information on Autumn and Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad my gullibility generated a near-emotion in you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A young girl named Abigail Weatherfrost who is interested in attending Monarch Prep is scheduled to meet with Principal Whitford in a few hours.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who would be crazy enough to `want` to go there?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who would be crazy enough to [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to go there?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Someone who doesn't know how much it's changed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? How can she help us?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: She's all kinds of rich. Given the school's current economic status, Whitford might actually jump through hoops to get on this girl's good side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're thinking...

options.label: We recruit her for our team!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure?
$ZOE remembers all the time she's spent with Owen...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He was there for me when I was trying to become Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I was there for him when he was trying to get a new start...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've been through `so` much together!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been through [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much together!

nodes.text: She looks at Wes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could I not have feelings for him after all this?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's something I don't know. After all, it's `your` heart.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's something I don't know. After all, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] heart.

nodes.text: Somewhere in $ZOE, she can feel that she's lying to herself.
She knows it's time to move on...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Friends?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I used to have feelings for him, but not anymore. Owen and I aren't really meant for each other.
Wes nods.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So, you're helping Owen out of friendship? Out of the kindness of your marshmallow-soft heart?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, it doesn't even matter, Kimi, because there's still Whitford... And the alarm system...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I want this to work, but it seems like it'll just be a waste of everyone's time.
From her vantage point, $ZOE can see Wes out in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I just had an idea... Wait here, guys, I'll be right back!
You are now playing as $ZOE...
$ZOE approaches Wes as he fiddles with the combination to a locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Wes...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: One second. Almost...
He spins the lock!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Got it!
He pops the locker open, quickly takes out a bright pink notebook, and closes the locker up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That notebook says 'Katie' on it! Is it yours?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Per our last conversation, it's probably best if you don't ask any questions.
Sidestepping casually, he bangs twice on another locker, and it opens right up.
Without hesitation, he deposits the bright pink notebook while simultaneously extracting a paper bag.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We can walk and talk here while I conduct business.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, um... I need your help. Again.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Otherwise, why would you be talking to me, right?
Another locker pops open, and Wes stuffs a roll of ten dollar bills inside.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You didn't see anything, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to know how to disable the alarm system for the Monarch Prep Detention Center.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: An expensive and difficult request. But since I like you so much, I'll offer you another deal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gee, thanks. What's the cost? Just my soul this time?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Slightly less steep: one more favor, plus information.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I want to know who you think the next Head Cheerleader is going to be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is this about getting revenge on Lindsay for destroying Autumn's camera?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Questions. Questions. Questions.
Wes moves down and enters the combination for another locker.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oops! This one's yours!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Sorry... While it's open, you need anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Stay out of there!
Wes closes it, a delighted smile on his face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. If I `had` to guess, and it would be a total guess, I'd say the next Head Cheerleader will be Lindsay.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. If I [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to guess, and it would be a total guess, I'd say the next Head Cheerleader will be Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's the most like all the former Head Cheerleaders... Paula, Taylor, and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Does this mean we have a deal?
He extends a hand. $ZOE sighs, looking back at Owen in the cafeteria... Then, she shakes Wes's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Deal. A favor to be named later...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Plus?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Information, as discussed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I just `gave` you information!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I just [color=#3b78e2][i]gave[/i][/color] you information!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Exactly. You `gave` it to me. Which I appreciated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly. You [color=#e23b3b][i]gave[/i][/color] it to me. Which I appreciated.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You snake! You tricked me!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Guilty as charged. Do we have a deal or not?
$ZOE grits her teeth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. Information. But nothing `too` personal or creepy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Information. But nothing [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] personal or creepy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to give you details about the girls' locker room!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What you must think of me... Anyway... Information first.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You're asking me to disable the alarm system so Owen can go see Paige. I'm assuming, but I always assume correctly.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That basically means that once again you're helping Owen get closer to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Do you still have feelings for him?
$ZOE thinks about her stage-kiss with Owen, how the only way she could make it feel passionate was by thinking of Howard...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.prompt: Do you still have feelings for Owen?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you still have feelings for Owen?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yet? Like I'm going to be hanging around you `more?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yet? Like I'm going to be hanging around you [color=#3b78e2][i]more?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... If you want?
Emily nudges Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Easy there, stalker.
Kimi takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, you're `so` right. You just don't know my repertoire of skills!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] right. You just don't know my repertoire of skills!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, `I` do! Fashion, singing, and you're pretty handy with computers!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] do! Fashion, singing, and you're pretty handy with computers!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All perfect for a heist...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just impressed that you used the word repertoire!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, we just established that, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen, you're a football and basketball stud.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ben, you're like this nerd, jock, `everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben, you're like this nerd, jock, [color=#3b78e2][i]everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Emily, you're a swimming goddess!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're like Miss Perfect! And I don't mean that as an insult! It's true!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So that just leaves me... The `nothing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So that just leaves me... The [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, that's not true.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you can act, right?
Both $ZOE and Emily shake their heads furiously at Owen, but it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, as The Nurse! What a great role in `Romeo and Juliet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, as The Nurse! What a great role in [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo and Juliet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I'll just move on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good call, dude.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, we're helping you. What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure yet. Monarch Prep is a total fortress. I just know we have to figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I would give `anything` just to see Paige... Just to be sure she's okay...
nodes.text_bbcode: I would give [color=#e23b3b][i]anything[/i][/color] just to see Paige... Just to be sure she's okay...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwwwwww!
The four at the Center Table turn to see Kimi gazing at Owen from a nearby table. She stiffens!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I said that out loud, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What are you doing? Come over here, Kimi!
Kimi takes a seat at the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't realize I was worthy enough to sit with you guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're assuming you're good for the $10 entry fee.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... What?
Emily whacks Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't try to take advantage of my friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That $10 was going toward your birthday present... But I guess now you're getting some socks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry for eavesdropping, guys.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can I just tell you something, Owen? I know `way` more than I should about you and Paige!
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I just tell you something, Owen? I know [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more than I should about you and Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've loved you guys ever since that psych project report you gave!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Plus, I totally squealed when I heard how you went on a Valentine's `outing` together!
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, I totally squealed when I heard how you went on a Valentine's [color=#3b78e2][i]outing[/i][/color] together!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How did you know about our Valentine's Day? And you're a freshman! You're not even in Psych!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... Never mind, never mind! You were saying something about a fortress!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, first, there's a security guard who patrols the Monarch Prep grounds...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's like a cross between a giant and a ninja because he's everywhere at once.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does anyone else want to see `Ninja Giant` turned into a movie?
nodes.text_bbcode: Does anyone else want to see [color=#e23b3b][i]Ninja Giant[/i][/color] turned into a movie?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if you're lucky enough to avoid detection from him, there's still Principal Whitford herself, who guards the main entrance...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's old and out-of-touch, but she's pretty skilled with a broom.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Did you say 'broom'? You're afraid of an old woman with a broom?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's all fun and games till she starts sweeping at your face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, even if you manage to avoid her, there's still the fact that the whole complex is rigged with alarms!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Once they go off, the spotlights find you, and that means the giant and the broom aren't far behind...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does anyone feel like we just entered a wacky children's book? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's no reason to despair! We can totally help!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! It'll be just like those heist movies!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... I'm assuming I can come along.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course you can! All of us bring something to the table! I'll be the driver!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Emily, you've got that whole athleticism thing going!
Emily nods, coughing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Cough!` I'll be fine. My doctor says I'm just not supposed to talk much.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough![/i][/color] I'll be fine. My doctor says I'm just not supposed to talk much.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can totally set up one of my patented Ben pranks! All I'll need is--
Ben excitedly twists in his wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! My leg! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Guess who's going to be resting instead of coming with us?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aww, man. I'm the one who stays back and hopes nothing goes wrong?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know you want to help, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I'll be the best guy who stays back `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'll be the best guy who stays back [color=#e23b3b][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily kisses Ben's head.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, Owen, you can use your knowledge of the campus to find Paige! And Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Well, you can... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't really do anything, can I?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not true, Kimi.

options.label: We just don't know you well enough yet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is `my`... Friend. She's not really any of yours.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color]... Friend. She's not really any of yours.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but we're `your` friends! And when your friend needs something, you help them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but we're [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] friends! And when your friend needs something, you help them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't ask you to do that, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we're not going to just sit around while you struggle over this!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Besides, haven't you already tried to break into Monarch Prep a bunch of times on your own?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least a half dozen times.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... It'd be pretty dumb to try again by yourself then, wouldn't it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Looks like you just got logic-crushed `by girls--`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! Looks like you just got logic-crushed [color=#e23b3b][i]by girls--[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily twists Ben's wheelchair just a notch, causing his broken leg to bend a hair.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Which is... `Ow...` Not at all unusual in these enlightened, modern times!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow...[/i][/color] Not at all unusual in these enlightened, modern times!

nodes.text: Emily puts the chair back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've tried to break into that place a bunch of times on my own, but most of my attempts failed pretty miserably.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Frankly, I could use the help!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, help is here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You sure? I mean, I know how most of you feel about Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Feelings aside, we all want `you` to be happy, Owen...
nodes.text_bbcode: Feelings aside, we all want [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] to be happy, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I second that.
Ben raises a hand.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I third it. Can you third something? Because that's what I'm doing.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Say, is it getting hot in here? Or is that just my malfunctioning fan?

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Get it? Because that was not a joke.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E. says that when its internal temperature rises...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is that bad?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With the competition coming up so soon... It's a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can't you fix it?
The nerds look at each other grimly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We can, but probably not by the time Robo-Con starts. None of us are that skilled.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Maybe I won't be hoisting that trophy after all...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Let's at least test the motor functionality before it overheats.
Meanwhile, out in the hall, Emily rolls Ben along in a wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've been a chemistry nerd, a basketball captain, and an actor...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't think I can handle being an... I don't want to say `invalid,` but...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't think I can handle being an... I don't want to say [color=#e23b3b][i]invalid,[/i][/color] but...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You broke your leg, Ben. It happens. The doctor says you'll be back on your feet in... `Cough`... No time.
nodes.text_bbcode: You broke your leg, Ben. It happens. The doctor says you'll be back on your feet in... [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough[/i][/color]... No time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah, should you be talking?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: A little bit's okay...
Emily stops the wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Did you hear something?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... Besides your melodious voice?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Seriously. Shh...
`FWOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]FWOOM![/b]

nodes.text: Suddenly the door of the robotics club flies off its hinges! A robot scurries out, chattering as it skitters off down the hall!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Cow. Cow. Cow.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's correct. Weird that it repeats it, though.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Probably just a small error in the code.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Of course. Easy question.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's not even close.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Maybe I spent too much time giving it a personality...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, well, I guess there are bound to be a few glitches.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My butt?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hahaha! I `might` have made some late-night code changes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hahaha! I [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] have made some late-night code changes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Very funny, Kevin.
Dex and Kimi try to hide their snickers.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Butt. Butt. Butt.
The nerds all laugh.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Repeating must be a small glitch...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Or a big butt!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.title: Owen's Eleven
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen get close to Paige?

nodes.text: In the robotics room, the nerds (and Kimi) are huddled around a metallic mass of legs, joints, wires, and sensors.
Brendan, a senior nerd, holds up a beaker of sparkling apple cider. The rest follow suit, raising beakers of their own.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E. the robot is at long last ready to power on!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It must feel good. After all, you've been working on this project so much, it feels like we haven't seen you in forever!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Except in here, of course!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We're going to smoke the competition at Robo-Con over Spring Break! I can't wait to hoist the 1st place trophy over my head!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...I should probably start doing push ups.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's not get too cocky, fellas! After all, if you fly too close to the sun, you'll burn your hot dog buns!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Greek mythology sounds a lot weirder coming from you, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I'm just nervous... I feel like I'm t-t-tingling!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not your nerves! Your hand is brushing against an exposed wire!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Th-th-that explains everything!
Erik twitches involuntarily as he steps away from the wire.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I'll be in the nurse's office, boys! Let me know how it goes!
He wobbles out of the room! The nerds return their attention to the robot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What part of L.Y.L.E. did you work on, Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Special effects! Hey, you want to turn it on with me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure!
Kevin puts his hand on the switch, and Kimi puts her hand on top of his.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me be a part of--

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We should `all` turn it on together!
nodes.text_bbcode: We should [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] turn it on together!

nodes.text: Soon, all the nerds have their hand on the switch.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Something special.
They flip the switch! The robot vibrates and hums and slowly begins to glow a bright green color.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, is it radioactive?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Nah. I added the color just 'cause it looks cool!
Suddenly, a monitor at the head of the robot swivels around!
You are now playing as L.Y.L.E...

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: I am L.Y.L.E. Reporting for duty.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sweet! It works!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's test the general knowledge feature first!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E... What animal has four legs and goes `'Moooooooooo'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: L.Y.L.E... What animal has four legs and goes [color=#e23b3b][i]'Moooooooooo'?![/i][/color]

nodes.prompt: What has four legs and goes 'Moo'?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What has four legs and goes 'Moo'?

nodes.text: A light tapping on the open security room door breaks Kimi's concentration.
Both she and Whitford turn to see a well-to-do young lady standing in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Hullo. I'm Abigail Weatherfrost. I've an appointment this evening.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: I was calling from out there, but I don't think anyone heard me over the sound of the alarm. Is everything all right?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What did you say your name was?!

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Abigail Weatherfrost. I'm sorry for being so late. It's just that all the power in our home went off and then none of our cars would start.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Terrible bother flagging down a limo at this hour.
Principal Whitford pushes Kimi aside, staring at the console, taking in the disabled security system...
And then Owen, traversing the dorm building!
She whirls on Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You!
Whitford grabs Kimi, hauling her past the real Abigail and out of the security room!
As they pass the PA system, Whitford grabs it and hails Brock!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, Owen! I did the best I could...
You are now playing as Owen...
Balanced on a ledge of the dorm building, Owen inches toward the last window...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is it. If she's not in this room, she's not here!
He peeks in. Sitting on the bed, talking to a redhead, is Paige!
Owen's heart feels like it's exploding in his chest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I'm actually about to talk to her!
He tries to pry open the window, but he can only open it a smidge, just enough to hear the girls talking!
Their voices are almost drowned out by music coming from a stereo system.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Jessica doesn't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But she's `so` manipulative.
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] manipulative.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't think I can get more cute, rich boys than her?!
Owen pauses, shocked for just a second.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cute, rich boys?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll give you that she's manipulative, but she's not even that rich.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If you beat her, Whitford will totally let you go to the Debutante Dance for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's... Great news.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The hotel overlooks Centerscore Beach!
Owen is just about to call out to Paige when...

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Catch. Boy!
Brock manages to grab Owen's leg and pull him down from the building!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A moment later, Whitford watches as Brock tosses Owen and Kimi off of the Monarch Prep grounds!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: If I see either of you again, I won't give you the luxury of being thrown out! Instead, I'll call the police!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And I'll make sure you end up in jail! Do you understand me?
Owen gets up and pulls Kimi to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We get it. Don't worry... We won't be back.
Owen and Kimi walk away from the grounds and out onto the street toward their rendezvous point with $ZOE and Emily.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen... I tried to buy you as much time as I could... Did you get to see Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did. But not for very long.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess you didn't get to say what you wanted?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I didn't get to say `anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't get to say [color=#e23b3b][i]anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I did overhear something!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know where Paige is going to be for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Where?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A hotel near Centerscore Beach! And I'm going to be there too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? Eeep! So... That means...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That means the mission was a success! I couldn't thank you enough, Kimi!
Kimi beams.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't have to be modest.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, it was awesome! `I` was awesome! It was like the greatest performance I've ever given in my life!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, it was awesome! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was awesome! It was like the greatest performance I've ever given in my life!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Only no one was there to see it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I might not have been there, but you were a pretty important piece in getting that information.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. So seriously... Thank you!
Owen gives Kimi a big hug!
A moment later, Owen and Kimi are riding back home in $ZOE's car...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So then Whitford was all, like, 'How do you know this building is the security building?!'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! What'd you do?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even remember! But whatever I did, I got in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What'd you think of the guard, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, yeah! Thanks for telling me he runs faster than a nervous gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I was so freaked out when I first saw how big he was... I'm just glad I remembered not to step on the grass!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You won't even believe what I had to deal with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This elderly lady just `had` to be in the middle of the road `right` when Emily needed me most!
nodes.text_bbcode: This elderly lady just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to be in the middle of the road [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] when Emily needed me most!

nodes.text: As the group laughs and shares their moments...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to say, 'thank you.' I couldn't have done this without your help.
The girls let out a collective `Awwww!` as the car heads closer and closer to home.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girls let out a collective [b]Awwww![/b] as the car heads closer and closer to home.

nodes.text: All Owen can think about is that he's one step closer to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All I have to do now is find her during Spring Break!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 5: Owen's Eleven!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 5: Owen's Eleven![/b]
