nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you accusing me of something?!
The suspicious look fades from Whitford's face and is immediately replaced with regret...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm... I'm so sorry, dear. I thought that with this curfew violation and your behavior...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, it's been a rough evening! Please forgive me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll consider it, especially if you consider grabbing a bite somewhere nearby.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I... I would.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are there any local eateries that cater to my sophisticated palate?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well...
As Whitford struggles to list restaurants in the surrounding area, Kimi silently praises herself.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Way to stall, Kimi Chen!
Finally, Whitford runs out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That last one sounds permissible. I'm sure you have a driver for just such an--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...
Kimi says the first thing that comes to mind!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eunice Hogbottom!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't have much time!
Kimi flips open a panel and stares at the keypad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What was the code?!
Kimi enters the code into the keypad, but the light for the dorm building alarm doesn't go out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um... Hello? I `thought` that's what it was...
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... Hello? I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] that's what it was...

nodes.text: She tries again, but it doesn't work!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you serious?! No, I did `not` forget the password!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious?! No, I did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] forget the password!

nodes.text: She holds her hands against her temples!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `What` is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What[/i][/color] is it?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The password is 88775.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, I...
Kimi looks over and sees Whitford standing there menacingly, broom in hand and a loathing scowl on her face.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You'd better come with me, impostor!
Kimi sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am...
As Whitford roughly escorts Kimi out of the building, she knows without a doubt that...
Kimi enters the code. A second later, the light for the dorm building alarm goes out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes!
As Kimi heads out of the room, she takes out her phone and types out a text to Owen!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeep! It's like I'm helping my two favorites characters in a story get together!
Whitford blocks the doorway just as Kimi hits 'Send' on her phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You brought up a good point about further escapes... If you don't mind, I'd like to continue our interview in here, where I can keep my eye on `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You brought up a good point about further escapes... If you don't mind, I'd like to continue our interview in here, where I can keep my eye on [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've gotta stall! Whitford's going to see Owen on the monitors at any moment!
Near the dorm building, Owen's phone beeps quietly in his hideout spot deep within the bushes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hope there's good news in this text, Kimi...
He looks at it.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: scrty dis8bld! go 4 it! p.s. i think u n paige r sooooooooo cute!!!!1!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do I suddenly feel like I have a fan club?!
Owen emerges from the bushes and approaches the corner of the dorm building. He reaches his hand out... And touches it!
`Silence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Silence.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice job, angels!
Owen shimmies up the corner of the building, using a column to assist his climb to the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige's room has got to be here somewhere!
He shimmies along a narrow ledge on the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't look down!
In the first window, a girl sings a sad song by herself.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: { Nobody knows... The trouble I see! {

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's sad...
He keeps moving along the ledge...
In the next window, a crying girl is comforted by another!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It's going to be okay, Caroline! This place is hard on all of us! You'll see your family soon...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: But I miss my yacht, too!
A sudden gust of wind nearly knocks Owen over! But he manages to hang on!
He looks up along the row of windows and realizes...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There must be thirty more rooms!
Owen starts shimmying along the ledge as fast as he can!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hope you can stall Whitford just a little bit more, Kimi!
Meanwhile, back in the security room, Kimi's attempts to stall Whitford are wearing thin!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I appreciate the arts as much as the next headmaster, but you'll have to forgive me!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I am not in the mood to hear every line from Romeo and Juliet at the moment!
Whitford gets up from the chair Kimi has placed her in! Kimi leaps in her way, blocking her view of the video monitor!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're not feeling a bit peckish, are you? I could really go for a Cowboy Burger.
A look of suspicion comes over Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shoot! Rich people don't go to Cowboy Burger!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Tell me... What was your name again? It's so interesting.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My name? You mean...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I do what `I` want!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do what [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why are you so insistent on remaining in this room?
Whitford's eyebrow raises.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: There's something peculiar about you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It must be my family's natural charisma shining through me! You do remember that my family's rich, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes... Something you seem to be reminding me of often.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Too much, Kimi!
The sound of the alarm grabs Whitford's attention!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Fine! Have it your way! But I `will` be back soon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! Have it your way! But I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] be back soon!

nodes.text: She angrily storms out! Kimi can hear her on a PA system in the next room, hailing Brock.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I want to be in the safest place possible! Who knows how many others are planning to get in or out?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A `fair` point, I guess... You may stay here. Don't touch anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]fair[/i][/color] point, I guess... You may stay here. Don't touch anything!

nodes.text: Whitford leaves in a rush! Kimi can hear her on a PA system in the next room, hailing Brock.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No! It's merely a small matter of funding! You saw how my guard nearly caught her!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Imagine if a dozen guards patrolled the grounds!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nice job, girls!
Kimi wipes away her smile and turns to Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Are you okay?! You look awful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm `never` doing this again. Just drive.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] doing this again. Just drive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Kimi has to be doing better than us, right?
When $ZOE reaches the west wall, Emily peeks out from behind a nearby bush and hops into the car!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm late, you wouldn't believe--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Go go go! He could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?!
All of a sudden, Brock leaps onto the hood of $ZOE's car!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE swerves, managing to toss Brock off the hood of her car but not before plowing into a mailbox!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My car!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Your car? What about me? I was in that bush for `way` too long!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your car? What about me? I was in that bush for [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too long!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry, Em!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Em!

nodes.text: $ZOE throws the car into reverse and heads away...
As $ZOE speeds off, she gives Emily a quick glance.
$ZOE hits the brakes, her car screeching to a halt a few yards from the crosswalk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She can't take `that` long, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: She can't take [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] long, right?

nodes.text: What seems like a hundred hours later...
At last, the lady scoots out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Finally...
$ZOE accelerates through the crosswalk...
$ZOE slams on the brakes, scrambles out of her car, and helps the elderly lady.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, ma'am! Let me help you!
$ZOE extends an arm for the lady, who takes it.

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Why, thank you! You sure are a nice one!
$ZOE picks up the pace.

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Whoo! Skedad! I haven't moved this fast since the East Humble County Pickle Race!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's nice!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Of course they weren't called pickles then! Back then, they were brine sausages!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh huh.
$ZOE moves just a little bit faster!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Then these slick, marketing, Uncle Sam types came in and tried to put the wool-eye on all of us!
The lady tries to demonstrate to $ZOE what 'the wool-eye' looks like.
They reach the far curb!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: You remember what we talked about!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will! Pickles! Brine sausages!
$ZOE races back to her car, hops in, and speeds off!
A split-second later, $ZOE reaches the west wall!
Emily manages to leap over just as a gargantuan hand reaches out to try to grab her, barely missing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was close!
Emily jumps into the car, and they speed off!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nice timing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$ZOE accelerates past the elderly lady, calling out of her window!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for cutting you off! I have to help a friend!
A second later, police lights flash in her rearview mirror!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
$ZOE pulls over and stops. Officer Monte gets out of his car and barrels over to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Disgusting! I've seen some shameful acts in my time as a superior enforcer of the law, but I have never `ever` seen something so disgraceful!
nodes.text_bbcode: Disgusting! I've seen some shameful acts in my time as a superior enforcer of the law, but I have never [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] seen something so disgraceful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Do `not` interrupt me, missy! I know what I saw! A blatant disregard for the infirm!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] interrupt me, missy! I know what I saw! A blatant disregard for the infirm!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Plus, let's not forget how you belligerized the victim as you passed her in your vehicle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Belligerized isn't a word!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your talk-backity attitude is noted! I suggest you remain `silent.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your talk-backity attitude is noted! I suggest you remain [color=#e23b3b][i]silent.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Em...
$ZOE keeps her mouth shut as Monte writes her up a ticket.
A few minutes later, $ZOE finally drives away from the intersection...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come [color=#3b78e2][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A sign along a fence in front of the wall reads `'ELECTRIFIED FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A sign along a fence in front of the wall reads [b]'ELECTRIFIED FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE'.[/b]

nodes.text: Distracted, Emily doesn't realize how close behind Brock is!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Got... You!
Brock lunges for Emily! She ducks under his massive arms, and his momentum carries him past her, nearly into the fence!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: No. Touch. Zap.
Emily takes out her phone, speed dialing $ZOE as she moves away from Brock!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE! Answer!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily! I heard the alarm! Where are you?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Change of plans! I'm heading for the west wall! Meet me there!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
As the sun sets, $ZOE flips on her headlights, puts her car in 'drive', and speeds off toward the west wall!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm coming, Em!
At the end of the road along the north wall, $ZOE comes to an intersection.
She rounds the turn, her tires screeching as they burn from the friction!
In a crosswalk a hundred yards ahead, an elderly lady with a walker scoots across the street painfully slow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you serious?

options.label: Hit the brakes and help the old lady!
Hit the gas and go around her!

nodes.text: Emily manages to hobble her way to the north wall...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's where $ZOE's waiting!
But she's completely disheartened when she gets there!
Halfway there, she realizes...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no, $ZOE's at the `north` wall!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no, $ZOE's at the [color=#3b78e2][i]north[/i][/color] wall!

nodes.text: As she tries to reverse directions, she trips! Sprawling out on the dirt and rocks!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! Ow!
Emily gets to her feet!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Can't turn back now!
Emily hesitates for just a second!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Get. Girl.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pick a direction, Emily!
She limps as fast as she can toward the west wall!
Halfway there, she realizes...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no, $ZOE's at the `north` wall!
As she tries to reverse directions, she trips! Sprawling out on the dirt and rocks!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! Ow!
Emily gets to her feet!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Can't turn back now!
Emily's legs pump furiously, carrying her swiftly to the north wall!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's where $ZOE's waiting!
But when she gets there, she stops dead in her tracks!
Halfway there, she realizes...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no, $ZOE's at the `north` wall!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no, $ZOE's at the [color=#3b78e2][i]north[/i][/color] wall!

nodes.text: As she tries to reverse directions, she trips! Sprawling out on the dirt and rocks!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! Ow!
Emily gets to her feet!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Can't turn back now!
Emily hesitates for just a second!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Get. Girl.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pick a direction, Emily!
She runs off toward the west wall!
Halfway there, she realizes...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no, $ZOE's at the `north` wall!
As she tries to reverse directions, she trips! Sprawling out on the dirt and rocks!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! Ow!
Emily gets to her feet!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Can't turn back now!
Emily sprints for the...
When she gets to the security building, she reaches out and slaps the building!
An alarm blares!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hope that helps you out, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!
Brock closes the gap on Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh oh!
When she runs by the security building, she avoids touching it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Setting off that alarm is the whole point of my mission!
She stops suddenly, twisting her ankle!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ow!
Hobbled, she returns to the building and slaps the wall, setting off the alarm!
Brock isn't far behind her!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!
Emily isn't sure what to do!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I probably `shouldn't` set off any alarms, right?
When she runs by the security building, she avoids touching it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Setting off that alarm is the whole point of my mission!
She stops suddenly, twisting her ankle!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ow!
Hobbled, she returns to the building and slaps the wall, setting off the alarm!
Brock isn't far behind her!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!
Emily turns and runs away from Brock...
Right onto the main lawn!
The automatic floodlight flashes in Emily's eyes, blinding her!
An alarm sounds!
Before she can even blink, Emily is tossed into a room inside Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Meet. Girl.
Brock slams the door shut. Emily turns and finds Paige sitting on the only bed in the room.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey... Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here? Did Brock catch you swimming in the lake or something?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here? Did Brock catch you swimming in the lake or something?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Actually... We came to rescue you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Looks like you did an `awesome` job!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Looks like you did an [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome[/i][/color] job!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you think it would make a difference if I told them I'm not enrolled here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `None` of us are enrolled here. Enjoy the back of the complaint line.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]None[/i][/color] of us are enrolled here. Enjoy the back of the complaint line.

nodes.text: Emily moves to sit on the bed, but Paige scoots over, filling the space.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If it makes you feel any better, my bed is a lot smaller than yours.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Where's my--
Paige gestures to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great. Glad I ruined my life trying to rescue someone incapable of gratitude...
As Emily tries to settle onto the floorboards of her new home, it's painfully clear...
Overwhelmed by Brock's massive size, Emily freezes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He's enormous!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl!
Emily can't fight the urge to cough anymore!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brock turns!
Emily dashes out of her hiding spot and sprints...
As the urge to cough builds again...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm going to cough soon, no matter how much I suppress the urge! Better get this over with!
Emily fights the urge to cough!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And third! Hop over the `north` wall! That's where $ZOE's waiting!
nodes.text_bbcode: And third! Hop over the [color=#3b78e2][i]north[/i][/color] wall! That's where $ZOE's waiting!

nodes.text: The coughing sensation returns, this time stronger than ever!
Emily manages to suppress her cough for a moment...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Phew! Second, trigger the alarm in the `security building!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Phew! Second, trigger the alarm in the [color=#3b78e2][i]security building![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The urge to cough swells again!
Near the bramble patch, Emily sees Kimi and Principal Whitford enter the security building.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: My turn...
She finishes putting on her Monarch Prep uniform, a collared shirt with a plaid skirt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Who wears this stuff? I look so--
Emily gives herself a once-over.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, I actually look really cute.
She takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is crazy! Here we go!
She sprints along the concrete edge that lines the main lawn, careful to avoid stepping on the grass.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Owen said sensors in the grass will trigger the `central alarm,` along with the floodlights!
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen said sensors in the grass will trigger the [color=#3b78e2][i]central alarm,[/i][/color] along with the floodlights!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I just want to trigger the `security building alarm...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I just want to trigger the [color=#3b78e2][i]security building alarm...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily puts her back to a wall, careful not to touch it, and peers around.
Brock, the giant guard, is standing watch about ten yards away, singing softly to himself.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: { Brock. Guard. School. {

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: { Brock. Get. Paid. {

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: { Brock. Go. Home. {

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: { Brock. Love. Family. {

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, he's no Shakespeare, but he's actually kind of sweet...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If it's possible to be sweet when you're three times the size of my dad!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Time to go over the plan...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: First... Sprint past Brock, distracting him away from the dorms... And away from Owen!
Emily suddenly feels a cough welling up in her throat!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no! I can't cough now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You `really` think I haven't done my research on the layout of this facility?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] think I haven't done my research on the layout of this facility?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, I--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you doubt my commitment, perhaps I should leave!
Kimi starts to walk away, but Whitford stops her!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm not doubting! I just--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe `preparatory` school isn't for me... I heard of a public school on the other side of town that might be interested in a large donation...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]preparatory[/i][/color] school isn't for me... I heard of a public school on the other side of town that might be interested in a large donation...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Twin Branches High?! No, you mustn't go there! Boys and girls do `everything` together there!
nodes.text_bbcode: Twin Branches High?! No, you mustn't go there! Boys and girls do [color=#3b78e2][i]everything[/i][/color] together there!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I apologize if I offended you! Of course you did your research! It was just a silly mistake!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: One that won't happen again?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Heavens, no!
And with that, Whitford opens the door to the security building and lets Kimi in!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! You're up, Em!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh oh! She's onto me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, this building `looks` like a security building!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, this building [color=#3b78e2][i]looks[/i][/color] like a security building!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What does a security building look like?
Kimi ignores the question.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Plus, it was just a lucky guess on my part.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think you might have gestured toward it, too?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I don't remember that, but I suppose I could be overly paranoid.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A quality I'm looking for in a principal!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paranoia?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Stupid!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes, of course!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: For only when we're paranoid do we suspect what no one else dares to.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A lovely quote.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A Kimi, on-the-spot original!
Whitford nods, grumbling.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Come this way.
And with that, Whitford opens the door to the security building and lets Kimi in!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Phew! Not my best, but still in. You're up, Em!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I... I admit that things around here have gotten quite strict, but all for good reason!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So the rumors `are` true! What possible reason could you have for treating innocent girls this way?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So the rumors [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] true! What possible reason could you have for treating innocent girls this way?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: It's precisely their innocence that I'm trying to protect!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're going to have to explain that!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Come on, Kimi, figure out how to get inside...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You don't remember this, being so young, but there was a time when the world was a whole lot simpler!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: These girls are bombarded with conflicting messages about `what it means` to be a lady!
nodes.text_bbcode: These girls are bombarded with conflicting messages about [color=#3b78e2][i]what it means[/i][/color] to be a lady!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: So many of them have lost their way, and I'm their guiding light, bringing them back from the brink!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wow. She actually believes this crap.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know what it is about you, Principal Whitford, but I find your point of view compelling.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: However, I'm sure you can understand that I'm very particular about the institution I attend...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not only will I be paying for all of my room, board, and education up front, but I want to become `invested` in my school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only will I be paying for all of my room, board, and education up front, but I want to become [color=#3b78e2][i]invested[/i][/color] in my school.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've got her on the line... Time to reel her in!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's important to give back to the community, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Of course! We have so many, ahem, volunteer programs here for precisely that purpose.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Excellent! And security? It's important that someone of my considerable wealth feel protected.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've heard you boast quite an impressive security system.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: State-of-the-art!
Kimi moves toward the door.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Show me! I don't want to commit to a school without knowing I'll be safe.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: From?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: From... Boys, of course. Nasty, immature, totally-not-hot-at-all boys.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Of couse! No trouble at all! You'll be really quite impressed with the--
Whitford stops suddenly, an eyebrow raised at Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: One moment... How did you know the security system was housed in `this` building?
nodes.text_bbcode: One moment... How did you know the security system was housed in [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] building?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because no one tells me how to talk! Do I need to remind you of my family's background?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No! No, not at all!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Good. Then you can start by addressing the rumors that this place has turned into some kind of prison!
Whitford gives Kimi a strange glare.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I guess I expected more attitude from someone as entitled as you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shoot! I'm supposed to be acting like Abigail! Not Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What about the rumors that this place has turned into some kind of prison?!
Several hours later, at Monarch Prep...
Nestled in some bushes near the dorm building, Owen hunkers down, camouflaged all in black.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just gotta be patient, wait for Kimi's signal, and then climb the building to Paige's room!
In her car, idling outside the campus walls, $ZOE double-checks her phone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Alarm's set. Emily should be here in... Ten minutes.
At the school's edge, just above a gnarly patch of brambles, Emily laces her shoes up tight...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ready when you are, Kimi.
And climbing up the steps of Monarch Prep is Kimi, wearing a fashionable dress and a pair of pearl earrings.
At the top, she approaches Principal Whitford, noting the broom that lays against the front door.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just remember your name, remember your name, remember your name!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Abigail Weatherfrost! It's a pleasure to finally meet you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, that was easy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `wish` I could say it was a pleasure meeting you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]wish[/i][/color] I could say it was a pleasure meeting you!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me?! No one talks to me that way!
She shoves the phone under the mattress and heads to sleep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to break easily... And Jessica `is` going down.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to break easily... And Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] going down.

nodes.text: Paige whips out the phone and dials Owen's number...
`Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: `Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: `Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: It goes to Owen's voicemail message.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've reached Owen! Please leave your name after the--
In the recording, the sound of the door opening and closing is heard in the background, then...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, hi! Your grandmother let me in. Are you ready to head out?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Let me just turn this phone off--
The recording cuts out abruptly, transitioning into an obnoxious `Beep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The recording cuts out abruptly, transitioning into an obnoxious [b]Beep![/b]

nodes.text: Paige hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was I even expecting?
Paige resists.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't need him, and I don't need to talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But she's `so` manipulative...
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] manipulative...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, I don't even remember `why` I'm knitting her this quilt, but I can't bring myself to stop!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I don't even remember [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] I'm knitting her this quilt, but I can't bring myself to stop!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't think I can get more cute, rich boys than her?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll give you that she's manipulative, but so am I. She's nothing. She's not even that rich.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, if you beat her, Whitford will have to let you go to the Debutante Dance for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's great!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The hotel overlooks Centerscore Beach!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, Centerscore...
For a second, Paige thinks of `him...`
nodes.text_bbcode: For a second, Paige thinks of [b]him...[/b]

nodes.text: But then she remembers where she is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The beach is going to be so much more amazing without Jessica!
Prissy and Penelope chatter on about how fantastic their Spring Break trip is going to be...
While Paige broods.
Later, when Paige is alone in her room...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm certainly not in this competition to see `him`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm certainly not in this competition to see [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: She suddenly thinks of Owen smiling down at her...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here you go.
Owen hands Paige the flowers.
For a second, she grips the phone in her pocket. It'd be so easy to dial Owen's number and talk to him...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Focused like you were the last month? Or what about tonight?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You had no idea what a Perfect was until dinner...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Prissy, I can handle her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've done something Jessica has never figured out how to do.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that makes me smarter than she is.
Paige hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... I'm more focused?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Better make way at the top... Or else it's going to get awfully crowded.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know, we can drag this out over several months, curry favors, set each other up...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But there's a much easier way to settle this. The Emerald Ball's just about the `perfect` time for us girls to show off our `Monarch Prep values`, don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: But there's a much easier way to settle this. The Emerald Ball's just about the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] time for us girls to show off our [color=#3b78e2][i]Monarch Prep values[/i][/color], don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Get to the point.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is that there will be guys at this Ball interested in girls like us. Why don't we let them decide who deserves to rule Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean a competition? Because if that's the case, you're going down.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Diamonds sparkle, and so do I. When I'm done, there won't be a guy there who isn't enchanted with me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So enough with the posturing... What's the wager?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Straight and simple. Whichever girl has the most guys on her side of the ballroom by the time Whitford makes the evening toast wins.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't say I haven't been looking forward to this moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I suppose you'll be wanting this back.
Paige flashes her the phone, but Jessica shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, sweetie. That's yours. I insist. From one friend...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: To another.
Later that night, Paige and her friends hang out in her room. On the floor, Prissy knits a large quilt while Paige and Penelope sprawl on the bed.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was very brave standing up to her...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Brave... Or stupid?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Maybe both!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Do you honestly think you can beat Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Jessica doesn't stand a chance...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's going to lose, and when she does, I'm going to be there to sweep everything out from under her. That means the boys, the school, and her `stupid` title.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's going to lose, and when she does, I'm going to be there to sweep everything out from under her. That means the boys, the school, and her [color=#3b78e2][i]stupid[/i][/color] title.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because there's one thing I definitely have over her...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he would. He already did.
Paige is surprised to find out that Jessica's words sting now just as much as they did in her dream.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He can't break up with me. We were never together to begin with. And however you interpret it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen's behind me now. I have something more important to focus on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Your` spot.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Your[/i][/color] spot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen was a fine distraction while I was at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, come on, he's hot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't doubt that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But looking at him now, he's also easily distracted, and the only pitiful thing I've done is waited this long to figure it out.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I deserve the best...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what I'm going for is your position.
Off-balance, Paige struggles to think of something to say.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen would never do that to me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you `have` changed after being out there in the big, bad world, haven't you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] changed after being out there in the big, bad world, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So tell me... Did you find him? You know, the guy you're totes crushing on?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I found him all right.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now you're back. You know, escaping from this facility, even just for a few hours, gives you a lot of credibility...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So I'll extend my original offer. You can be my friend...
She produces a phone, and Paige knows in her gut that `this` one works.
nodes.text_bbcode: She produces a phone, and Paige knows in her gut that [b]this[/b] one works.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...And I'll be yours.
Paige takes the phone and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Jessica. I'll take it... As tribute.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As `tribute?`
nodes.text_bbcode: As [color=#3b78e2][i]tribute?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. You know, like a gift from a servant to her leader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's just say that there's been a change of plans... And there's a new queen of Monarch Prep now.
Jessica sinks back in her plush chair, her arms crossed.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, this is rich. Richer than all of the girls here put together.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're challenging me? You have no idea what you're getting yourself into. You've had your head stuck in the clouds about Owen, and you don't know the rules of the game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `Perfect`, and there's nothing you can do to cross me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color], and there's nothing you can do to cross me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Perfect'? Please. Get over yourself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what I thought. You have no idea, do you? I'm `the` Perfect. That's a title I earned here at Monarch Prep, and that means I have power and perks. Power you don't know anything about.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I thought. You have no idea, do you? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] Perfect. That's a title I earned here at Monarch Prep, and that means I have power and perks. Power you don't know anything about.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So 'Perfect' is like what? A British school `prefect?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So 'Perfect' is like what? A British school [color=#3b78e2][i]prefect?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure. Only way more `perfect`, obviously.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure. Only way more [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color], obviously.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is, don't cross me. Because `I` decide who goes...
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is, don't cross me. Because [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] decide who goes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And who `stays.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And who [color=#3b78e2][i]stays.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see...
Jessica points to the door as Whitford sweeps into the room and stands in front of all the girls, her hands clasped together.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Girls, I have an important announcement to make... The Emerald Ball is happening this weekend!
Excitement titters around the room, and Whitford raises a hand to quiet everyone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: As you know, the Emerald Ball is an event that brings together society's brightest gems from the country's most distinguished schools.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Members from the school board and gentleman from other schools will be there to evaluate you, so this is an opportunity for every lady here to demonstrate good behavior.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Those of you who do particularly well will earn the opportunity to enjoy another event down the line... Which I'm sure your `Perfect` will explain in more depth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Those of you who do particularly well will earn the opportunity to enjoy another event down the line... Which I'm sure your [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] will explain in more depth.

nodes.text: Whitford gestures to Jessica, who steps up with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Our dear Principal Whitford is talking about Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This year, two ladies who demonstrate the best Monarch Prep values at the Emerald Ball will get to travel, parents permitting, to an exclusive resort near Centerscore Beach to attend the famous Debutante Dance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As `Perfect,` I'll be helping Principal Whitford hand select the right ladies for the trip. So be good now!
nodes.text_bbcode: As [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect,[/i][/color] I'll be helping Principal Whitford hand select the right ladies for the trip. So be good now!

nodes.text: Jessica steps down and slides into the seat across from Paige as Whitford leaves the room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Has someone changed their mind about being nice to me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, but it's pretty clear that they're setting the bar low for perfection these days...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know what, Paige? I've tried to be nice to you. I invited you to my table, I invited you to my parties...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll just consider tonight as a mistake. You must be so tired after being locked up in isolation for eight hours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But mark my words... Monarch Prep is `mine`, and the Emerald Ball is where `I'm` going to shine.
nodes.text_bbcode: But mark my words... Monarch Prep is [color=#3b78e2][i]mine[/i][/color], and the Emerald Ball is where [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to shine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've become weak over some `boy` who's more interested in a goody-two-shoes Juliet than `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've become weak over some [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] who's more interested in a goody-two-shoes Juliet than [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Juliet'? How'd you find out about that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `Perfect.` I know things.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect.[/i][/color] I know things.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I know why you're going for this pitiful power play... It's because Owen's dumped you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen didn't `dump` me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]dump[/i][/color] me...

options.label: He would never do that to me.

nodes.text: Paige turns away from Jessica and sits with Prissy and Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige! You're back! Is what everyone's saying true? You did escape?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, I did.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So, if you escaped, why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I came back because Monarch Prep is my home. This is where I belong. And I'm not going to sit around anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jessica had better watch her back if she thinks she can be queen bee while I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, you're certainly not going to beat her by sitting with us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If you're going to challenge Jessica, you should do it face-to-face. Instead of being at Jessica's beck and call.
Prissy points to the center table where Jessica is beckoning Paige over.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: She's waving for you. You better get to her.
Paige gets up and heads to Jessica's table, moving slowly to spite her. When Paige finally sits down, Jessica grins.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There you are. I've been summoning you for forever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one `summons` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one [color=#3b78e2][i]summons[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, `feisty` Paige. This is fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, [color=#3b78e2][i]feisty[/i][/color] Paige. This is fun.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you think it's fun now, let's see how you feel at the end of the night.
Paige walks up to Jessica's table and casually takes a seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't recall extending an invitation...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, your memory must be working because you didn't. I invited myself.
For a second, Jessica just stares at Paige, trying to figure out the best way to respond...
Then she smiles.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well-played. I like you acting all feisty. You may sit here.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't really need your permission either.
Paige does one last extra push-up, rolls over, and starts doing sit-ups!
Hour eight.
By the time the dinner bell rings and her door opens, Paige is more than ready...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It all starts `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It all starts [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At dinner that evening, Paige pauses before entering the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right... If I'm going to rip the red carpet out from under Jessica's feet, I'll need to make a dramatic entrance...
Paige throws the doors open. They bang against the walls as she strides into the room confidently, her head held high. As soon as people notice her, whispers rise like a tide around her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And check that off my list.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Is that Paige? Where has she been?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I heard she was in isolation all day...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Well, people are saying that she escaped from Monarch...
As they chatter on, Paige searches the room for a place to sit.
On one side, she sees an empty seat next to Prissy and Penelope. In the center, she sees a seat at Jessica's table. Jessica smiles smugly at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, is it better to confront Jessica by sitting next to her or by ignoring her and pretending I don't care about her at all?
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not going to be good enough... Let's do that again!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`
Despite the pain, she crawls back into pushup position.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's do that again!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why is this so hard?! Okay... Five from the top!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford may not think I'm a society girl, and Jessica doesn't think I'm in charge...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, they don't know everything!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I `do` belong at Monarch Prep...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] belong at Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I can prove it by taking Jessica `down`...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I can prove it by taking Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]down[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When I'm through with her, she won't be asking for favors, getting her contraband, or having anyone at her beck and call...
As Paige thinks about how to topple Jessica, she trains. She gets down on the floor and does a...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... That's exactly it. I deserve better.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen's not interested in me... So there's nothing out there for me to do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Which means I'm supposed to be here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait, that seems wrong. If I don't belong here, I should try escaping...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But what would I escape to? Owen's not interested in me...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here is where I'm supposed to be!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... I, uh, think... Shoot, I forgot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe it's that I don't belong here?
Whitford regards Paige... And whatever she sees in Paige's eyes makes her nod her head.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I don't know exactly what you're after, Paige. But know this... You will be treated better when you prove to me that you've changed.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That means not trying to escape, blending in with the other girls, and behaving well at public functions...
Whitford sniffs.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm not certain you'll be able to redeem yourself fully... But you can certainly try.
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: At any rate, now that you're back, we'll have to give you a suitable punishment. You'll be kept in our isolation wing all day tomorrow from dawn until dinner.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You'll spend your time alone, eat your meals alone, and think completely alone until you grasp the severity of what you've done.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope your time in solitary will help you figure out how to behave like you belong.
Whitford turns and leaves. With a sympathetic look in his face, Brock opens the door and nudges Paige in.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Think. Hard.
Brock closes the door, leaving Paige in the lonely isolation wing of the Butterfly Detention Center.
In the darkness, alone, Paige curls up on her bed...
And sleeps.
The next morning, Paige wakes up to a bleak morning and an empty room. She hears nothing, and when she tries the door, it's locked.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, right. I'm in isolation... Dawn until dinnertime? That's only eight hours. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can last until dinner...
Hour one.
Paige taps her foot on the floor, paces the length of the room, and taps it again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is fine. I'm fine.
Hour two.
Paige flops on the floor and stares at the ceiling, trying to see shapes in it.
But frustratingly, all she can see is Owen...
...Kissing $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Arg!
Hour three.
On the bed, Paige closes her eyes, trying to rest... But $ZOE and Owen's kiss flashes through her head!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was exactly the same way he kissed `me` on `Valentine's Day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was exactly the same way he kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] on [color=#3b78e2][i]Valentine's Day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ugh!` He's `so` lame! He only has one move!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ugh![/i][/color] He's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] lame! He only has one move!

nodes.text: Hour four.
Paige is just frustrated enough to consider escaping again when a knock at the door startles her. She opens it to find Brock with a tray of food.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Here. Girl. Food.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Girl no `want` food, Brock. Girl wants out of solitary.
nodes.text_bbcode: Girl no [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] food, Brock. Girl wants out of solitary.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Can't. Help. Girl.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Help. Self.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Trust. Self. Girl.
Brock leaves her with the tray. She sniffs it, but it seems gray and unappealing. As the door closes behind him, Paige throws the tray away from her in disgust.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought you'd help me out, Brock! Remember, I helped you! I thought we had an understanding!
Hour five.
Paige stands in a lobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... This is the Twin Branches auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought I was at Monarch Prep... But I'm still here!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Unless I'm dreaming about being `here...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless I'm dreaming about being [color=#3b78e2][i]here...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She waits a moment for something strangely dreamlike to happen. But it doesn't.
Cautiously, she throws open the doors to the theater...
And walks in on $ZOE and Owen making out onstage!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aw, crap. This `is` a dream!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, crap. This [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a dream!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is it really?
Jessica appears next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, now it's mostly a nightmare.
Onstage, the kiss freezes, Owen's hands framing $ZOE's face... Jessica clucks her tongue.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't that sweet? While you're pining away over here at Monarch Prep, letting me run all over you, poorman whats-his-face moved on. Like you didn't mean a thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen wouldn't do that to me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he would. He already did. But it's okay to stay hung up on him. Because the longer you do, the longer this place is mine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Monarch Prep isn't yours...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's totes cute that you believe that! But haven't you been listening?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not a threat. I just told you that you won't be able to `redeem yourself fully` enough to be one.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not a threat. I just told you that you won't be able to [color=#3b78e2][i]redeem yourself fully[/i][/color] enough to be one.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't say that... That was Whitford.
She glares at Jessica... But Whitford is standing in her place!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're right, it was. And you won't be able to redeem yourself as long as you're hung up on Owen...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ah!
Paige wakes up, sharply and suddenly. She looks around the room, looking for any sign of Whitford or Jessica...
But she is alone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, even in my dreams Jessica and Whitford are annoying...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But they're right... I've been way too caught up with that two-timer Owen! Whitford doesn't think I can reform, and Jessica's been walking all over `my` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: But they're right... I've been way too caught up with that two-timer Owen! Whitford doesn't think I can reform, and Jessica's been walking all over [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I may have been distracted by Owen before... But not anymore!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If he wants to tongue wrestle with $ZOE, then I don't want anything to do with him...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if I were honest with myself, I'd say that...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You just came to that conclusion all on your own, did you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yes? It's like what you said when you found me at Twin Branches. You told me it was time to go home. I believe it now.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I don't believe that you've changed your mind just like that. Change is something you see in action.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A girl who `says` she's reformed must be planning something devious.
nodes.text_bbcode: A girl who [color=#3b78e2][i]says[/i][/color] she's reformed must be planning something devious.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm onto you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But it's true! Everything I want is here.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I left trying to find something, `someone`... But when I got to him, everything changed. And I realized that the outside world is not where I'm supposed to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I left trying to find something, [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color]... But when I got to him, everything changed. And I realized that the outside world is not where I'm supposed to be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a society girl, Principal Whitford. I have riches, I have resources, and I have power. That's what I was born to.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everything I want is right in here.
You are now playing as Paige.
Deep in the Butterfly Detention Center facility, Brock and Principal Whitford usher Paige down a long hallway.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back `willingly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back [color=#e23b3b][i]willingly.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brock looks down at her sadly.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: But. Girl. Run.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not like I have anywhere else to go...
They stop abruptly, pushing Paige in front of an imposing door.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, do you know where we are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In front of a door?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is our isolation room at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that you're in serious trouble. You've violated half a dozen school rules during your trip to the outside world.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And despite what your parents generously donate to our private paradise here, you won't be getting off unscathed. What do you say to that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I understand, Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What? No sarcastic remarks? No witty comments?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope you enjoyed that little taste of freedom because it's unlikely that you're going to see anything outside these gates in a long while.
Paige thinks of Owen holding $ZOE and pulling her close for that kiss... Paige balks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... `That's` something I never want to see again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] something I never want to see again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to be a problem from now on...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A likely story! What are you trying to pull?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Don't think that because you escaped once, you'll be able to escape a second time! This time around, I'll make sure that you don't make it past your dorm room door!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why not? Why should I trust you? What are you plotting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not plotting anything. It's just on the car ride back from Centerscore, I realized something...

options.label: There's nothing out there for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah? I'll join up with you soon... I think.
Preston walks off.
For the next hour, Paige works on flirting, cajoling, and bullying other boys onto her side of the room.
Paige even gets an ex-boyfriend to join her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Lee... At least let me get you to the dance floor so you can meet someone `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Lee... At least let me get you to the dance floor so you can meet someone [color=#3b78e2][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Well, when you put it like `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when you put it like [color=#e23b3b][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And of course, Paige recruits her friends!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I want to dance!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So tell me about this `Lee` guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: So tell me about this [color=#3b78e2][i]Lee[/i][/color] guy!

nodes.text: By the time Whitford stands up on the podium to make her toast, there's a raucous party over by the dance floor!
While on the other side of the ballroom...
Jessica stands by the food table alone, desperately trying to serve out hors d'oeuvres to get people to stay on her side.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Canape, anyone? Does any guy want a canape and some of those toast thingies?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, fine!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Any girl?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Eat that, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It seems the school has done you well.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I hardly recognize this girl anymore. It appears swatting with the silver spoon is much more effective than feeding with it.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I quite agree.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You may go on Spring Break with the school... But you're certain you don't want to spend your break with Tad and I on the East Coast?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for the invitation... But this Spring Break trip means attending the Debutante Ball.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh yes! I love the Debutante Ball! I met my first husband at that ball... Perhaps you'll find an eligible young gentleman while you're there...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Yes, indeed. Someone entirely unlike that ruffian boy in Centerscore. What was his name? Otis? Othello?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen... His name was Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not that it matters anymore. Don't worry, Mother, Tad...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll find someone who's worthy of my attention... Someone who wants `me... `
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll find someone who's worthy of my attention... Someone who wants [color=#3b78e2][i]me... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I promise.
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 6: Perfect Paige!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 6: Perfect Paige![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up?
`Season 4: Love and Basketball` is available in More Episodes now!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Season 4: Love and Basketball[/b] is available in More Episodes now!

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But the other girls--

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Will get along without you.
Margot and Tad get up in a huff. As the door closes behind them, Paige can feel her rising star falling fast...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's only a matter of time before someone else closes the gap I've left...
And in her heart, Paige knows...
She has failed.
