nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I knew it. You still have feelings for him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't--

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You can't even admit how beneath you he is. This is terribly disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'd been hoping to see more changes in you, Paige, but... It hasn't happened.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You can forget going to Centerscore Beach. In fact, I'll make certain that you don't leave the premises for the rest of the year.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I knew it. You still have feelings for him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't--

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You can't even admit how beneath you he is. This is terribly disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'd been hoping to see more changes in you, Paige, but... It hasn't happened.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You can forget going to Centerscore Beach. In fact, I'll make certain that you don't leave the premises for the rest of the year.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that `boy` was common...
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] was common...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he is, but I also think that you guys were wrong to send me here. This place is a joke, and it was a stupid move on your part.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige! You're being `rude.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]rude.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So rude that I don't think you'll be getting to attend that Spring Break trip after all...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We were?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes. Even though I was upset when you sent me away, the journey's been... Educational.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I belong here. I know that now.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that `boy` was common...
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] was common...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he is, but I also think that you guys were wrong to send me here. This place is a joke, and it was a stupid move on your part.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige! You're being `rude.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]rude.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So rude that I don't think you'll be getting to attend that Spring Break trip after all...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that `boy` was common...
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] was common...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he is, but I also think that you guys were wrong to send me here. This place is a joke, and it was a stupid move on your part.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige! You're being `rude.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]rude.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So rude that I don't think you'll be getting to attend that Spring Break trip after all...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that `boy` was common...
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? You just said that you thought that [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] was common...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he is, but I also think that you guys were wrong to send me here. This place is a joke, and it was a stupid move on your part.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige! You're being `rude.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]rude.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So rude that I don't think you'll be getting to attend that Spring Break trip after all...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You guys were wrong!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You really believe that? But you were so convinced--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That he was good for me? That he cared for me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I certainly don't think that anymore.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: She doesn't even sound sarcastic, Taddy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know this will be hard to believe coming from me, but...
Paige hesitates, unsure what to say.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen isn't horrid! He's... Just nice.
Paige takes a deep breath in and out before talking in a calm manner.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The school is hardly recreational. This Spring Break trip, though seemingly superfluous, is actually a conditioning exercise.
Tad seems surprised by Paige's response.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Is that really you, Paige? This well-spoken young lady? I can hardly believe it.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What's your angle then? This isn't an elaborate ruse to see that horrid `boy` again, is it?
nodes.text_bbcode: What's your angle then? This isn't an elaborate ruse to see that horrid [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] again, is it?

nodes.text: For the umpteenth time, Paige thinks of Owen's kiss with $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That boy is...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This place is a joke!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But this Spring Break trip is the one good thing about this place!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Yes, I'm sure it is. Unfortunately, you won't be getting to attend that Spring Break trip after all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I `won`, and no one's going to forget that.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]won[/i][/color], and no one's going to forget that.

nodes.text: Applause bursts around them as Whitford stops speaking. But Paige and Jessica aren't done.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did you seriously think I was going to roll over and let you take everything I've worked hard to build up here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think you've beaten me? Well, you haven't.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what are you going to do about it?
Jessica puts a pained expression on her face and waves her hand in the principal's direction.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Principal Whitford! Principal Whitford!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Jessica! What is the matter here? Young ladies do not yell like fishwives.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just found out that Paige has gotten her hands on some contraband!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? No! I--

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes, she was just bragging about using her `cell phone` to call her `boyfriend` in her room right under your nose!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, she was just bragging about using her [color=#3b78e2][i]cell phone[/i][/color] to call her [color=#3b78e2][i]boyfriend[/i][/color] in her room right under your nose!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, is this true?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Jessica's the one who--

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's blaming me to get out of trouble, Principal Whitford. You know she's always trying to escape.
Whitford glances from Paige to Jessica and nods.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Come with me at once. We're going to settle this matter once and for all!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal, there's nothing in my room, I swear!
But Whitford's got one hand on Paige's arm. Leading a small trail of curious girls, Whitford drags Paige all the way back to her room in the dorms.
Paige glares at Jessica who smiles at her wickedly.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, let's see it then. Where's the phone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's hiding it.
Jessica kicks over Paige's mattress...
And finds nothing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? I told you! Jessica's trying to set me up.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Clearly, it's `hidden.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Clearly, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]hidden.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods to one of the girls in her group, a meek girl named Amber. Amber discreetly dips her hand into her purse and uses her own contraband phone to call the phone that Jessica has given to Paige.
Somewhere, a phone buzzes incessantly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's here, Whitford! I can hear it!
Whitford stops to listen to its location...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: It's not in this room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's... It's not?
Whitford walks down the hall as the phone keeps buzzing. She stops in front of Jessica's room and gives the Perfect a stern look.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Why is the phone coming from your room?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I, uh... I don't know!
As Whitford uses her key on the door and opens it, Jessica glances at Paige... Who's smiling wickedly at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You are going to `pay` for th--
nodes.text_bbcode: You are going to [color=#3b78e2][i]pay[/i][/color] for th--

nodes.text: Whitford storms out of the room, holding the ringing cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What's the meaning of this, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whitford, I swear, it's not my phone!
Whitford glances down at it, examining the phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: If it isn't your phone, then why are there texts with your name on them addressed to... Ryan-licious?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why does he assume you're 'running off together to French so hard that we start wearing berets'?!
Whitford shows Jessica the screen, and Jessica sees a wall of texts sent by and to 'Jessica Blaire'...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But those are--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And if this isn't your phone, then what is `this?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if this isn't your phone, then what is [color=#3b78e2][i]this?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Whitford shows Jessica the back of the phone where the incriminating initials 'J.B.' are written in glitter across the back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, I... Er...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: These initials look familiar...
And suddenly Whitford's eyes narrow.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The speakers from the party the night that Paige left. Those were yours too, weren't they?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And to think of the horrors that poor Jane Brovlosky has endured in Deluxe Isolation due to your treachery!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Those were Jane's speakers! Why would I lie about that?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: To avoid getting stripped of your ranking and put into isolation?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Er, well, `yes,` that is a good reason. But I swear, Principal, those speakers aren't mine, and that phone definitely `isn't` mine!
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, well, [color=#3b78e2][i]yes,[/i][/color] that is a good reason. But I swear, Principal, those speakers aren't mine, and that phone definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] mine!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Somehow` I don't quite believe you...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Somehow[/i][/color] I don't quite believe you...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige... Girls... You may go. Little Miss `Perfect` and I need to have a chat...
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige... Girls... You may go. Little Miss [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] and I need to have a chat...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And it starts with taking away that title of yours... You've abused the system I've set up for you... And you no longer deserve to run it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No!
Jessica turns to run and rams straight into Brock!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. In. Trouble.
As Brock and Whitford haul Jessica off, the other girls crowd around Paige and cheer.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: She's gone!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You set her up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, she set `me` up. I just turned the tables.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, she set [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] up. I just turned the tables.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Paige is `in charge!` Woo!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#3b78e2][i]in charge![/i][/color] Woo!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah. Great. If you like switching one dictator in for another...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lighten up, Priss. Jealousy doesn't look good on you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or do you really feel like crossing the new `Perfect` of Monarch Prep?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or do you really feel like crossing the new [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] of Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You haven't earned it yet...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But I suppose I'm not going to put it past you.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's good to see you back to your normal self.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks... It's good to be back.
In the weeks that follow, things `do` change around Monarch Prep...
nodes.text_bbcode: In the weeks that follow, things [b]do[/b] change around Monarch Prep...

nodes.text: Jessica is dismissed from her position and becomes a regular student in the detention center...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: After asking the girls questions about the recent contraband in your room...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I was `shocked` to discover that you've been extorting supplies and blankets from them for weeks!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]shocked[/i][/color] to discover that you've been extorting supplies and blankets from them for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In addition to the time you'll be serving in isolation, you'll also be required to do community service...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! I can't... I'm not cut out for work...
Whitford looks to Brock.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Do. Push-ups. Now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not again...
And Paige wins the title of `Perfect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And Paige wins the title of [b]Perfect.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to say... `Perfect Paige` has a nice ring to it. Don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to say... [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect Paige[/i][/color] has a nice ring to it. Don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Panderer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Nothing!
And life at Monarch Prep becomes more bearable for Paige...
Until one day at lunch...
Principal Whitford calls Paige into her office.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal Whitford? You wanted to see me?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes. Perfect, I don't think I ever congratulated you on earning your title, did I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sure...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No, I didn't. Congratulations. You know, I had my doubts.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: When we recovered you from outside, Paige, I had some doubts about your true intentions... But with you here, I now see that you represent the finest that Monarch Prep has to offer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks. Is that all?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No. As Perfect, you get certain benefits associated with your position. And one of those benefits is getting to receive visitors...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm allowed to see people? From the outside?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So that's how Jessica's been in contact with the outside world...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Incidentally, you have a few visitors...
Whitford stands up and goes up to a door leading into a conference room.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But who's visiting `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But who's visiting [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige pauses just outside the door...
And flings it open!
Margot and Tad sit stiff-backed against plush velvet seats. They turn to Paige as she enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mom? Tad? I thought you guys were traveling in Italy.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We came back early.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It was far too Italian over there...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But what are you doing `here` at Monarch?
nodes.text_bbcode: But what are you doing [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] at Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Imagine our surprise to receive a voice message from Principal Whitford asking for our permission for you to leave Monarch Prep during Spring Break.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I was going to pen her a strongly worded letter to tell her that you were under no circumstances to leave the school...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But the principal also mentioned that you'd recently had the honor of becoming a school `Prefect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But the principal also mentioned that you'd recently had the honor of becoming a school [color=#e23b3b][i]Prefect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, the term is `Perfect,` Tad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, the term is [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect,[/i][/color] Tad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: 'Perfect'? That's a bit odd, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I think it's wonderful. And we just had to see for ourselves what had changed...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: If anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I'm going to keep my position at the top, I have to go on this trip... But how do I get my parents to go for it?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So tell us more about this Centerscore Beach trip. I thought we sent you to a disciplinary school, not a recreational one...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what? Why should I care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because I'll carry it until the day I graduate and then for years after!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'll be known forever as that girl who didn't keep her promises!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's fine! Go ahead and stay mad at me! I love it. I `relish` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's fine! Go ahead and stay mad at me! I love it. I [color=#3b78e2][i]relish[/i][/color] it.

nodes.text: Paige doesn't know what to say to that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The wind gone out of your yacht sails? Good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not done. I'm not the only one who'll resent you for tonight. Everyone else will too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because when it comes down to it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what? Why should I care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because everyone heard you issue that challenge to me at dinner a couple nights ago.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promised that we'd settle this tonight. And it's clear I've won.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: People don't like it when promises are broken.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It tends to make people think you're unreliable. They won't listen to you now, Jessica, and without them, you have no power.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Face it...
Whitford clears her throat on the stage.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen,to the eightieth anniversary of the Emerald Ball, the precursor to our famed Debutante Dance...
As Whitford prattles about school tradition in an attempt to impress the school board members, Jessica storms up to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There you are! I was wondering where you'd gone, `Jess.` Things are looking a little lonely on your side, aren't they?
nodes.text_bbcode: There you are! I was wondering where you'd gone, [color=#3b78e2][i]Jess.[/i][/color] Things are looking a little lonely on your side, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up. This proves nothing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It proves everything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's just too bad. You may have won this little display, but you can forget me handing anything over. I'm still Perfect, and I still run this school.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're going back on our deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can't really be that surprised.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not... But Jessica, you should know that...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Yes? I'll, uh, see you on the dance floor then? Maybe?
Preston walks off.
For the next hour, Paige tries unsuccessfully to get guys onto her side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee? Uh... Would you like to hang out... Somewhere near the dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Uh, sorry, Paige... I just don't think it's a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Setting aside our whole relationship history, you've been weirding everybody out.
With just a few minutes left to go, Paige realizes that all of the boys are on Jessica's side of the room!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Did I tell you about the `old` versus `gold` watch and my rich father?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I tell you about the [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] versus [color=#e23b3b][i]gold[/i][/color] watch and my rich father?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, no... `Do` tell... And have a canape while you're at it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, no... [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] tell... And have a canape while you're at it.

nodes.text: Desperately, Paige yells into the crowded ballroom...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Does anyone want to hang out on this side of the room?!
Even Paige's friends desert her...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Sorry, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: All the boys are on Jessica's side!
And by the time Whitford stands up on the podium to make her toast, something inside Paige deflates.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks a little lonely over there, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Want to join the real party over here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All you have to do is bring one of those speakers over here... As `tribute.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All you have to do is bring one of those speakers over here... As [color=#3b78e2][i]tribute.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With a heavy heart, Paige trudges to the speaker, knowing...
She has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: No! No! No!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I'm not an `astrologist!` Astrology is not a viable field of science, and I refuse to be lumped in with that hogwash!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not an [color=#e23b3b][i]astrologist![/i][/color] Astrology is not a viable field of science, and I refuse to be lumped in with that hogwash!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, uh, sorry? So what about that dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Is the Andromeda galaxy elliptical?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That's... That's right! I'm so... Surprised!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: By what?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Well, girls like you don't usually talk to, uh... Astronomists like myself. I don't exactly have that... `gravitational pull.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, girls like you don't usually talk to, uh... Astronomists like myself. I don't exactly have that... [color=#e23b3b][i]gravitational pull.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure you do. I want to hear more... On the dance floor. Will you be there?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Is Proxima Centauri 4.2 light-years away?
Paige blanks out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... An astrologist?
Paige looks to Preston.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And last but not least... The nerd...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Coming, Preston?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Dancing's not my thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not your thing? And what is?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Science is.
Paige looks him over and notices a star pin on his jacket lapel.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me guess. You study stars. You're an...
Carson gives her a smile that lets Paige know she's hit his weak point.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You like them?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cream wing-tipped oxfords with a handmade brass antique heel? That must have been a fortune. They're classic.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: A true connoisseur. I appreciate it. These shoes are my pride and joy... Along with the fourteen other pairs I have that are just like them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you know where I think they'd go best?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: On a dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that. I'll make my way over.
Carson heads away to Paige's side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're so... Brown.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Really? But brown is so... Common.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, did I say brown? I meant... Coppery. Copperish. Copper-colored?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Copper... As in the cheap metal that pennies are made of?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, it's a nice color, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I always thought of my eyes as a nice hazel color.
Paige can see she's hurt his feelings and tries to change the subject.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... I don't suppose you want to dance?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I spy with my `hazel` eye... Somewhere else to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I spy with my [color=#e23b3b][i]hazel[/i][/color] eye... Somewhere else to be.

nodes.text: Carson strides off.
Paige feels she's run out of time! She chooses the first thing that comes to mind...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nice what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice eyes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So I want to dance, but the floor's looking pretty lonely. I was hoping I could convince some of you to start the party...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you say?
Mark kisses Paige's hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, that's... An interesting move you got there. Nice hand kiss.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, thanks. I don't think anyone's said that before.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll be the first.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you know, you seem like a really nice guy.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Nice? Yeah, uh, great...
Paige can tell her compliments aren't working. Mark looks anywhere but at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Being nice isn't doing anything for me! This is why $ZOE sucks!
Paige tries to get his attention back.
Paige pulls her hand away from Mark. He kisses his own by accident!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, you're moving pretty fast there, ace. I don't know if you and I are at that level yet.
She turns to Preston and Carson.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'd better watch the mouth on this one...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha ha, man... She has your number.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh-huh... I appreciate a girl who plays hard-to-get.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know why guys always think that... But it's making this `way` easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why guys always think that... But it's making this [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] easy...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: So, Paige... What'll it take to get to `that level?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, Paige... What'll it take to get to [color=#e23b3b][i]that level?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A million years.
The boys laugh.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `Touche.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Touche.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige freaks out and pauses!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do I do? I guess I'll just... Be nice to him?
Paige rushes onto the dance floor...
Where she finds Jessica at the center of a crowd of guys.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There you are! I was wondering if you'd bother showing up.
She turns away from the boys to address Paige fully.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I will. Whitford just had this interesting notion that I'd be trouble tonight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you did try to escape.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wrong. I did escape.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatevs. Are you ready to do this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You and me. We split up the room from that statue over there in the middle--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I get the side with the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: --Fine. I'll take the side with the hors d'oeuvres.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoever has the most guys on her side by the celebratory toast in an hour wins.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Great.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They part, and Paige finds three guys talking near the statue in the center of the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Those look like tempting targets.
Paige sizes the three boys up.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: And then this girl told me that she wanted an `old` watch, not a `gold` watch. I dropped her like a hot tomato. Backbutter doesn't have time for chicks playing games.
nodes.text_bbcode: And then this girl told me that she wanted an [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] watch, not a [color=#e23b3b][i]gold[/i][/color] watch. I dropped her like a hot tomato. Backbutter doesn't have time for chicks playing games.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Big ego hotshot. Used to getting his way with the ladies...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: An `old` watch? Why want something old when you can buy something new?
nodes.text_bbcode: An [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] watch? Why want something old when you can buy something new?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He seems exactly like the type to flaunt his wealth...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Who even wants a watch?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And he's just a nerd.
Paige steps up to the group and smiles at each of them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello boys... I'm Paige.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm Carson, and this is Preston.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Hey. We've met before.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: And I am Mark Backbutter. `Enchante, mademoiselle...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I am Mark Backbutter. [color=#e23b3b][i]Enchante, mademoiselle...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mark takes Paige's hand and lifts it to his mouth to kiss it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, hotshot...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The last few weeks I was here, I forgot that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But seeing this ballroom, the glitter, and the glamor... Well, I finally figured out my place.
Whitford stares at her thoughtfully... And smiles.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Good.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were right after all, Principal.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just needed to see it for myself.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm glad we came to this understanding. You are much more clever than I gave you credit for.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Perhaps we'll be seeing you at the Debutante Ball this spring after all.
Whitford walks away, chuckling to herself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Changed. Inside and out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a completely different person.
Whitford stares at her thoughtfully... Then frowns.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Do you think me a simpleton, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, no!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I've heard lip service before. I know what it sounds like.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You don't fool me. You may think you can pander to me to get yourself into my good graces, but you'd be wrong.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'll be watching you, Paige. If I were you, I'd be my very best tonight, or you may never graduate from the hallowed halls of this distinguished academy!
Whitford walks away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Great.` Every girl's dream come true... Having a principal watching her every move...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Great.[/i][/color] Every girl's dream come true... Having a principal watching her every move...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just hope it doesn't ruin my chances against Jessica.
On the night of the Emerald Ball...
Principal Whitford escorts the well-dressed girls through the serpentine maze of corridors underneath the detention center...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This way, girls...
...And into a glittering room with high chandeliers. Sparkling juices bubble in crystal glasses, and canapes are served on silver platters.
All around the room, distinguished men and women from the school board as well as handsome young gentlemen mingle on the gilded floor.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome to the Butterfly Ballroom!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh, my goodness... `This` is what I've been missing this entire year!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, my goodness... [color=#3b78e2][i]This[/i][/color] is what I've been missing this entire year!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Food that's not gray! I'm so happy!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Do you `smell` that? That's `gold` in the air. We're surrounded by luxury!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]smell[/i][/color] that? That's [color=#3b78e2][i]gold[/i][/color] in the air. We're surrounded by luxury!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Surrounded by luxury? Who cares about that? I'm surrounded by `boys!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surrounded by luxury? Who cares about that? I'm surrounded by [color=#3b78e2][i]boys![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not for long...
Jessica frowns at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll see about that.
Whitford stops to address the girls.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Remember what I've said about `good behavior`, ladies. Now... On your way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember what I've said about [color=#3b78e2][i]good behavior[/i][/color], ladies. Now... On your way.

nodes.text: As the girls walk into the ballroom to mingle, Whitford puts a firm hand on Paige's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, I'd like to speak with you. Jessica tells me that you've had trouble adjusting since you... Returned to us. She seems quite concerned about you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is she? That's so `sweet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is she? That's so [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope her concerns are unfounded. I also hope isolation and being back this last week was enough to make you rethink your decisions.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal, honestly, you have nothing to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: How can I be so sure that you'll behave?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know you're interested in Kevin, and I bet he's probably interested in you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He'd be a total fool not to be.
Kimi blushes.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So what do I do? He just seems so... Clueless.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then give him clues. Nerds are smart about a lot of things, but social cues are not one of them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It might take a while for him to catch on...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can be patient.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why don't you wait here for him, and I'll go on ahead?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! Thanks!
As Kimi happily waits for Kevin, Owen's thoughts turn to Paige...
Owen and Erik reach the top floor of the `Roundabout Hotel.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen and Erik reach the top floor of the [b]Roundabout Hotel.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jeepers bleepers! This hotel is fancy and humongous! Like a bedazzled elephant!
They see a roped-off door down a wide corridor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's probably the ballroom. Come on.
Blocking the room is a fierce-looking woman, bedecked in fine jewelry.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even the bouncers are rich!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, ahem. We'd like to go in please.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Too bad you're not invited.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, we're totally invited.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We are? That's convenient!
Owen elbows Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, uh, check the guest list! We're very important people!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Psst, Owen, I just realized what V.I.P. means!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Important, huh? What country are you the prince of?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er, Nowherezistan?

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Uh huh. And what company does your family own?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, `I` used to run a company that gave tours of the city!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] used to run a company that gave tours of the city!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We didn't make `any` profit, but it was a hoot!
nodes.text_bbcode: We didn't make [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] profit, but it was a hoot!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Guess what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're not invited...

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Sorry, boys.
She raises her hand high above her head.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You have to be this rich to ride this rollercoaster.
Owen's eyes grow wide. On the other side of the bouncer, across the ballroom, he sees Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, come on, Erik. It doesn't look like we're going to get in.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're just giving up?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just... Come on!
Owen marches off, and Erik reluctantly follows...
He has failed.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should go to `The Cottage!` It's got gold trim so it must be expensive, and you can step right out on the sand!
nodes.text_bbcode: We should go to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Cottage![/i][/color] It's got gold trim so it must be expensive, and you can step right out on the sand!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Hot dog, ride a hog! {
Twenty minutes later, Owen opens the tiny door to `The Cottage...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Twenty minutes later, Owen opens the tiny door to [b]The Cottage...[/b]

nodes.text: And the door slams right into a sofa chair!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Don't worry about that! Happens all the time! Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't mean to burst your bubble, O-Dog, but it's unlikely that this place has a dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was just thinking the same--

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: We don't get many visitors here! How do you feel about pickles?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but we just don't have time for--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pickles?! I love them! But you do know they used to be called brine sausages, right?!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: My my my! Someone knows their pickles!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Come on! Who hasn't been swept up in pickle mania?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, normal people?

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Would you like to see my collection?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Would I?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nope! No way! Come on, Erik! We should be going!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Now that I've had `way` too long to think about it, I'm pretty sure we want to go to `Roundabout.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that I've had [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too long to think about it, I'm pretty sure we want to go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awwww...
Owen drags Erik out of `The Cottage.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen drags Erik out of [b]The Cottage.[/b]

nodes.text: After a long drive and a long elevator ride...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should go to `Roundabout.` 'Luxury' sounds expensive. 'Beachfront' obviously means they're on the beach. And if they can brag about how big their hotel is, they probably have a ballroom.
nodes.text_bbcode: We should go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout.[/i][/color] 'Luxury' sounds expensive. 'Beachfront' obviously means they're on the beach. And if they can brag about how big their hotel is, they probably have a ballroom.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Ho-ho, let's go! {
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should go to `Al's Austere Hotel!` It mentions a dance floor and a beach!
nodes.text_bbcode: We should go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Al's Austere Hotel![/i][/color] It mentions a dance floor and a beach!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Lickety-splickety! {
Twenty minutes later...
Owen and Erik creep into a dumpy hotel, the walls are black with dirt, cobwebs hang from the lights, and somewhere is the sound of a rat scurrying about...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey. Name's $Travis. You want a bed?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, no thanks. But I think I just learned what austere means.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too. Hey, don't you work at a flower shop?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I've gotta lotta odd jobs, nerd. You gotta problem?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, sir!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, let's go to `Roundabout.` That was my second choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, let's go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout.[/i][/color] That was my second choice.

nodes.text: After a long drive and a long elevator ride...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should go to `Groviere!` It `sounds` really rich, and it's bound to have a dance floor!
nodes.text_bbcode: We should go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Groviere![/i][/color] It [color=#e23b3b][i]sounds[/i][/color] really rich, and it's bound to have a dance floor!

nodes.text: Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How far away is this place?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You didn't check back when we were on the computer?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! Why don't you check on your phone now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not while I'm driving... Here!
Owen hands his phone to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: According to this, it's an hour and a half away...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! Is it `in` France?
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Is it [color=#e23b3b][i]in[/i][/color] France?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No offense, but geographically we could never get to France in an hour and a half, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was kidding.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Ha! That was funny!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, let's go to `Roundabout.` That was my second choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, let's go to [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout.[/i][/color] That was my second choice.

nodes.text: After a long drive and a long elevator ride...
He walks away...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I'll just have to figure out the internet on my own!
Owen opens up the computer's web browser and types in 'local hotels' into the search bar.
On the edge of the screen, a happy cartoon pig points at a pile of money underneath a big header that says 'THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS IN PRIZES!'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, cool. If I click on this pile of money I'll actually win money?!
Ten minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hahaha! The cat is standing like a human!
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And now I'll just plant these strawberries... Sure, I'll speed that up with some corn cash.
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How come no one is commenting on my post?
An unknown amount of time later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. That cat is... Wait! I've seen this before!
Owen rises up out of his chair!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh no! I totally forgot about Paige!
But when Owen turns around he sees that the conference hall is empty.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How long was I on the computer for?
He checks the time on his phone, but before he sees the result, he already knows that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A friend? I can be a great friend!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, buddy. Is it too much to ask for your help finding Paige? I know the guys probably need you to work on L.Y.L.E....

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No biggie! I'm the repair guy, and battling isn't till the end of Robo-Con! I got time to spare, O-dog!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, probably shouldn't call me that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It felt funny as soon as it left my mouth. What can I help you with first?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do you need me to drive a getaway car? Use my athletic prowess to leap over a wall? Or act the part of a loose-moraled hussy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I could just use some help with the internet. I'm not exactly a computer wizard. Could you look something up for me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure thing! I love web surfing! It's my second favorite sport after basketball!
Erik licks mustard and ketchup off of his fingers and sits down next to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you searching for?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm actually looking for a hotel in the area...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And what are the parameters?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Expensive, for sure. Also, it needs to be on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it should be big enough to have a dance hall or a ballroom.
Erik's fingers dance on the keyboard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! My search has turned up `four` hotels!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! My search has turned up [color=#e23b3b][i]four[/i][/color] hotels!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What does it say about each one?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, there's `The Cottage...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's [color=#e23b3b][i]The Cottage...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'A cozy hotel reminiscent of a bed and breakfast. Every room decorated in gold trim. Step out of your room and onto the sand!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How lovely!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What else?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Next is `Roundabout...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Next is [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'Luxury is now at your fingertips. Our beachfront property spans more acreage than any hotel in Centerscore Beach!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Impressive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay. Next.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Al's Austere Hotel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Al's Austere Hotel...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'Hey, folks. Love the beach?! Love the dance floor?! Al's Austere Hotel offers prices so low you'll shout YOLO when you see them!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow. I don't think I'd ever shout that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the last one?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Groviere...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Groviere...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Most of their site's in French. Something about chandeliers, the waltz, and not having to deal with the pesky, pesky ocean.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Very French.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which one do you think we should go to?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There are plenty of people here who can help you navigate a computer. It's a robot conference after all.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could use more than just `tech` support though.
nodes.text_bbcode: I could use more than just [color=#e23b3b][i]tech[/i][/color] support though.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy. You should have thought of that `before` you abused my friendship...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, buddy. You should have thought of that [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] you abused my friendship...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And you know what the worst part is?
Erik sadly tosses his hot dog into a nearby trashcan.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've made me lose my appetite.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `My` help?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]My[/i][/color] help?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So after you lie, I'm just supposed to drop everything to give you a hand?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy. Even though I feel plumb rotten abandoning someone in need of tech support...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just can't do it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And you know what the worst part is?
Erik sadly tosses his hot dog into a nearby trashcan.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've made me lose my appetite.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, you were saying something about a hawk?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I wasn't. Were you even paying attention?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was trying to. Sorry. I remember now. You were talking about your bikini?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I thought you were more sensitive than this...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I am normally. I guess I just got distracted by all these people...

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: The air smells divine, ripened by the perfume of your forefathers!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...And this robomonkey.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I'm paying attention now. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay. Don't worry about it. I'll just wait here for Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure...
As Kimi sadly waits for Kevin, Owen's thoughts turn to Paige...
Owen, $ZOE, Ben, Emily, Kimi, and the nerds arrive outside the hotel!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's pretty obvious what we do with Owen...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Welcome to the Robotics Club!
The nerds clap, and Brendan pulls Owen aside...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've thought about it, and I'm making you the official nerd supervisor!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't you mean the L.Y.L.E. supervisor?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nope. We've got enough nerds looking after the robot, but no one to look after us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: After all, who watches the watch-wearers?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I do now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: See you tomorrow! Spring Break! Woot!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's pretty obvious what we do with Owen...
The nerds all nod glumly.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Buh-bye! We don't need you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm never going to see Paige now!
Owen turns to leave the Robotics room...
...And runs into L.Y.L.E.'s carrying case for the second time!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Grrr!
He bends down and easily throws the case aside!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry if I damaged your case, I just--

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Who cares about the case?! Turns out, we `do` have a use for you after all!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who cares about the case?! Turns out, we [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] have a use for you after all!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You do?
The next day, after a long van ride...
The nerds all look at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, if `Ben` says so...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben[/i][/color] says so...

nodes.text: Erik attaches the green and blue wires together!
Suddenly Owen realizes that Ben told him `never` to do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Suddenly Owen realizes that Ben told him [b]never[/b] to do that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait--
`FWOOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]FWOOOM![/b]

nodes.text: An explosion lifts L.Y.L.E off the ground! Dark smoke billows out, filling the room!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!` Ben did `not` tell you that!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] Ben did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] tell you that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I might have... `Cough!`... Mixed up the lesson...
nodes.text_bbcode: I might have... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color]... Mixed up the lesson...

nodes.text: The nerds all stare at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Trust me, you don't want to put green and blue together.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Actually... He's `totally` right! Green and red!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually... He's [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] right! Green and red!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Got it!
Erik puts the wires together. L.Y.L.E. quiets down.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Whub. Whub. Whub.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How'd you know that, Owen?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Easy. It's Robotics 101.
Owen hesitates to speak!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: The blue wire, I think...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's it! The blue wire! Ben told me about that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's undo the most recent changes that we've made.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E., what's your favorite food?

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Chips. Computer chips.
The nerds wait for L.Y.L.E. to repeat itself, but it remains silent.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Huzzah! It's fixed! First place trophy, here we co--
L.Y.L.E. starts humming loudly! It rocks back and forth! The humming turns into a violent thumping sound!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: `Whump! Whump! Whump!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whump! Whump! Whump![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: --Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Abort! Abort!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's a wiring issue! Quick, Erik, reattach those two wires together!
Erik sneaks a peek underneath L.Y.L.E. at the mesh of wires dangling from its underbelly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There are three exposed wires! Red, green, and blue! Which ones do I put together?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: The green wire and the... Uh, the...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What's that going to do?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dex, nothing that we're doing seems to be working, so why not?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Fine. Let's take a step back.
All the nerds take a step away from L.Y.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The paint job looks splendid!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I'm not getting any epiphanies about how to fix it from back here.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Wow, I'm so shocked. Can we actually come up with a `good` idea now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, I'm so shocked. Can we actually come up with a [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] idea now?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's okay. I'm not sure what I expected to happen...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hey, great idea, `Mom.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, great idea, [color=#e23b3b][i]Mom.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's not a bad idea, Dex.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes, it is. I've been calibrating the voice processor. Nothing that anyone else has been doing conflicts with that...
The nerds stare at each other awkwardly.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Right?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, I was trying to improve the quality of L.Y.L.E.'s audio output...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I was working on the code that calls its voice commands.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So, we're `all` working on L.Y.L.E's speech?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So, we're [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] working on L.Y.L.E's speech?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not me! I've just been zapping it every once in a while with this welding torch! It's really fun!
Dex's face reddens as he looks over at Owen...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I, uh, I stand corrected.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just make sure you clean your room up like I asked you to.
The nerds power L.Y.L.E. off and on again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E., what's your favorite food?

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Chips. Computer Chips.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! That's my joke! I made me laugh!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Chips. Chips. Chips.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hmm, delivery is still a little repetitious.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I wish I hadn't told Ben to go home and program L.Y.L.E.'s battle mode.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: He'd totally know how to fix this!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Chips. Chips. Chips.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm stumped, guys. Are we missing something?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe if you...
Erik gasps and covers L.Y.L.E.'s 'ears'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How could you say that in front of him?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, no I didn't mean throw it away, I thought--

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We get it, jock! You meant recycle it because you care about the environment!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, we're not just going to give up on L.Y.L.E so easily!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not what I meant! Isn't that a Robotics term?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Did you mean power cycle?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, maybe...
The nerds start laughing!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Power cycle, power reduce, power reuse! Haha!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We should probably do a power cycle now that it's been brought up.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Good idea, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I brought it up...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Of course we've tried power-cycling it! Do you think we're amateurs?! Kevin powered L.Y.L.E. off like ten minutes ago!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So just get out of our brainspace and go dunk a layup or whatever it is you do!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh... I actually never turned L.Y.L.E off.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?! But I told you to put it into warp seven!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `That's` what you meant? Because I turned this dial over here on L.Y.L.E.'s back to seven!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That's[/i][/color] what you meant? Because I turned this dial over here on L.Y.L.E.'s back to seven!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The coolant system?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, that explains a lot. We should probably do a power cycle. And get clear on our terms!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen. You really saved the day!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was nothing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Tried what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Recycling it or something?
Twenty minutes later, in the robotics room...
Owen walks in... And runs right into a huge metallic case!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!
None of the nerds notice as they are all busily operating on L.Y.L.E. the robot. Owen rubs his knee.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hello... I'm here to prove my--

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not now, jock! We've got a category five nerd-mergency!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You said I could join if I proved myself!
Erik flips open his welding hood.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry there, my fellow basketball champion. Membership will have to wait.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E.'s on the fritz, and we have to be on the road to Robo-Con bright and early tomorrow morning!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why are you guys stressing about this Robo-Con? What happens there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `The Computition!` Rounds one, two, and three feature a grueling series of questions and answers, stressing the robot's artificial intelligence capabilities to infinity and beyond!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The Computition![/i][/color] Rounds one, two, and three feature a grueling series of questions and answers, stressing the robot's artificial intelligence capabilities to infinity and beyond!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, not beyond infinity... That doesn't exist!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happens in round four?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: An all-out robot battle to the death! Although frankly `I` think the finale should be more gentlemanly. Why not a game of robot tag? I love tag! Although I hate being `it.` No one likes--
nodes.text_bbcode: An all-out robot battle to the death! Although frankly [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] think the finale should be more gentlemanly. Why not a game of robot tag? I love tag! Although I hate being [color=#e23b3b][i]it.[/i][/color] No one likes--

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Erik, focus!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoops! Got to get back to work! Nose to the computer processor!
Erik flips the welding hood back down, fires up a blowtorch, and gets back to work. A second later, sparks explode out from underneath L.Y.L.E.!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Try it now! It `should` work!
nodes.text_bbcode: Try it now! It [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] work!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E., what's your favorite food?

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Michigan. Cow. Butt.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I don't think that's going to impress the judges.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Have you tried...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm sorry for wasting your time. 'Don't give up' is `only` the mantra that's gotten me through my most difficult academic times.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm sorry for wasting your time. 'Don't give up' is [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] the mantra that's gotten me through my most difficult academic times.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I didn't mean to belittle your advice. I just wanted--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I get it. I get it. You want to see Paige, and you're out of options.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But this isn't `only` about you. The nerds have worked `hard` to get to `Robo-Con.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But this isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] about you. The nerds have worked [color=#e23b3b][i]hard[/i][/color] to get to [color=#e23b3b][i]Robo-Con.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That means you've got to pull your weight. Contribute. You can't just slide by because you're in love.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... You're right. Still, I could use--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. You want my advice? Robotics crash course? Here it is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Power cycle. Step back. Don't not not cross blue and green wires. How's that?
Ben rolls his wheelchair away from the table.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Confusing...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think you hurt his feelings. You know, I bet if you apologized, he'd give you better advice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I think it's too late for that. I have to meet with the nerds now...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Don't give up` is a good mantra, but it's not going to impress the nerds.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't give up[/i][/color] is a good mantra, but it's not going to impress the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, they're usually only impressed by processing speed and solid game mechanics.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, you want the crash course in Robotics?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If you don't mind...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. Uh, let me think...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Lesson one: If it's broken, try turning it off and on. That's called power-cycling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Two: When I don't know the answer to a problem, I'll ask the guys to take a mental step back.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, really `see` the big picture.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, really [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] the big picture.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then `they` figure out the solution and give `me` the credit!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#e23b3b][i]they[/i][/color] figure out the solution and give [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] the credit!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, three: Never ever `ever` cross blue and green wires together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, three: Never ever [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] cross blue and green wires together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? That seems oddly specific. You're sure? I mean what if--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. It's a weird thing. Just `don't` do it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me. It's a weird thing. Just [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] do it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If you say so...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben! I have to go meet with them now, and I think your crash course will help!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem. Anything for a future club member!

nodes.title: The Debutante Dance, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen find Paige during Spring Break?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen...
It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called `'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called [b]'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.[/b]

nodes.text: With his other hand, he inspects and probes a tiny robot, laying lifeless on the table next to his lunch, which has long gone cold.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Come on! Please work this time!
He brings two wires together... Sparks shoot out every which way! The robot's eyes glow bright for a second, only to fade again.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You stupid thing!
Kimi and $ZOE arrive, with Emily wheeling Ben up behind them. They all sit down around Owen.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Robo-surgery doesn't look like it's going well.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, and in twenty minutes, I've gotta prove to the nerds that I'm competent enough to join the Robotics Club!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hope you do! Otherwise you'll never find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Man, I missed `one` awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, I missed [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's so simple, Ben! Owen just has to get good at robotics so he can join the Robotics Club so he can get into a hotel for Spring Break so he can find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `So` simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. When we snuck Owen into Monarch Prep, he found out that Paige is going to be at a Debutante Dance in a hotel near Centerscore Beach this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right, I remember someone unimportant telling me about that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And `someone's` going to break his other leg if he's not careful...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]someone's[/i][/color] going to break his other leg if he's not careful...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Anyway, I tried to get a hotel room, but every hotel is booked! Turns out there are a million different events going on this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Including `Robo-Con!` Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!
nodes.text_bbcode: Including [color=#e23b3b][i]Robo-Con![/i][/color] Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!

nodes.text: Ben does a little dance in his wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, `The Computition,` we get to stay at the hotel for `free!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, [color=#3b78e2][i]The Computition,[/i][/color] we get to stay at the hotel for [color=#3b78e2][i]free![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We do? Sweet! Free is my favorite price!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As soon as I heard that the Robotics Club has a hotel room, I asked Kimi if she could get me in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand... I'm caught up! How's studying going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of `some` use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?

nodes.text: Owen gestures sadly toward his robot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Turns out, pretty hard. This one-second lightbulb isn't going to cut it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! It's kind of cute to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The thing is... I've never wanted anything more than I do now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to talk to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To tell her that my kiss with $ZOE during the play was... Was exactly what it was, a stage-kiss and nothing more.
$ZOE nods her head, agreeing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to tell Paige how I really feel.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, man, Robotics 101... `Don't give up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man, Robotics 101... [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't give up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No offense, but I could use advice that's a little more...

nodes.prompt: I could use advice that's a little more...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I could use advice that's a little more...

nodes.text: A moment later, he steps back out into the kitchen, blending in with the rest of the waitstaff.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The disguise worked. Now I need to get out there to find Paige!
He sees staff members leaving the kitchen holding trays of food.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's my ticket!
Feeling confident, Owen grabs a tray of tiny steak sliders. He heads for the door, takes a deep breath, and nudges it open.
Peeking out, he immediately sees Paige across the ballroom...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh my...
Owen can't believe how beautiful Paige looks in her gown...
All around her, tuxedoed guys cast glances her way.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's right. Keep your distance, fellas.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... Why are they staying away?
That's when Owen notices the handsome guy near her...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who's this chump?!
The guy gets close to Paige... Too close...
As jealousy builds in Owen, his heart sinks... He can't bear to see what he sees, but he can't take his eyes away.
Because at that moment, Paige look at the handsome guy and `smiles.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because at that moment, Paige look at the handsome guy and [b]smiles.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is... Is Paige happy with this guy?!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hey, you gonna stand in the doorway all night?!
Owen doesn't look back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not.
He steps out, walking a straight path toward Paige. Immediately, Principal Whitford approaches him!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Waiter, would you get me another drink?
Owen hides his face from Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sure thing...
He keeps walking...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When I reach Paige, I'm going to tell her exactly how I feel...
As Owen crosses the dance floor, Madisenn reaches out to take some food from his tray.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: `So` good! And, hey, you look familiar! Have you butlered for me before?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So[/i][/color] good! And, hey, you look familiar! Have you butlered for me before?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, no. First time... Butlering. And I'll give the chef your compliments.
Owen presses forward...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm going to tell Paige that she's always been the one for me!
Owen is just steps away from Paige, she notices his presence, but doesn't notice `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen is just steps away from Paige, she notices his presence, but doesn't notice [b]him.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me? I'd like some food. Like, now!
She takes an hors d'oeuvre off his tray.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm going to tell her everything that's been inside my heart, and I'm going to tell her `right now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to tell her everything that's been inside my heart, and I'm going to tell her [color=#e23b3b][i]right now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ahem. Maybe the lady would like to treat the staff with a little more respect.
She looks at him, shocked, and he shoots her a wink.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 7: Debutante Dance, Part One!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 7: Debutante Dance, Part One![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up?
Season 4: Love and Basketball is available in More Episodes now!
Love SHS? Remember to rate us in the app store!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
Owen changes as fast as he can.
He steps back out into the kitchen in chef's attire. Almost immediately, he's ordered to get to work!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, guess I'll try to cook something!
Owen finds an empty station...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: You! Make the chimichurri sauce!
Owen grabs a mixing bowl and starts throwing together random ingredients!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... Like twenty tablespoons of hot sauce? One per person?
When he's done, someone scoops up the sauce and pours it over a steak.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh. I feel kind of... Proud.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... What does cooking have to do with Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should be dressed as a waiter so I can go out there without drawing attention to myself!
He's about to sneak back into the supply closet when the first of the screams pierce through the kitchen walls!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh no... I think my chimichurri sauce might have been a tad too fiery...
All eyes turn to Owen, and he knows there won't be any more disguises. He knows...
Owen changes as fast as he can.
At the bottom of a set of stairs, Owen finds himself in a bustling kitchen!
Fancy chefs, butlers, and waiters zig zag in a chaotic orchestra of food, pots, and fire!
As Owen watches them from behind a rack of bread, one thing becomes abundantly clear...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've got to find a disguise!
He sneaks over to a supply closet and steps in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Looks like I can dress as a chef or a waiter...
Owen starts to get up, but immediately feels dizzy again!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Better wait it out for the full twenty seconds!
After coming to grips with a near-death experience, Owen gets to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, get back to Robo-Con and tell the guys I'll be there! I promise!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You got it!
Erik runs off while Owen opens the rooftop door of `The Roundabout Hotel...`

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't mess up!
As Owen leaps he thinks about what it would be like to fall, and the thought causes just the slightest hesitation...
He jumps... But the jump isn't his best!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not going to make it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no!
Owen throws his hands out, barely managing to snag the lip of the Roundabout's roof!
Erik calls to him from across the gap!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Phew! You thought about failing, didn't you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Shut up!
Owen slowly pulls himself up onto the top of the roof, and lies there, feeling dizzy, his heart pounding.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, aren't you going to go after Paige now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: After what just happened, I think I'm just going to lie here for twenty seconds contemplating my existence.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fair enough...
Owen starts to get up, but immediately feels dizzy again!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Better wait it out for the full twenty seconds!
After coming to grips with a near-death experience, Owen gets to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, get back to Robo-Con and tell the guys I'll be there! I promise!

nodes.text: You got it!
Erik runs off while Owen opens the rooftop door of `The Roundabout Hotel...`

He jumps... But the jump isn't his best!

Erik calls to him from across the gap!
