Owen slowly pulls himself up onto the top of the roof, and lies there, feeling dizzy, his heart pounding.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, aren't you going to go after Paige now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: After what just happened, I think I'm just going to lie here for twenty seconds contemplating my existence.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fair enough...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is the reason I'm here!
Owen leaps off the edge of the building, flying across the gap...
...And landing on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sugar buns! You nailed it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes! I'm still alive!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, get back to Robo-Con and tell the guys I'll be there soon! I promise!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You got it!
Erik runs off while Owen opens the rooftop door of `The Roundabout Hotel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik runs off while Owen opens the rooftop door of [b]The Roundabout Hotel...[/b]

nodes.text: Owen's mind is a complete blank as he leaps off the edge of the building!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is this what it means to achieve inner peace?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Owen! Grab the edge!
Owen instinctively throws his hands out, barely managing to snag the lip of the Roundabout's roof!
Erik calls to him from across the gap!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What happened?! You just kind of... Turned into putty.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... But I'm glad you said something!
The song ends...
Cromwell twirls Paige one last time and draws her close.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I like your spirit. It would be my honor to court you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But all I can offer you is everything money can buy. Clothes, jewelry, vacations to the most exotic destinations in the world...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Also escape from all your problems, all your troubles, and so on, etcetera. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I think...
Paige stifles the feeling she has deep within her...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Paige.` My name is Paige.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Paige.[/i][/color] My name is Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige. My mouth enjoys saying this. It is a pleasure.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What girl wouldn't want `everything?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What girl wouldn't want [color=#3b78e2][i]everything?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ah, and you are logical too! The perfect girl! It is a pleasure.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The pleasure is all yours!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am sad to say that you seem to be of inferior upbringing...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Inferior? Do you even `know` who you're talking to?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Inferior? Do you even [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] who you're talking to?!

nodes.text: Paige gives him an intense look.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then again, maybe I am mistaken...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not `maybe` mistaken! `Definitely` mistaken!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color] mistaken! [color=#3b78e2][i]Definitely[/i][/color] mistaken!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Very well! You have earned what I rarely offer... A second chance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I want it!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You aren't accepting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I didn't say that! But a girl like me doesn't just take the first offer. Impress me... And we'll see what happens, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I like this arrangement. And I must admit, I did not know I would find myself here with you tonight!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, you never know where you might end up...
You are now playing as Owen...
On the rooftop of the building adjacent to the `Roundabout Hotel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: On the rooftop of the building adjacent to the [b]Roundabout Hotel...[/b]

nodes.text: The door flies open, and Owen and Erik stagger out, both panting.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hoob! Can I just reiterate for the hundredth time how stupid this idea is?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure, Erik, as long as I can ignore you for the hundredth time...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, then... Jumping from the roof of one really tall building to the roof of another really tall building is `really` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, then... Jumping from the roof of one really tall building to the roof of another really tall building is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Owen ignores Erik and walks out to the edge of the roof. Across the gap is the `Roundabout's` roof.
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen ignores Erik and walks out to the edge of the roof. Across the gap is the [b]Roundabout's[/b] roof.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It looks farther away from up here...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Welp! That's it! I can't do it! I can't watch you kill yourself!
Erik starts walking back toward the exit.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not going to kill myself, Erik! I can do this!
Erik keeps walking away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In fact, I'm `going` to do this, whether you're here or not.
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]going[/i][/color] to do this, whether you're here or not.

nodes.text: Erik stops. Owen turns, facing the `Roundabout's` roof. He runs, accelerating toward the edge!
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik stops. Owen turns, facing the [b]Roundabout's[/b] roof. He runs, accelerating toward the edge!

nodes.text: His mind is focused on not falling, on not tripping, on not failing. He's ready to jump, when--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait!
--Owen stops! His momentum carries him right to the edge! His feet skid on pebbles that fly off and get sucked down into the abyss below!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it, Erik?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just want to make sure you're focused on the right thing when you jump!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's why I almost died just now?! I know how to focus! Athlete, remember?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No need to get all grumpy. So, what were you focused on?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Ahem... Not failing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, geez, I'm glad I stopped you then! Otherwise I would have been serving up Owen Pancakes in the morning!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? I could do without the imagery!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm a vivid storyteller!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Forget it! What am I `supposed` to focus on?
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget it! What am I [color=#e23b3b][i]supposed[/i][/color] to focus on?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about your target?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The roof?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you come all the way out here for a roof?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. But I get your point.
Owen returns to the other end of the roof, giving himself the longest runway possible...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got this.
He runs! As the edge nears, he thinks only of...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: How is this possible? How can someone be so cold?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How can someone be so dumb?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Maybe you are an ultimate challenge. A girl so hardened she's forgotten what love is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see. This I can respect.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I care.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Tell me, do you believe in love at first sight?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't believe in...

options.label: Talking so deeply with a stranger.

nodes.text: Paige's feet get tangled up, and she stumbles, bumping into another couple!

nodes.speaker: Rich Guy
nodes.text: Must you add injury to insult? I see you've found someone `prettier!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Must you add injury to insult? I see you've found someone [color=#e23b3b][i]prettier![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell pulls her towards him.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Perhaps I am too advanced for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or did you ever think maybe you're not very good at twirling me?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I never considered that the fault would be mine...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Start considering!
Paige twirls and comes back, easily returning to Cromwell's arms.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Nothing fazes you, I see.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. I could waltz in my sleep.
Paige hesitates, and Cromwell runs into her!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Look out!
Cromwell's weight shifts, preparing to twirl Paige out!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So, you are speechless because you've never... Diamonds?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not what I meant.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It's okay. I must surprise you. Most men my age aren't men yet.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Oh, I love it! You do not mince words. It is so refreshing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You like it when I insult you?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: We like what we rarely experience.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And now you are speechless again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Diamonds!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: My fortune comes from the diamond mines my father owns. Someday I will own them too.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are speechless because you are thinking about diamonds, are you not?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I'm speechless because I've never...

options.label: Met anyone so full of himself!

nodes.text: Paige twists her body in rhythm with the music.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You know the waltz, I see.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't change the subject. Tell me about this fortune.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! What fire!
She gets tangled up with Cromwell, nearly falling over, but he catches her!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I will not let you fall.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Although I am disappointed to see that you don't know the waltz.
Paige straightens her dress...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know it! I just made a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see... I've found that the trick with mistakes is not to make them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that how you made your fortune?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ah, I knew you wouldn't let me forget...
Paige hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fortune?
All the couples switch directions with the music! Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you must know, it's Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? You don't like how that sounds?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: No... I assume since you are so willing to give me your name, you must already know about my fortune.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft! I'll only tell it to guys who actually have a chance with me.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You're tormenting me willfully? I like this. When girls learn of my family fortune, they treat me like I am a large piece of fragile glass.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't it obvious? The key to happiness is money, status, and power!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Take me, for example. Now that I've overthrown Jessica, I've got all the status and power I could ever want.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: And are you happy?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not yet. All I'm missing is money. But that's about to change!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: So you're going after the richest guy? What if he looks like a baboon? Or worse, acts like one?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! Spoiler alert! They're `all` going to be ugly. The more money guys have, the uglier they are.
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't matter! Spoiler alert! They're [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] going to be ugly. The more money guys have, the uglier they are.

nodes.text: Near a side entrance, a butler plays on a trumpet, announcing the arrival of the guys!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The Debutante Ball begins with a waltz! Everyone get to the dance floor!
The girls line up on the dance floor as the guys file in, dressed in their very finest.
Paige scans the line...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, I do care about looks `a little.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I do care about looks [color=#3b78e2][i]a little.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Eugh. Pass.
The cute guy Paige looks at is staring right back at her, as if she is the only girl in the room!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! 12 o'clock. Total hottie. `Totally` into you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! 12 o'clock. Total hottie. [color=#3b78e2][i]Totally[/i][/color] into you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, and totally poor, I'm sure!
The music starts up. The two groups come together, pairing off in the waltz.
Paige is paired up with a short, stocky guy.

nodes.speaker: Rich Guy
nodes.text: You're rather pretty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, thanks. You are too.

nodes.speaker: Rich Guy
nodes.text: What? I'm pretty?
Suddenly, the cute guy and his partner come near to Paige and her partner...
There is a flurry of activity! Paige is spun about, and suddenly finds herself dancing with the cute guy.

nodes.speaker: Rich Guy
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I couldn't wait another moment. As soon as I saw you, I had to dance with you. I am Cromwell. Please, tell me your name.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A lie that people made up a long time ago to sell flowers and chocolates.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you have feelings for someone, too bad, because they never have feelings for you!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Please stop talking. I'm getting really sad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's even worse when you get together, because inevitably you break up, and then your heart's completely shattered.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Even adults, who are supposed to be, like, experts or whatever, get divorced more than half the time! Look at my parents!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I don't want to look at anything!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Love is a lie, Madisenn.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: So what's the point, then? Why are you even here?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: A what?
Paige can't bring herself to say the word.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A l-

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: A lark? A light? A luxurious, relaxing Sunday afternoon with the one you want to be with for the rest of your life?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Never mind. Forget about all that sappy stuff!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: If you're not interested in love, what are you here for?
You are now playing as Paige.
In the `Roundabout Hotel` ballroom...
nodes.text_bbcode: In the [b]Roundabout Hotel[/b] ballroom...

nodes.text: Paige is standing in a circle of girls that has formed around Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I've brought you all here to the Debutante Ball because you are the very best, the cream of the crop.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's a given.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What I expect of you is tip-top behavior. Represent Monarch Prep well today, and you may never have to use a paper napkin ever again.
The girls' ears perk up.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Everything I've taught you has all been in preparation for today.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The gentlemen you'll be meeting in just a few moments are, like you, unparalleled in manners and decorum.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And they are `all` wealthy. It's not uncommon for girls at this event to be offered extravagant gifts!
nodes.text_bbcode: And they are [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] wealthy. It's not uncommon for girls at this event to be offered extravagant gifts!

nodes.text: The girls chatter excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What kind of gifts?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Trips to exotic lands, priceless jewelry, luxury cars. I've seen it all.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In short, the Emerald Ball was training, but now you're in the big leagues.
Madisenn whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: This is kind of disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Really? You don't see it? Guys just giving us stuff even though they hardly know who we are?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wake up, Madisenn. That's life!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: No, it isn't. I mean, what about love?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft! Love? Love is just...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Disengage trap! End program! Cancel trap!
The monkey-robot stops wrapping its rope around Owen!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Apologies, friend.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know which one worked, but I'm glad it did!
The robot quickly cuts the rope, and Owen gets back to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Now I should be home free!
The lot is completely empty, and the night is quiet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... What time is it?
Owen pulls his phone out of his pocket and checks the time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That took `so` much time!
nodes.text_bbcode: That took [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] much time!

nodes.text: Owen runs off in the direction of the restaurant, even though he knows it's too late!
By the time he reaches the restaurant, the sun begins to rise, and he knows without a doubt that he won't find Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's gone. Maybe forever...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If Paige `is` getting dinner, I probably don't have much time before she leaves the restaurant!
nodes.text_bbcode: If Paige [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] getting dinner, I probably don't have much time before she leaves the restaurant!

nodes.text: Owen starts to sprint toward the beachfront walkway, when he's stopped in his tracks!
Nearby, an old man is feeding a beautiful black horse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How much to rent your horse, sir?

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: One hundred dollars, and he's yours for the next two hours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I don't have that much.

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priiit!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Well, how much have you got?
Owen rifles through his pockets, knowing already there isn't going to be nearly enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Never mind. I've only got... Uh, seven bucks.
Owen turns away, wondering how he'll ever make it in time, when the old man calls out to him!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Wait one minute, Sonny! You look like someone who needs this horse a lot more than the tourists, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's kind of important, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Well, it just so happens that my fee this late drops to seven dollars for as long as you need ol' Thunder here.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You serious?

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priiit!
The old man hands him the reins and shoots him a wink.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: As serious as a broken heart.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I like what you're saying, Cromwell.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Of course you do. I am saying wonderful things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I also imagine you are excited to not go to horror school anymore, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Once you are with me, we will travel the world together!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Travel? You never said anything about traveling!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I do not live here, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where do you live?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Everywhere and nowhere. The world is my home. We can explore it together!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That is what this whole day has been about... Will you experience the world with me?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are speechless again because my offer is so amazing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Air! I need some air!
Paige gets up from her seat in a hurry and rushes outside!
Out on the restaurant's balcony, the cool sea air blows against Paige's face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I `want?`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I [color=#3b78e2][i]want?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the distance, she hears a voice calling out.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Paaaaaaaige! Paaaaaaaige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Am I that hung up on Owen? Now I'm hearing his voice...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be stupid, Paige.
Paige casually turns, looking down along the beach...
Her voice catches in her throat. Owen is there, riding up to her on a magnificent stallion!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige!
At that moment, Cromwell steps out onto the balcony. He sees the look on Paige's face...
...And starts rolling up his sleeves!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see trouble has returned.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am going to end this. Stay back, dear. This is about to get ugly.
He has failed.

Owen waits...
And waits...
And waits...
Until finally the fire goes out in the rings, and they lift upwards.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Took you long enough... Stupid rings.
He walks under the rings and out into the convention center parking lot...
Owen leaps through the hoops cleanly, landing on the other side without a scratch on him!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sweet! Maybe I've got a career making dangerous jumps!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Bad monkey-bot! Bad!

nodes.text: Do not hurl insults, enemy.
The rope wraps around Owen's neck!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hrrk! Hard to! Breathe!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Go! Away! Monkey!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Invalid command.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're an! Invalid! Command! You! Stupid! Hunk! Of! Junk!
The rope wraps all the way around Owen's head and face!
Everything starts to go black, when...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Lucius?! What are you doing?! I leave you alone for two seconds!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: End program!
Lucius, the monkey-bot, cuts the rope around Owen, giving him enough slack to wriggle free.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Phew! I can finally breathe again!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Sorry about that. I came as soon as you triggered its enemy alarm.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, thanks for saving me. That would have been embarrassing.
As the robot's owner guides the robot away, Owen's attention turns to the far end of the tunnel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A setback, but I should be home-free from here...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, was it a left and then a right? Or a right and then a left?
Owen gets completely turned around inside the maze!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe robots can navigate through this, and I can't!
Finally, at long last, he pops out of the maze...
Only to discover that he's right back where he started!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?!
Ten minutes later, he finally reaches the beginning of the large, pitch-black tunnel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hopefully, I didn't lose too much time. All I have to do is get to the end, and I'll be on my way to Paige!
He twists his way through the maze, reaching the beginning of the large, pitch-black tunnel.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was easy! Now all I have to do is get to the end of the tunnel, and I'll be on my way to Paige!
In the restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So when you say there's nothing you wouldn't do for me...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Name it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted to live in a mansion all my own?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It is yours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted jewelry, like this emerald piece, every day?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Also, yours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: --Paige, you will want for nothing, `need` for nothing.
nodes.text_bbcode: --Paige, you will want for nothing, [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And there is no obstacle that I would let get in the way of your happiness...
At Robo-Con, Owen sprints through the tunnel...
...And trips over a robot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Enemy! Enemy! Engaging monkey trap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I even want to know what that is?!
Before Owen can get to his feet, the monkey-robot fires a rope and quickly wraps it around Owen's legs, working up to his body!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How is this even related to monkeys?!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: None of your monkey business, enemy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, turn off, now! Not an enemy!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Does not compute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, stop the trap!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Invalid command.
The rope is now around Owen's elbows, heading up his arms!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just have to say the right commands!
And then...
Then...
Meanwhile, in Betty's Chowderhouse, Paige and Cromwell are sitting at a candlelit table...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I told you they do not have valet parking here. I was appalled to have to park the car myself.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I do not understand. Why did you pick `this` restaurant?
nodes.text_bbcode: I do not understand. Why did you pick [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know, okay?! I just did!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are upset? Maybe about the waiter from your past?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am thinking you are sad about a time when you used to be poor...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! My family owns a mansion!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Only one? Then it is worse than I imagined...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It is okay, I assure you. If you are with me, you will never have to worry about money again.
Cromwell reaches into a satchel and pulls out a velvet jewelry box...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cromwell? You're not--?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Oh no! Do not be ridiculous, we are still young.
He hands the box to Paige. She opens it, revealing a glittering emerald necklace.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's the most beautiful necklace I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know. That is because it is the most expensive emerald necklace in the world.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I wanted you to know that if you choose to be with me, there is nothing I would not buy for you...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: ...Nothing I would not do for you.
Back in the convention center, Owen dodges and darts through the chaos that is Robo-Con!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've never seen so many nerds! How do I get out of here?!
He sees a glowing `Exit` sign at the far end!
nodes.text_bbcode: He sees a glowing [b]Exit[/b] sign at the far end!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There it is!
Owen tries to move toward the exit, but he's blocked by a huge crowd!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! What is this?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You don't know? The Robo-Strikers are here! They're the cutting edge in robotic soccer!
Owen tries to push through the crowd, but the nerds rebuff him!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Uh, no! Tall, attractive people in the back!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? That's not a rule! Besides, I'm trying to leave!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Well, you're not going to get out this way anytime soon! Not when there are such celebrities afoot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Don't hit me!
He looks around for another way out...
...And that's when he sees the robot obstacle course!
At the end of the course, a large tunnel spills out into the convention center parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm about to do this...
From outside, he quickly traces the maze...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Left, Right, Left! Then it's a clear path through that tunnel to the end, right near the lot!
He ducks into the maze! When he comes to the first fork, he turns...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, Paige loves me. It's gotta be `The Love Ship.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Paige loves me. It's gotta be [color=#e23b3b][i]The Love Ship.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But she's never actually said that she loves you... I mean, as far as I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't you think `Betty's Chowderhouse` might be better? You know, because that's your Grandma's name?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you think [color=#3b78e2][i]Betty's Chowderhouse[/i][/color] might be better? You know, because that's your Grandma's name?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, right. That's way smarter.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Heh. Maybe `I` should be the one going after Paige.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] should be the one going after Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, really...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to sap your confidence. You're going to be fine.
Owen takes a big, deep breath.

nodes.text: You're sure?
