nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You got it!
Owen squats down and lifts L.Y.L.E. up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kevin slides in under L.Y.L.E. and begins tinkering with its motor.
A minute later...
L.Y.L.E. is on its feet, its wires back inside its body, its head swiveling smoothly from side-to-side.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Wheeeeeee.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No... I can't do it! You're making a huge mistake!
Owen walks off! As he leaves, he hears the nerds scrambling to fix L.Y.L.E. without him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Idiots. What do they think they're doing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If something hurts you, you have to protect yourself!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E. has no chance against Paige!
At the mention of Paige's name, it suddenly dawns on Owen why he's so reluctant to put L.Y.L.E. back into the arena!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `I'm` just like L.Y.L.E.! I'm trying to protect `myself!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] just like L.Y.L.E.! I'm trying to protect [color=#e23b3b][i]myself![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He runs back to the nerds!
But when he gets there, it's apparent what has happened.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You guys had to throw in the towel?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We couldn't fix L.Y.L.E. in time!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We needed you, man.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks for all your help!
The nerds pack up what's left of L.Y.L.E. and head to the parking lot. Kimi hangs back to talk to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're sure you're not going to go after Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I would, but... It just doesn't feel right anymore... Not with the Club feeling so down.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh... I guess that's an excuse...
As Owen leaves with the nerds, he realizes without a doubt that...
Owen and Kimi are startled by a loud `BOOM!` as smoke billows out of L.Y.L.E.'s undercarriage!
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen and Kimi are startled by a loud [b]BOOM![/b] as smoke billows out of L.Y.L.E.'s undercarriage!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What happened?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I can't fix L.Y.L.E.'s motor `and` hold him up at the same time! I'm not that strong!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't fix L.Y.L.E.'s motor [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] hold him up at the same time! I'm not that strong!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Erik, hold L.Y.L.E. up so Kevin doesn't blow it up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'd love to, but I'm sort of holding this butane torch for a reason!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Seriously, guys, we've only got like two minutes left!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't look at me, I can't lift crap from this chair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can do it. I can help!
The nerds hesitate for a second...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have a choice?
Owen bends down and starts lifting L.Y.L.E. up off the floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Buuuuuuuuuutt!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Just a little bit more, and I should be able to reach the motor!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Does anyone... `Oof!`... Want to tell me what the time limit is for?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Does anyone... [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]... Want to tell me what the time limit is for?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Round two against Shock'N'Saw! We've got to get L.Y.L.E. ready for more battle!
Owen immediately sets L.Y.L.E. back down!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What are you doing? You almost crushed me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Saboteur!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You guys can't send L.Y.L.E. out there again! It'll be destroyed!
The nerds all share knowing glances with each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owen, we all know what you're going through right now. We've all been there.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I remember my first time at a battlebot competition. I cried when my bot, I Wedge Allegiance, got knocked out.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awww! You cried?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, I was `really` young!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I was [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] young!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: For me, it was Brendizzle Junior.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mine was Father of the Gear.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I miss my first robot everyday... Hope you're doing okay in robot heaven, Robot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We came to the competition knowing we'd probably lose L.Y.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, `it...` You know what I mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, [color=#e23b3b][i]it...[/i][/color] You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We came here with a purpose, Owen. And nothing can deter us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just because Round 1 didn't go according to plan, that doesn't mean we give up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It means we send L.Y.L.E. out there and give that Shock'N'Saw jerk-bot everything we've got in Round 2!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cheesy life lessons aside, we are kind of in a crunch here! So... Little help?!
Kimi slaps Owen across the face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! What is with girls slapping me today?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, I got a little crazy there...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But how could you think she's actually chosen Cromwell?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, she's with him, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, for, like, a day! You think what the two of you had is better than a day with some rich dude?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I don't think that at all.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not the problem here. `She` thinks it. And even if it is wrong...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not the problem here. [color=#e23b3b][i]She[/i][/color] thinks it. And even if it is wrong...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...She made her opinion of me crystal clear at the ball.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'changed'?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's... She's not the Paige I used to know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think whatever's going on at that school has warped her, like a piece of plastic in the sun.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, warp her back, Owen!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's just it. I don't think there's anything `I` can do!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just it. I don't think there's anything [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can do!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think this new Paige is even capable of saying `awwwwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think this new Paige is even capable of saying [color=#e23b3b][i]awwwwww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I just... I know how great you guys would be together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she made her opinion of me crystal clear at the ball.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Okay! I will fight you now for besmirching my honor!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Besmirching? Did you actually just say besmirching?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are afraid then?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What makes you think I am pompous?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Other than of course how much better I am than you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But that is a fact, not an opinion.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I need to point out all the irony?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You think it is wrong to care so much about appearances?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I find this very disturbing considering how much you stick out like a...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Like a very ugly thumb.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No further questions. I rest my case. Scumbag-ism proved!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: If I am a clown with a beaver face as you say...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You are.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then you are the bear that I make do all my tricks for me.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: With a little hat and a tricycle.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What weird circus is this?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And what bizarre website did you find this guy on, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Dear'? Who do you think `you` are?
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Dear'? Who do you think [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! This one is like you, Paige. All fire.
Cromwell grows serious as he catches the look between Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You know my date? How? You are just a lowly wage worker!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it with rich people and insulting me?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And she's not interested in you, believe me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft! I'll decide who `I'm` interested in, thanks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! I'll decide who [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] interested in, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The lady has spoken. You should leave...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But a word of advice... I suggest a different career, like running an oil company or becoming an investment banker.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Anything that does not make you wear such embarrassing clothes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is a tuxedo!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But it is obviously not custom-made. Please, `please` stop talking. I am afraid you will cause yourself more shame.
nodes.text_bbcode: But it is obviously not custom-made. Please, [color=#e23b3b][i]please[/i][/color] stop talking. I am afraid you will cause yourself more shame.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bwahaha! This is the best moment of my life!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, really? This guy? You want to be with this... This...
Owen catches her wrist, her hand an inch from his face!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Careful. Before you do something you regret.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I regret the day I met you. Now let go!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is this man-servant deserving of punishment, Paige, dear?
Owen lets go of Paige's wrist, sizing Cromwell up.
Owen is too slow to react!
Paige slaps him hard across the face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How could you?! After everything I did to come find you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you just listen to me for one--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is this man-servant deserving of punishment, Paige, dear?
In the ballroom of the Debutante Dance, Owen, disguised as a waiter, has just been discovered by Paige!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Owen?! What do you think you're doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just trying to make an honest living. Which reminds me, you still haven't tipped me yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here's a tip... Go jump in the ocean. You'll fit right in with all the other slimy creatures.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Harsh. Even for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Deal with it. I'm `not` a Mary Sue, not like some people.
nodes.text_bbcode: Deal with it. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a Mary Sue, not like some people.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause that even remotely crossed my mind.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, a moment ago, when I was `playing hotel hopscotch,` I actually thought you might be happy to see me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, a moment ago, when I was [color=#e23b3b][i]playing hotel hopscotch,[/i][/color] I actually thought you might be happy to see me.

nodes.text: Paige glares at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I actually thought that you cared about me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? `I do!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]I do![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It sure didn't look like it when you were lip-locked with croissant-haired $ZOE in front of the whole school.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You... You did see the end of the play then, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How long was I gone before you did the whole poor guy, dinner-with-Grandma-Betty routine with her?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you really think I feel the same way about her as I do you?
Paige turns away, trying to hide her feelings.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, that's why I'm really here. To tell you that it was just a stage-kiss. It didn't--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You kissed `her` the same way you kissed `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] the same way you kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't under--
Paige turns back quickly, her hand flying out to slap Owen!
Paige gives Owen's arm a playful punch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think I've taken enough of a beating today, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee!
Owen pulls her in for another kiss, and this one lasts for what seems like forever.
Finally...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Who is that down there with that ruffian?! It better not be one of my girls?!
Whitford descends down the restaurant steps toward Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do we do?! I'm stuck at Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll get you back to Twin Branches, I swear. Until then, we'll make this work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So there is an us?
As Whitford nears, Owen climbs up onto his horse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah. There's definitely an `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah. There's definitely an [color=#e23b3b][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Awwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Awwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He rides off!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 8: Debutante Dance, Part Two!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 8: Debutante Dance, Part Two![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up?
Season 4: Love and Basketball is available in More Episodes now!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
Owen has failed...
`Just so you know...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Just so you know...[/b]

nodes.text: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I care about you more than I've cared about anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up. You're going to make this weird.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I haven't been myself without you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You make me feel... More like me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! `I'll` shut you up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] shut you up!

nodes.text: Paige pulls Owen close!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, I love--
--They kiss! And as they kiss, Paige melts into Owen's arms, trembling.
At long last, they part.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did... Did you just say that you love me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I said, 'I love--' and then you cut me off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say, 'I love the ocean.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're totally right. You can't make me do anything I don't want to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You jerk!
Paige smacks him on the arm!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Hey! I think I've had enough punishment for one day!
Owen expects to get some kind of playful ribbing back from Paige, but instead she just looks out over the water...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Idiot! Tell her how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...
She turns to him, but her eyes go wide! Owen looks behind him and sees a police officer barreling toward him.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You!
The old man who sold Thunder to Owen is huffing and puffing behind Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: That's him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Did you steal this horse?!

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priit!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! No! He let me rent it!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For how much?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Seven bucks!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Ridiculous! My going rate is $100... At least, I think it is... Wait, where am I?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! You're coming with me, horse thief!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen is not a horse thief!
Paige whispers to Owen under her breath...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't steal the horse, did you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why are you all beat up?!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: `I` did that when he tried to steal my horse from me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] did that when he tried to steal my horse from me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Enough out of you! We'll get this settled downtown at the station! Come along!
Monte grabs Owen by the arm and drags him away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait! There's something I have to tell Paige!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Do you want to add resisting arrest to the list of charges you're facing?!
Owen shakes his head and looks back...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should have told her how I felt when I had the chance!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe... Maybe I'll get another opportunity after I get out of this--
Owen's thought is interrupted when he sees Cromwell run down the steps of the restaurant and return to Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Son of a--
But it's too late! They've already reached Officer Monte's police cruiser.
Monte shoves Owen into the back. The old man waggles a finger at Owen from the other side of the glass.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: No one steals my Thunder!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's okay. Paige isn't going to be suckered in by that guy! After all, he beat me up, `and` he snatched her necklace!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay. Paige isn't going to be suckered in by that guy! After all, he beat me up, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] he snatched her necklace!

nodes.text: Meanwhile, back on the beach...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Forgive me, Paige, my dear. I was blind with rage at the thought of losing you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to forgive you that easily. You beat up Owen, `and` you snatched my--
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to forgive you that easily. You beat up Owen, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you snatched my--

nodes.text: Cromwell holds up a pair of car keys.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I bought you a new car for apologies.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Eep! Ohmygosh!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am forgiven?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Oh, yeah. Whatever.
Paige takes the keys, and Cromwell escorts her off!
Many months later...
Paige is sitting on a throne, bedecked in jewels, inside her massive personal mansion.
Two of her servants are riding miniature ponies on a loop around the massive hall.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is boring. Servants! Go buy me some new clothes to try on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this time, make sure they're `all` from Paris!
nodes.text_bbcode: And this time, make sure they're [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] from Paris!

nodes.text: Cromwell arrives.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And how is my queen?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm bored!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Well, maybe my queen would like to travel with me... For once.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your queen is not really interested in traveling with you since all you do is talk about your money!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am `so` sorry for this personal flaw. Here, this is the location of the jet I bought you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry for this personal flaw. Here, this is the location of the jet I bought you.

nodes.text: Cromwell hands Paige a slip of paper with an address on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My own jet?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: This way you may travel without me. But we might still spend time together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Great.
Cromwell kisses Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know you do not love me, but I do not care! Just knowing you are mine is enough!
Cromwell leaves... And in this moment of loneliness, all Paige can think of is Owen...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop, Paige! I'm better off without him. After all, he couldn't even tell me how he felt!
Meanwhile, at Twin Branches, Owen has adopted a rather annoying habit...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hi, Amanda... Just so you know, you're kind of an airhead...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should study more...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?! Why would you say that?!
Amanda runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Jill. Just so you know... You've been here at this school for a long time, and no one knows anything about you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should work on your personality...
Jill runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen! What's gotten into you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I can't help it! Ever since Paige left me, I have to tell everyone the truth!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Otherwise, it might be too late!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you think you're being ridiculous?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, and just so you know, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A lot of people like you, but a lot of people hate you too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? People hate me? Why? I try to be nice to everyone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's exactly why.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if being nice makes people hate me, maybe I should start being mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that what you're saying?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, no, but--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll start with you. You're nothing but a... A horrible person who says mean things!
$ZOE runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't I just tell Paige how I felt...
By now it should be very `very` clear that...
nodes.text_bbcode: By now it should be very [b]very[/b] clear that...

nodes.text: He looks at her for a moment and then out at the water...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, I tried to break into Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You did?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like a dozen times! One time, I even made it all the way to right outside your window.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Creeper!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I overheard you say something about cute, rich boys.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't get jealous, did you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do you think I'm here, battered and bleeding?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think you're here because you care about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, what did you just say?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really going to make me say it again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I'm capable of making you do anything you don't want to do.
Owen reaches out and gently holds Paige's face in his hand.
The pressure Paige applies to his lip eases slightly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's an acting technique. You imagine something that conjures up the emotions you want...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I imagined kissing you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what emotion were you conjuring?
Owen can feel his cheeks flush with color...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Didn't mean anything?!
The pressure on Owen's lip intensifies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow... And no! It didn't! It was just a kiss for the play!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, what about the fact that you kissed `me` the same way?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what about the fact that you kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] the same way?!

nodes.text: The pressure increases even more!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did `that` not mean anything either?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] not mean anything either?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I mean--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!
Paige practically punches Owen again, grinding the washrag into his already torn lip!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Give me that!
Owen snatches it away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you just stop for one second and think about the fact that I came here for you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: On a horse, I might add!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That `was` kinda hot.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] kinda hot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Owen sinks into the sand, he yanks Cromwell's leg, toppling him!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As the two get tangled up in the sand, Cromwell takes a handful and throws it in Owen's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell pulls Owen to his feet!
Cromwell flies backward, falling face first into the sand!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hffff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hffff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen turns to climb the stairs, but...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: My... My eye! Oh my eye! What have you done?!
Cromwell starts writhing in the sand!
Owen runs over to check on him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your eye?! Let me see--
--Cromwell tosses a handful of sand in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell rises to his feet, laughing.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! What a softie!
As Owen struggles to regain vision, Cromwell hits him with a hard uppercut!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen falls backward, stumbling. A kick slams into his chest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And a final, vicious punch cracks Owen's jaw! He stumbles back into a small stream of ocean water...
And then falls to his knees in the muddy sand around it, helpless and exposed!
Cromwell cocks his fist back!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And to all, a good night!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige is running across the sand towards them.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't hit him! Get back! Go away!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But, my dear, I am about to `win` the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, my dear, I am about to [color=#e23b3b][i]win[/i][/color] the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want your dreamy life!
Paige drops down into the sand next to Owen, cradling his face.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But he is muddy. And a weakling. And he has nothing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's got everything I want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's... He's my perfect person.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, now... Now I am the one who is speechless.
He reaches down to Paige, as if pleading with her...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Neither was I until now!
Cromwell snatches the necklace off of Paige's neck!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Thank you for wasting my time!
He storms off, leaving Paige and Owen alone on the beach...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What took you so dang long?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up and come inside so we can get some ice on your face. You don't want it to swell up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The last thing you want is to be poor `and` ugly.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last thing you want is to be poor [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] ugly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least you're not adding insult to injury...
Paige tugs Owen, but he doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about I stay here, not moving, and you bring the ice out to me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Assuming you can do something nice for someone else for once in your life.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll see if I can stomach it... Says the girl who just saved you from getting knocked back to last Tuesday.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much `blood` in my ear canal!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much [color=#e23b3b][i]blood[/i][/color] in my ear canal!

nodes.text: A moment later, Paige and Owen are sitting in the sand while Paige tends to Owen's wounds.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously? Are you just, like, a huge baby?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for `my` honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] honor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just sit still!
A silence settles between them, filled by the sound of the waves crashing against the shore.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... About the kiss you saw between me and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh.
Owen feels Paige adding pressure to his lip.
Owen tries to land a fourth jab, but Cromwell blocks it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Kitchen!
Owen hits Cromwell with a devastating right cross!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell teeters on his feet...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In my grandma's!
Owen is too slow to land a third jab!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Another jab!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Trained!
Owen is too slow to land a second jab!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Owen hits Cromwell with a swift jab to the face!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hkk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hkk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well I!
Missing the opportunity, Cromwell breaks Owen's block and slams Owen with a hard right cross!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You say you trained all over the world?
Owen catches Cromwell's arm with his own!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Huh?!
Surprised, Cromwell leaves himself exposed.
Owen tries to duck down, but he ends up right in the path of the overhand punch!
Cromwell's fist hits him squarely on the temple!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was dumb of me...
Before Cromwell can throw another punch, Owen rises quickly to his feet!
The quick movement catches Cromwell off-guard!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Who is the clown now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If she can handle looking at your ugly, beaver-nosed, dumb-as-dumb-can-get, clown face--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hey!
Owen gallops his horse up to the restaurant and dismounts!

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Prrrrit!
Owen starts to climb the stairs to the balcony when Cromwell descends, blocking him!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You can stop right there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I need to talk to you, Paige!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: --She does not talk to garbage cans like you.
The next afternoon, Sam and $ZOE head into the theater where the drama club is convening. As they walk down the rows of seats to the stage, $ZOE elbows Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm a little nervous...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I did fine last night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You were `great` last night! Just get out there!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? You were [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] last night! Just get out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did seem off last night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I know you can do it, Sam. Your delivery is great. Just don't let anything rattle you.
They come up to the stage where Andrew is shouting directions to anyone and everyone.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Jenna, for this scene, you're supposed to be standing `up` stage right, not `down` stage right! Are you daft?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jenna, for this scene, you're supposed to be standing [color=#e23b3b][i]up[/i][/color] stage right, not [color=#e23b3b][i]down[/i][/color] stage right! Are you daft?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: No, but--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Hannah, what are you thinking of, wearing `that` hideous green costume? This is Shakespeare, not `snake`speare!
nodes.text_bbcode: And Hannah, what are you thinking of, wearing [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] hideous green costume? This is Shakespeare, not [color=#e23b3b][i]snake[/i][/color]speare!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, I--
A guy in all black wearing headphones walks across stage.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And `you`, stagehand!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color], stagehand!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, I'd rather go by Kevin...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Stagehand, what are you doing out here? Your job is to stay `back`stage...
nodes.text_bbcode: Stagehand, what are you doing out here? Your job is to stay [color=#e23b3b][i]back[/i][/color]stage...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Which means I don't have to `see` your face out here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means I don't have to [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] your face out here...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You know I'm in control of sound, right?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Nothing. Not important. Don't worry about it.
Kevin shrugs and walks offstage. Sam and $ZOE approach Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd like to join your production. I saw the poster that said you wanted more actors...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We're just doing the casting right now, so it's good timing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! It's good timing for me too. There's this `scholarship` I want to apply for, and this play is perfect for it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great! It's good timing for me too. There's this [color=#3b78e2][i]scholarship[/i][/color] I want to apply for, and this play is perfect for it!

nodes.text: Andrew's smile fades, and he gives Sam a scornful once over.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: On second thought, we have enough entries already.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you just said it was fine. I'd like to try out for Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Absolutely not. You can't try out for `my` Romeo and Juliet production. Directed by, produced by, written by, and `starring`... Yours truly!
nodes.text_bbcode: Absolutely not. You can't try out for [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] Romeo and Juliet production. Directed by, produced by, written by, and [color=#e23b3b][i]starring[/i][/color]... Yours truly!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'written by'...?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just because Shakespeare was the greatest writer in the English language doesn't mean the text couldn't use a little polishing up by a fellow genius!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just tell me... Why can't I audition?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're not part of the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't know that was a prerequisite...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course it is!
$ZOE steps in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, it isn't. If I recall, none of the paperwork you turned in to the school offices indicated this production was exclusively for the drama club. Therefore, tryouts are open, and Sam is allowed to try out.
Andrew makes a face that looks like he's bitten into a nail.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Way to logic that one through!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: ...All right. `Fine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...All right. [color=#e23b3b][i]Fine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So you `can` try out. But `should` you?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] try out. But [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Tell me something, Sam... Have you ever been the lead actress in a popular production before?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? No...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ever been on a stage before?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For middle school graduation, maybe...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ever done any professional acting before?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Now that we're all done wasting my time. Let's go over the rules...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Rule One: No boys!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Rule Two: No boys!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Rule Three: Any and all misbehavior will have consequences. Rest assured, you `don't` want to find out what those consequences are.
nodes.text_bbcode: Rule Three: Any and all misbehavior will have consequences. Rest assured, you [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want to find out what those consequences are.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That's all you need to know for now!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Brock will be searching each of you to make sure you haven't snuck in any contraband.
As Brock moves down the line of girls, taking their phones, purses, compacts, and everything else they might hold dear...
When the inspection is over, Brock hands Whitford a garbage bag filled with all the girls' valuables.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome to the Butterfly Detention Center, ladies.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Breakfast is at 0600. That's six in the morning. Don't be late!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Rooms. In. Now.
Paige steps inside her room. The door swings closed behind her, clanging shut.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe that this is still the same day... It's... It's still Valentine's Day...
Paige curls up with a single, thin blanket, and tries to stay in the memory of her day with Owen, tries to imagine herself anywhere but where she is.
The next morning, Paige shuffles in line through what was once a fancy cafeteria...
But it has since lost its luster. The chandelier seems to hang by a thread, mold grows along the walls...
And everything feels covered by a fine layer of grime.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Gross! I can't believe I actually miss the Twin Branches's cafeteria!
A flabby woman behind the counter dumps some gray slop into a bowl on Paige's tray.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uck. This place is `so` the worst.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uck. This place is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] the worst.

nodes.text: Paige looks for an empty seat and is surprised to find one in a prime location.
As she sits, she can feel the other girls watching her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Geez. Stare much?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Psst! Paige! What are you doing?
Paige's old friends sit down at the table next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I didn't know all of you were in here! Are you 'troubled' too?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Didn't you know? Everyone's troubled according to Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I wasn't made for this life! I'm too pretty!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I've done so many push ups, my arms look like a guys's!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Never mind that! You shouldn't be sitting there!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no... Is there gum on my seat or something?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: No, that's `her` seat.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, that's [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] seat.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whose?
The doors to the cafeteria fly open, and a furious blonde girl storms in!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Coffee! Why don't I have it already?!
Prissy whispers.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Jessica. She controls `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica. She controls [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A girl sitting next to Paige scrambles over to Jessica with a cup of coffee.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes slow, Amber! Any slower and you would have been on laundry duty!
The girl whimpers meekly and skitters back to her seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm warning `all` of you! Do `not` cross me today!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm warning [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] of you! Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] cross me today!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Those super lucky enough to attend last night's party `know` it was a long night!
nodes.text_bbcode: Those super lucky enough to attend last night's party [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] it was a long night!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I want to do is sit in my--
Jessica trails off when she sees Paige.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, well, well... Someone's sitting in my seat, and her name is Paige, isn't that right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Should I know you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great question! But let's put a pin in that and talk about seating arrangements, okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I sit here. You don't. Got it?
Paige looks at Prissy and the other girls as they implore her with their eyes to give up her seat.
Not wanting to cause trouble, Paige gets up and says...

options.label: I didn't see a name on it, but whatever.

nodes.text: Bryce angrily stomps his way back over to Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Your friend's a real witch, you know that?
Jessica comes back to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing? Bryce is totes cute!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'm not into him! In case it hasn't gotten through your blond follicles, I'm into `Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm not into him! In case it hasn't gotten through your blond follicles, I'm into [color=#3b78e2][i]Owen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, but Owen's not here, is he? It's not like I'm asking you to make little Bryce babies!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew. So much ew.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just make out with him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No way! I'm not like that, Jessica. Not anymore!
Jessica shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If hot college guys don't change your mind, then you're super hopeless!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My offer is way off the table! Forget it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No more invites! No more privileges! And you can forget the phone!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... We're enemies? Is that it?
Just then, Dontae climbs up on a table, poised to leap onto the chandelier!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Swinging time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!
But it's too late! Dontae leaps out and grabs onto the chandelier! It swings out, a snapping sound echoes in the cafeteria...
And then the whole thing comes crashing down! Glass explodes outward with a deafening sound!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You idiot!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on! If Whitford finds out, we're all doomed!
All of them make a break for the nearest door! Paige is the last to reach it.
She's about to get out, when Brock comes charging in!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no!
Without an alternative, she ducks behind a plant!
As Brock takes in the devastation, he begins to moan.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Trouble. Now.
Brock sits down at one of the tables and buries his head in his massive forearms. His huge shoulders heave.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is he... Is he crying?

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Lose. Job. Brock. No feed. Family.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He has a family...
Whitford bursts into the cafeteria! Her keys jangling as she waddles over!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Brock! Did you make this mess?! How many times have I told you to stay out of the cafeteria?!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Not. Brock. Fault.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That's right! It is your fault! You leave me no choice!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're--
Paige steps out from behind the plant!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait! It wasn't Brock's fault! Don't fire him! He was just doing his job like he always does.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige? I can't say that I'm surprised... Was this another one of your misguided escape attempts?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No comment.
Principal Whitford notices a glimmer coming from the floor behind Paige.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: ...What's that?

She steps over, kneels down, and picks up Jessica's monogrammed stereo set. As she rises, her key ring accidentally slips off her belt and lands soundlessly on a balled-up tablecloth lying on the floor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa... Principal Whitford just dropped her keys and didn't notice!
Whitford examines the stereo.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I see now... This wasn't an escape attempt. This was a `party!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I see now... This wasn't an escape attempt. This was a [color=#3b78e2][i]party![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Whitford turns to Brock.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You may keep your job. For this apparent security breach, I order you and Paige to clean up this mess tonight!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Clean. All. Good.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And I'll deal with `J.B.` tomorrow!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'll deal with [color=#3b78e2][i]J.B.[/i][/color] tomorrow!

nodes.text: Paige tries not to let a smile break out across her face as Whitford leaves, the keys still resting on the tablecloth!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She forgot them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is my chance to escape!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And there's no way she'll fire Brock if it's `her` keys I use!
nodes.text_bbcode: And there's no way she'll fire Brock if it's [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] keys I use!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just have to `actually` escape this time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just have to [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] escape this time!

nodes.text: Paige snatches the keys off the table and bolts for the door!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Huh?
She slams it closed, locking it behind her! She races down the hall toward another door that says `G15!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She slams it closed, locking it behind her! She races down the hall toward another door that says [b]G15![/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course! Why `not` have another door here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! Why [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] have another door here?!

nodes.text: `Boom!` Brock pounds on the door she just came from!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Boom![/b] Brock pounds on the door she just came from!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not much time!
She rifles through Whitford's key set, looking for the key labeled...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's that look again! Is Brock... Proud of me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully nothing else goes--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say it! Don't say the `w` word!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't say it! Don't say the [color=#3b78e2][i]w[/i][/color] word!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I'm going on soon...
Throwing the hood over his head, Andrew's mind races as he tries to plan what he's going to do... And that's when Spencer notices him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I, uh... I'm, er...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know Samface sent you to tell me when to get onstage, but I don't take orders, Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He... He thinks I'm Erik!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Indeed, she does, uh, in fact, need you onstage... Uh, Paul Revere... Or whoever!
Spencer stops abruptly in his mid-air jab, narrowing his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why do you sound weird?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh, it's, uh, method acting! I'm pretending to speak in another voice for practice.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But it's still the same ol' me... Ol' Erik...
Inside the security building, Kimi and Principal Whitford watch on the video monitors as $ZOE's car drives off!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What horrible security! Didn't you `just` tell me that I would be perfectly safe if I attended this institution?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What horrible security! Didn't you [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] tell me that I would be perfectly safe if I attended this institution?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes, I did. But--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well?! How do you explain what is obviously one of your students violating curfew so easily?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If it's hard to get in, it should be just as hard to get out!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I assure you. She won't be gone for long. Another one of our students escape--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Er, violated curfew just last week! We apprehended her in only a few hours!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That means Paige `is` here...
nodes.text_bbcode: That means Paige [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] here...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So this happens regularly?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sounds like a nightmare...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sounds like a cause I `might` be interested in funding!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like a cause I [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] be interested in funding!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Delightful.
The alarm continues to sound. Whitford heads for the exit, motioning for Kimi to follow.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Now, I `must` attend to the matter of this missing student at once!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, I [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] attend to the matter of this missing student at once!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I need to enter the code, and the keypad is right here!
Kimi doesn't budge, eying the pad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course. I'd expect nothing less.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No offense, but I don't allow `anyone` to remain in this room without me.
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, but I don't allow [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] to remain in this room without me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then you'll have to make an exception.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why is that?!

options.label: Because I'm concerned for my safety!

nodes.text: The entrance to the hotel is packed with rich vacationers, college kids, and enterprising robotics enthusiasts!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Finding Paige might be harder than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll check us in! I think that's one of my Social Chair duties!
As $ZOE squeezes her way through the crowd and into the hotel, the nerds fight over L.Y.L.E.'s acronym...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It stands for `L`aser-guided g`Y`ro `L`aser `E`mitter!
nodes.text_bbcode: It stands for [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]aser-guided g[color=#e23b3b][i]Y[/i][/color]ro [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]aser [color=#e23b3b][i]E[/i][/color]mitter!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You used 'laser' twice! Plus you can't use whatever letter you want in the words of an acronym!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! If that were true, it could stand for Inte`L`ligent friendl`Y` mechanica`L` dud`E`!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! If that were true, it could stand for Inte[color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]ligent friendl[color=#e23b3b][i]Y[/i][/color] mechanica[color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color] dud[color=#e23b3b][i]E[/i][/color]!

nodes.text: Nearby, Kimi tries to strike up a conversation with Kevin...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's so beautiful here, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What? Oh, yeah. I guess it is.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do you think you might be interested in taking a walk before the competition starts?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Great! It'll be nice. I like getting to know you.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And I like getting to know the competition! Great idea, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, guys, Kimi suggested we walk through the conference center early to feel out the competition for Robo-Con!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When did I suggest that?!
The nerds all nod in agreement. Kevin gives Kimi a pat on the back, and she sighs.
Meanwhile, Owen's heart sinks as he notices the endless row of hotels along the street, each one just as packed with people!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't worry, Owen. You'll find Paige.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, now that you're here, how exactly are you planning on doing that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, Robo-Con starts pretty soon.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just need to sneak away while the guys set up. That should give me enough time to figure out what hotel she's in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And how are you going to do that? Because there are like a million people here.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry! I think this wheelchair might be turning me into a Debbie Downer. Or a Bad News Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. I like that your first instinct is a girl's name.
Before Owen can answer, Kimi approaches him...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey Owen, could I talk to you about something?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! Over here!
$ZOE calls out from the hotel's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The hotel needs everyone's signature for check-in!
As Owen and Kimi push through the crowd, Owen tries to focus on what Kimi's saying.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How did you finally let Paige know that you liked her?
They pass a guy in shades surrounded by girls in bikinis...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Ladies, ladies, ladies. Spring break is here, and that means `Hawk` is in the air!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ladies, ladies, ladies. Spring break is here, and that means [color=#e23b3b][i]Hawk[/i][/color] is in the air!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawwwwwwwkaaaa!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'm sorry, Kimi, what'd you say?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, was there ever a time when you knew you liked her, but she didn't?
They squeeze by some sorority girls.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's `so` hot here. I can't wait to go swimming!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot here. I can't wait to go swimming!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I know! I just got this new bikini that really accentuates my...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sorry, Kimi, one more time...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was `saying,` how did you avoid getting frustrated during this whole Paige thing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]saying,[/i][/color] how did you avoid getting frustrated during this whole Paige thing?!

nodes.text: Near the entrance, a robotic monkey looks up at them.

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Greetings, humans. Do you have the time? My onboard computer is not nearly as fabulous as your human clothing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm going to find you, Paige. I promise!
An hour later, after checking in...
The members of the Robotics Club are setting up for Robo-Con in the convention center!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ben, are you ready to turn L.Y.L.E. into a battle bot?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've been waiting to hear those words all day!
While the nerds tinker with L.Y.L.E., Owen pulls Kimi aside...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Can you promise me you won't flip out when I tell you what I'm about to tell you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Totally. I promise. I'll be super cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm going to go look for Paige now and--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeep! This is `so` romantic! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeeep! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] romantic! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're flipping out.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh! Ahem. Right. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Can you cover for me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! I'd do anything to get you and Paige together! Even if you asked me to dig a hole in the middle of the desert, I wouldn't ask why!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... Thanks, Kimi! I appreciate it.
Owen steps away from the main convention center area and heads for a large bank of computers. He sits at one of them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... Internet. I guess I'll just, uh, mouse this browser first?
Erik wanders by, eating a hot dog. He stops when he sees Owen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Owen! Shouldn't you be helping the others set up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Shouldn't `you` be helping the others set up?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Shouldn't [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] be helping the others set up?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Touche, good sir! Touche!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My excuse is hot dogs! What's yours?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm trying to find Paige. She's going to be at one of the hotels here for a fancy dance.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho boy! Isn't that an amazing coincidence! You happened to join the Robotics Club and Paige just happened to be here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What a delightfully teeny tiny world we live in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um, yeah... About that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Unless of course... You joined the Robotics Club just so you could be here this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But my good buddy Owen is much too honorable to do something that devious and underhanded!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, actually, I...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... So, you... You did lie to us?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess in a way, yes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I kinda thought you wanted to join the Robotics Club because you and I had so much fun on the basketball team together...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Looks like I made a mistake...
Erik turns away sadly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, wait! It's not like that! I want to find Paige, but I also...

nodes.prompt: I want to find Paige, but I also...

menu.text: I want to find Paige, but I also...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How can you offer me all this when you don't even know me?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What is there to know?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are more beautiful than the necklace I have given you.
Paige blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: More full of life than any of the girls I have met all over the world.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How many girls?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Never mind that.
Cromwell takes Paige's hands into his own.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: As you may know, I have lots and lots of money.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You may have mentioned that.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But I have no one to share it with. No perfect person to love the way I love my money.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But you are that perfect person.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know that I will love you because I don't care that you only have one mansion.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: A girl like you is precious, and I would do anything to protect you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, if I had to, in a very bizarre circumstance, I would jump through hoops for you!
As Owen reaches the end of the tunnel, he trips a sensor!
Three large hoops descend from the ceiling, forming an unavoidable path out!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've `got` to be kidding.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding.

nodes.text: The hoops burst into flames!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Please! Go back to not on fire!
Owen looks back down the tunnel the other way.

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: I would not go that way. Hot. Hooooooooot.
Owen steels himself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm here for a reason. The nerds wouldn't give up. I won't either!
He sprints down the tunnel, toward the hoops, his legs pumping furiously! When he gets to the end, he...
Owen tries to get by Cromwell, but Cromwell shoves him back.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are not so good at listening.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not here to fight you, man.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then you are in for a rough time, because I am going to fight you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why? Are you afraid of what I might say to Paige?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She did not like whatever you said to her last time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She doesn't like what I say to her `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She doesn't like what I say to her [color=#e23b3b][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige stifles a laugh, and Cromwell shoots her an angry look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? It's true.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just going to talk to her for five minutes, and then I'll be out of your over-groomed hair.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You seem to still think that is an option.
Cromwell gives Owen another shove, pushing him back to the sand.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, really? He won't even let me `talk` to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, really? He won't even let me [color=#e23b3b][i]talk[/i][/color] to you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That is enough!
Cromwell punches Owen in the gut, causing Owen to double over!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof... Still you, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are not going to fight back?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you...
Owen rises to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not here to fight.
Cromwell socks Owen hard in the face, knocking him backwards and cutting open his lip!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are what they call a weakling then.
Cromwell calls back to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: He does not fight because he is obviously no match...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: While I have trained all over the world!
Cromwell turns his attention back to Owen, and rears back, throwing a hard, overhand punch!
This time, Owen...

nodes.text: The gathered actors are quiet... Then all of them burst into chatter!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Out of order? What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the `theme` of reversals.
nodes.text_bbcode: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the [color=#3b78e2][i]theme[/i][/color] of reversals.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be `reversals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be [color=#3b78e2][i]reversals![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, uh-oh! I don't deal well with sudden change!
Erik begins breathing heavily.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is it too bright in here? Am I still human? Where am I!
Owen claps Erik hard on the back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Breathe, Ericson. Breathe. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Change! I love change!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So with this new script... Does this mean we can put in a scene where I kiss Lady Capulet?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `wish.` There is `nowhere` in the play where you'd be kissing my character!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]wish.[/i][/color] There is [color=#3b78e2][i]nowhere[/i][/color] in the play where you'd be kissing my character!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As if I'd let him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does that mean we'd be switching roles too? I can be other things than just the Nurse, I promise!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I am a little confused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What does that even mean? How are we doing that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, the theme of my play is about 'reversals'. But the only reversal in my play is that I'm playing the male character Tybalt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to rearrange the play so that the deaths come first, and then we recount the story of Romeo and Juliet's love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last and most important scene will be their `kiss` on the balcony.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last and most important scene will be their [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] on the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Do I still get to do my sword-fighting scene?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! And don't worry too much guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it'll be easy because you already...

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! `Cough! Cough!` Bet you can't catch me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] Bet you can't catch me!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!
Brock starts lumbering toward Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh oh! He's even faster than I thought!
Emily runs along the concrete path as fast as she can toward the security building, remembering...
Emily sprints for the...
Emily limps for the...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Are you okay?! You look awful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm `never` doing this again. Just drive.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] doing this again. Just drive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Kimi has to be doing better than us, right?
As $ZOE speeds off, she gives Emily a quick glance.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A friend? I can be a great friend!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, buddy. Is it too much to ask for your help finding Paige? I know the guys probably need you to work on L.Y.L.E....

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No biggie! I'm the repair guy, and battling isn't till the end of Robo-Con! I got time to spare, O-dog!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, probably shouldn't call me that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It felt funny as soon as it left my mouth. What can I help you with first?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do you need me to drive a getaway car? Use my athletic prowess to leap over a wall? Or act the part of a loose-moraled hussy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I could just use some help with the internet. I'm not exactly a computer wizard. Could you look something up for me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure thing! I love web surfing! It's my second favorite sport after basketball!
Erik licks mustard and ketchup off of his fingers and sits down next to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you searching for?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm actually looking for a hotel in the area...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And what are the parameters?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Expensive, for sure. Also, it needs to be on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it should be big enough to have a dance hall or a ballroom.
Erik's fingers dance on the keyboard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! My search has turned up `four` hotels!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! My search has turned up [color=#e23b3b][i]four[/i][/color] hotels!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What does it say about each one?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, there's `The Cottage...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's [color=#e23b3b][i]The Cottage...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'A cozy hotel reminiscent of a bed and breakfast. Every room decorated in gold trim. Step out of your room and onto the sand!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How lovely!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What else?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Next is `Roundabout...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Next is [color=#e23b3b][i]Roundabout...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'Luxury is now at your fingertips. Our beachfront property spans more acreage than any hotel in Centerscore Beach!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Impressive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay. Next.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Al's Austere Hotel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Al's Austere Hotel...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'Hey, folks. Love the beach?! Love the dance floor?! Al's Austere Hotel offers prices so low you'll shout YOLO when you see them!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow. I don't think I'd ever shout that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the last one?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Groviere...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Groviere...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Most of their site's in French. Something about chandeliers, the waltz, and not having to deal with the pesky, pesky ocean.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Very French.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which one do you think we should go to?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great work, everyone! And just in time, too! The next round's starting right now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Get ready to see the fruits of your manly sweat, O-dog!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd love to, but--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But?
The nerds all turn to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I kinda sorta am leaving you all again... Please don't hate me.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?! But this is probably the last we'll see of L.Y.L.E.!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, but I just learned something... Something pretty huge, actually.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I came here for a purpose... To get Paige back...
Kimi gasps.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And just like you guys and L.Y.L.E., I got completely crushed in the first round.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeeeeeee--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But just like you guys with L.Y.L.E, I need to go back out there...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Eeeeeeeeep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if it means getting completely crushed again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I think I can speak for most of us, especially Kimi, when I say, 'Why are you still talking to us?! Go find her!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! And disrupt her power circuits! Er... Whatever the metaphorical equivalent of that is!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The rule might be ro-bros before--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Er... But I've also heard people say it's romance before platonic relationships...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's also not a phrase that anyone has used. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, gotta go! L.Y.L.E.... Good luck!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: You too, human.
Owen takes off through the convention center, but before he can make much progress, Kimi grabs him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! I'm so excited! But...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm surprised there's a 'but' to that sentence.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But second! How are you going to find Paige? The Debutante Dance is probably over by now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, you're totally right. Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if I know Paige, she's probably out with that Cromwell doof.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that means they're somewhere rich people go, somewhere she can get him to spend money on her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's still kind of vague...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But she also wasn't interested in the food I was serving. I bet she made Cromwell take her out to a fancy restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have internet access on your phone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Captain 1950's, of course.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, tell me the name of fancy restaurants along the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Here's one called `The Love Ship.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Here's one called [color=#3b78e2][i]The Love Ship.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's another called `Anglers Away.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's another called [color=#3b78e2][i]Anglers Away.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: One called `Betty's Chowderhouse.`
nodes.text_bbcode: One called [color=#3b78e2][i]Betty's Chowderhouse.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And a smaller place just called `Max's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And a smaller place just called [color=#3b78e2][i]Max's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It sounds egotistical, but I'm positive she'd pick one that would remind her of me...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even subtly... But which one?
Sam turns around to face the stage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right, $ZOE. I did not read the entire play through three times, just to be rebuffed by a skinny geek in glasses!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam strides angrily up the aisle to the lip of the stage and...
She has failed.

nodes.text: Right before lunch, $ZOE, Sam, and Kevin stand behind a table, each holding a stack of flyers for the auditions that afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The bell's going to ring in a minute... What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First, you're going to relax... When the bell rings, we're going to hand out flyers as people come in. Just smile and tell people it's a great opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are the chances we'll get enough people to try out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Our chances are solid. People `love` drama.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our chances are solid. People [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] drama.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...Yeah, we're always kicking people out of auditions, the lines are so long.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Do you really want to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't tell me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: But surely you two have `some` friends you can try to get onboard, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: But surely you two have [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] friends you can try to get onboard, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Riiight...
The bell for lunch rings, and as students flood the cafeteria, $ZOE and Sam step forward.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look alive!

options: Sell the play as an opportunity!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you think about the boys?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's tougher. The male characters have a bigger role than the female characters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The three biggest male roles in the play after Romeo are the `proud Count Paris,` the `honest Friar Lawrence,` and the `sword-fighting Mercutio.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The three biggest male roles in the play after Romeo are the [color=#3b78e2][i]proud Count Paris,[/i][/color] the [color=#3b78e2][i]honest Friar Lawrence,[/i][/color] and the [color=#3b78e2][i]sword-fighting Mercutio.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think Colt, Erik, and Spencer are our best bets for these roles. But which one should be which?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We can't just do a random shuffle?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Since no one here has formal experience, we have to make sure they are the right characters, so it's easy for them to act out the role.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are everyone's traits?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, Colt is `arrogant,` Erik is `truthful`, and Spencer is `athletic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Colt is [color=#3b78e2][i]arrogant,[/i][/color] Erik is [color=#3b78e2][i]truthful[/i][/color], and Spencer is [color=#3b78e2][i]athletic.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you put it like that, we can match them up easily enough...
