nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Sam bursts out of the auditorium and races to the swim center.
Coach Kessler is writing things down on his clipboard while he waits for Emily to change in the locker rooms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach Kessler? If I could have a word?
He looks up.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What do you want, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, Coach, you pulled Emily out of my auditions fast. Let me explain the situation to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd like to have Emily join my production of Shakespeare. She's a `great` actress.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd like to have Emily join my production of Shakespeare. She's a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] actress.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Absolutely not.
In the face of his resistance, Sam nearly backs down...
But then she thinks of all her dreams and what she wants... And she sets her teeth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach Kessler, Emily's acting may seem like a distraction to you, but it's something that will help her later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is about Emily's...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Through that door is another locked door. Even if you have the key to it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: By the time you think you've finally made it, Brock will grab you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But, hey, I could be lying!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock.
Principal Whitford calls from the top of the hill.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Brock?! Where'd you go?! Have you found her yet?!
Paige clasps her hands together, pleading with her eyes, but knowing it's hopeless, knowing she'll never see Owen again...
And then Brock grins ever so subtly and calls out to Whitford.

As Paige huddles under her blanket, trying to go back to sleep, she knows...
Ahead, she can see the lights of the city!

But the lights are suddenly blotted out by the imposing silhouette of Brock!
And then, just when she can take no more, it begins to recede! She slowly climbs her way out!
The mud clears away from her face, then her waist, then her elbows, and finally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope they don't mind that we're not Ben and Emily...
But all her worries are replaced with sheer nervousness when Owen starts soliloquizing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `See, how she leans her cheek upon her hand!

Owen stares at her, and $ZOE realizes it's her line!
Onstage, $ZOE stares up into Owen's eyes as their characters bid their adieus.

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That I shall say good night till it be morrow...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: This is it...
She rises up on her toes, and their lips meet. She thinks of a kiss from her past, from someone who she loved once...
Emily dashes out of her hiding spot and sprints...

Where she finds Jessica at the center of a crowd of guys.

nodes.text: There you are! I was wondering if you'd bother showing up.
She turns away from the boys to address Paige fully.

nodes.text: Of course I will. Whitford just had this interesting notion that I'd be trouble tonight.

Paige sizes the three boys up.

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priiit!

nodes.text: I... I like what you're saying, Cromwell.

nodes.text: Everywhere and nowhere. The world is my home. We can explore it together!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I `want?`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I [color=#3b78e2][i]want?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Paaaaaaaige! Paaaaaaaige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Am I that hung up on Owen? Now I'm hearing his voice...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be stupid, Paige.
Paige casually turns, looking down along the beach...
Her voice catches in her throat. Owen is there, riding up to her on a magnificent stallion!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige!

nodes.text: I see trouble has returned.

nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.text: What if I wanted to live in a mansion all my own?

nodes.text: What if I wanted jewelry, like this emerald piece, every day?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted--

nodes.text: --Paige, you will want for nothing, `need` for nothing.
nodes.text_bbcode: --Paige, you will want for nothing, [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] for nothing.

nodes.text: And there is no obstacle that I would let get in the way of your happiness...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How is this even related to monkeys?!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: None of your monkey business, enemy!

nodes.text: Uh, turn off, now! Not an enemy!

nodes.text: Does not compute!

nodes.text: Uh, stop the trap!

He twists his way through the maze, reaching the beginning of the large, pitch-black tunnel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was easy! Now all I have to do is get to the end of the tunnel, and I'll be on my way to Paige!

nodes.text: We came to the competition knowing we'd probably lose L.Y.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, `it...` You know what I mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, [color=#e23b3b][i]it...[/i][/color] You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We came here with a purpose, Owen. And nothing can deter us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just because Round 1 didn't go according to plan, that doesn't mean we give up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It means we send L.Y.L.E. out there and give that Shock'N'Saw jerk-bot everything we've got in Round 2!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cheesy life lessons aside, we are kind of in a crunch here! So... Little help?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm about to do this...
From outside, he quickly traces the maze...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Left, Right, Left! Then it's a clear path through that tunnel to the end, right near the lot!
He ducks into the maze! When he comes to the first fork, he turns...
A moment later, Paige and Owen are sitting in the sand while Paige tends to Owen's wounds.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously? Are you just, like, a huge baby?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for `my` honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] honor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just sit still!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... About the kiss you saw between me and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! What a softie!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!`

nodes.text: What?!

nodes.text: Don't hit him! Get back! Go away!

nodes.text: But, my dear, I am about to `win` the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want your dreamy life!

nodes.text: But he is muddy. And a weakling. And he has nothing.

nodes.text: He's got everything I want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's... He's my perfect person.

nodes.text: Paige, now... Now I am the one who is speechless.

nodes.text: Neither was I until now!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Thank you for wasting my time!

nodes.text: What took you so dang long?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up and come inside so we can get some ice on your face. You don't want it to swell up.

nodes.text: The last thing you want is to be poor `and` ugly.

nodes.text: At least you're not adding insult to injury...
Paige tugs Owen, but he doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about I stay here, not moving, and you bring the ice out to me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Assuming you can do something nice for someone else for once in your life.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll see if I can stomach it... Says the girl who just saved you from getting knocked back to last Tuesday.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much `blood` in my ear canal!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much [color=#e23b3b][i]blood[/i][/color] in my ear canal!

nodes.text: Cromwell flies backward, falling face first into the sand!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hffff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hffff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen turns to climb the stairs, but...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: My... My eye! Oh my eye! What have you done?!
Cromwell starts writhing in the sand!
Owen runs over to check on him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your eye?! Let me see--
--Cromwell tosses a handful of sand in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell rises to his feet, laughing.
Owen has failed...
`Just so you know...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Just so you know...[/b]

nodes.text: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think you're here because you care about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, what did you just say?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really going to make me say it again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I'm capable of making you do anything you don't want to do.
Owen reaches out and gently holds Paige's face in his hand.

nodes.title: The Play
nodes.subtitle: Can Sam land the role of her life?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nick.
It's the morning, right before school, and Nick and Sam are studying for the S.E.T.s in the bustling school cafeteria.
Nick takes a long sip of his favorite blend of fair-trade coffee and turns a page in his test preparation book.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay... Next question.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Another one? How many are there?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We have at least twenty more, and that's just the end of the math section.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great.
Sam tears off a piece of her scratch paper, balls it up, and tosses it against the wall where it falls to the ground and bounces away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, you know what would make this more fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Drilling screws into my brain?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, `no`, that sounds barbaric.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color], that sounds barbaric.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was `joking`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]joking[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I meant to say, before you so rudely interrupted me with your talk of medieval torture, was that we could make it a game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What kind of game?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, we can see how many questions we can answer...

nodes.prompt: We can see how many questions we can answer...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We can see how many questions we can answer...

nodes.text: That night, Sam is practicing lines from 'Romeo and Juliet' with Zoe.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's go over the balcony scene one more time. I think you could do Juliet a little better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, the balcony scene? Can't we go back to the sword fight scene? `That` was cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, the balcony scene? Can't we go back to the sword fight scene? [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Juliet's the main female lead. She's the one you'll be auditioning for.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I'm Romeo. I say... `When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds and sails upon the bosom of the air...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm Romeo. I say... [color=#3b78e2][i]When he bestrides the lazy-puffing clouds and sails upon the bosom of the air...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, `bosom`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, [color=#3b78e2][i]bosom[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's your line, Sam?
Sam clasps her hands to her heart.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deny thy father and refuse thy name... Or if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deny thy father and refuse thy name... Or if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, you're really good! There's just one thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You look angry when you say them. If you want to be Juliet, you need to look like you're in love!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's hard to look love-struck with these flowery phrases.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Juliet is happy. This is the most romantic scene!
Sam rolls her eyes just as her phone buzzes with an incoming text from Nick. It reads, 'can we talk? please?'
She shoves her phone away without texting back, frowning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just not in the mood for romance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How long are you going to keep ignoring your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, let's not go there. Nick and I haven't had the boyfriend-girlfriend talk. All we do is hang out, and sometimes, we make out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm not 'ignoring' him... It's more like I'm putting off answering his texts until never.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, Sam... You really should talk to him and clear things up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I kind of don't want to 'clear things up'. What is he going to say? 'I'm sorry I called you the name of my perfect past girlfriend'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, $ZOE. This morning, when he called me Sara, it brought up all these feelings. I mean, the reason I broke up with him the first time is because of her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes... It is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And do you know what I said to him then? I said that we couldn't be together because I wanted to be `number one` in some guy's life for once. Not second place. Not `the other girl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And do you know what I said to him then? I said that we couldn't be together because I wanted to be [color=#3b78e2][i]number one[/i][/color] in some guy's life for once. Not second place. Not [color=#3b78e2][i]the other girl.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But since this morning, I keep wondering... Am I just the runner-up? Is he dating me because she's gone? Does he still love her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a lot of questions that I don't have answers for...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know. But you never will if you don't talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... But it's not going to be tonight. Can we go back to the play?
Sam props her play book open, studying it intently, and $ZOE does the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you still look angry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't `do` 'romance' well...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] 'romance' well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's `Romeo and Juliet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But it's [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo and Juliet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I just think Shakespeare should have gotten more creative and added zombies... It's hard to look 'in love' when you're fighting off the undead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... Unfortunately for you, it's just boring old Romeo and Juliet. Let's try this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it helps to have the right mindset when you're acting. So you should try to think of things that inspire certain emotions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you do the balcony scene, think of something you love... Like, uh, N--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say 'Nick'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wasn't! I was going to say, uh, '`Nightmare` in Zombietown'... Your favorite movie. That's something you love.
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't! I was going to say, uh, '[color=#3b78e2][i]Nightmare[/i][/color] in Zombietown'... Your favorite movie. That's something you love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay. When I see Romeo onstage, I'll think of `Zombietown.` Any other good advice? What do I do if I'm sad? Or really really happy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, okay. When I see Romeo onstage, I'll think of [color=#3b78e2][i]Zombietown.[/i][/color] Any other good advice? What do I do if I'm sad? Or really really happy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you're sad, then think of a sad thing like...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Nick and Sara?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nick and Sara?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That might be `too` sad, but... Sure.
nodes.text_bbcode: That might be [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] sad, but... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if you want to be happy, then think of something that brings you joy... Like... `Meat pizza!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you want to be happy, then think of something that brings you joy... Like... [color=#3b78e2][i]Meat pizza![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's getting pretty late. Let's run the three Juliet scenes one more time and then go to bed. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah!
Sam flips to the right page in the play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just do what $ZOE told you... To show the right emotions, think of the right cues...

nodes.title: Casting Call
nodes.subtitle: Will Sam and $ZOE pull together the right cast?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Before school, Sam sits nervously in a conference room with Andrew and Ms. Macbeth, a representative from the Shakespeare Scholarship Foundation.
Under the table, Sam nervously rubs her sweaty palms on her jeans.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't have enough time to prepare for this. Heck, I barely got the paperwork done. But this scholarship is my ticket to college... I have to try to make a good impression...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or, at least, a better impression than `Andrew.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or, at least, a better impression than [color=#3b78e2][i]Andrew.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth clears her throat and throws her hands out in greeting.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Excellent morning! Thank you for joining me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, Andrew, I'm `most` enchanted to meet you both! How could I not be when meeting the two enterprising students who are working so diligently to earn the 'Romeo and Juliet' scholarship?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, Andrew, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]most[/i][/color] enchanted to meet you both! How could I not be when meeting the two enterprising students who are working so diligently to earn the 'Romeo and Juliet' scholarship?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm quite enchanted to meet you too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, me three!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Great! Let's go around with introductions. I'll go first. I'm Beth Macbeth, and I love studying all things Shakespeare.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The themes of political transition, his extensive use of free form iambic pentameter, the role reversal when female characters were portrayed by men...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It's all so intellectually stimulating!
She stops and gestures to Sam and Andrew. Sam sees Andrew open his mouth to jump in...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Later that afternoon...
Kevin adjusts lights and microphones while, onstage, $ZOE and Sam speak to a group of people who have shown up for the auditions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello everyone, and welcome to the auditions for Romeo and Juliet! We're so happy you can make it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In case you don't know, this play is the story of two star-crossed lovers, Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet, who are kept apart by their warring families.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're casting all the roles today. If all of you could just be patient, we'll call you up when we're ready.
$ZOE and Sam leap offstage and sit in the front row of seats, facing the stage.
$ZOE nods at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, we can start calling in people whenever you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First on the list... Erik Ericson!
Erik stumbles onstage and nervously adjusts his glasses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heya, everyone... For my audition, I've been practicing some jokes I found in an old book! Here goes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Knock, knock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A guy who looks just like me! What a coincidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No? Not funny? Well, they're not for everyone! Next joke!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How many Twin Branches students does it take to change a lightbulb?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Probably one! After all, we are pretty strong in the sciences.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is the mic on? Whatever! Here's another one for you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, uh, I haven't spoken with my `wife` in twenty years... It's not that we've fought. I just don't like to interrupt her.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, uh, I haven't spoken with my [color=#e23b3b][i]wife[/i][/color] in twenty years... It's not that we've fought. I just don't like to interrupt her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, your `wife?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yikes, your [color=#3b78e2][i]wife?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Sam try to listen, but his jokes get worse and worse...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I've been trying to grow a beard... But my timing's off. My five o'clock shadow's more of a half past six!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Next up we have... Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: As a professional flirter, I brought in some original one-liners... The best of my best!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `can't` wait. Go on...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] wait. Go on...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: How's it going, Sam? Has anyone ever told you that you're like a bump in the carpet?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Because you made me trip and fall hard... For `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you made me trip and fall hard... For [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right... Spencer's here for his audition.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know I'd make a good actor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: When I'm playing defense in football, you know, it's all about psyching the other person out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it was nothing to do with the fact that you're a hundred pounds heavier than everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That too, but to really tackle someone, they have to see pain in your eyes. The pain you're going to inflict on them once the play starts.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm good at projecting that pain.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's in the `eyes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's in the [color=#e23b3b][i]eyes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'll take it... Next!
Colt and Denni walk onstage next.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt! What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can have more than one ex-boyfriend on this cast at a time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... That's what I thought. I'll just be going then...
He tries to walk off, but Denni hooks him back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sam, I have a favor to ask... Colt needs one last thing to round out his application for community college, and this could be his best chance...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And it sounds like you needed some help, so we wanted to try out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I have an internship that I'm involved with, but other than that, I'd be entirely devoted to the play! We both would.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You understand, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. Go ahead. Try out...
Denni nods at Colt who clears his throat, puts on his best face, and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `To be... Or not to be... That is the question...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]To be... Or not to be... That is the question...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer, the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer, the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After Denni and Colt step offstage, $ZOE calls for a break.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's... Take five. That was way too intense.
As Sam and Kevin get up to talk to people and get water, $ZOE leans back in her chair and sighs, contemplating the cast list.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds like you've got the weight of the world on your shoulders there, $ZOE.
She turns around to see that Owen has slipped into the seat behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen! You're here! Are you going to try out?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, uh... I was here to watch Spencer. I'm not really an... On-stage person. Besides, I have other things to do, like, um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like what? Football's over. And so is basketball. What else do you do? Bake?
Owen snorts with laughter, and the sound warms $ZOE's heart.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just because I leave the baking up to you, Miss Cupcake, doesn't mean that I can't make a good muffin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, really? I'm going to need you to prove that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You doubt my muffin-making capabilities?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just say I saw what you donated to my bake sale when I was becoming Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There is just no love at all with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But really... If you have time, we could really use your help in this play... I'd be happy to work with your schedule. Is it your grandmother?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it school?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're spending all your time thinking of ways to free Paige from Monarch Prep...
She smiles, but her smile fades when she sees the look on his face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe it's a stupid idea, but I want to see how she's doing. I've even driven up there a couple of times by myself to look for a way to sneak in. But it's like a fortress...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, join the play. It will...

nodes.title: Paige Against The Machine
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige escape from Monarch Prep?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Back in time, on the night of Valentine's...
After her `outing` with Owen, Paige is caught by her mother, Margot, and Margot's fiance, Tad...
nodes.text_bbcode: After her [b]outing[/b] with Owen, Paige is caught by her mother, Margot, and Margot's fiance, Tad...

nodes.text: Paige twists out of her mother's hold and glares at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can ground me, you can cancel my credit cards, you can send me away to Monarch Prep, but you can't take today away from me. Especially not after this!
Paige ducks under Tad's hand and runs after Owen.
She grabs his hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, so you're a jerk with a two-dollar hair cut and a terrible fashion sense...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? You ran after me to tell me that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why else would I do it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For this.
He pulls her into a tender, passionate, and powerful kiss, his hands warm against her neck and waist.
Their lips part, catching breath, and as they converge to kiss once more--
Tad grabs Paige and yanks them apart!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Catch you later!
He runs off, and Paige smiles wickedly as she follows her parents into the house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `So` worth the grounding I'm about to get!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So[/i][/color] worth the grounding I'm about to get!

nodes.text: Once inside, Margot whirls on Paige angrily, the veins on her forehead throbbing!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I have never been more embarrassed in my life than by that willful display you just put on!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Entirely too willful, this one!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You made me feel like a bad mother, when `you're` the one who violated `my` trust with that awful party!
nodes.text_bbcode: You made me feel like a bad mother, when [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the one who violated [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] trust with that awful party!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Dreadfully low class.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `You're` the one who disobeyed `me` by violating your punishment today!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] the one who disobeyed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] by violating your punishment today!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Disobedient indeed!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And `you're` the one on my own foyer kissing that raggedy-looking `boy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the one on my own foyer kissing that raggedy-looking [color=#3b78e2][i]boy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: He even `smells` poor!
nodes.text_bbcode: He even [color=#e23b3b][i]smells[/i][/color] poor!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. Spare me the melodrama and just tell me how long I'm grounded for!
Margot's eyes spark with a fury that unsettles Paige... As if they say: `This will be more than just a grounding.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Margot's eyes spark with a fury that unsettles Paige... As if they say: [b]This will be more than just a grounding.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mom...
Over the next few weeks, time marches on for Paige and Owen, marked not by minutes, but by mysteries, near misses, and frustrations.
On the day after the Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...You didn't happen to hear anything about Paige, did you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... She didn't show up last night?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, she didn't.
He looks at his phone like he's lost a lifeline.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen--
The sound of Owen's phone beeping interrupts her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's from Paige... 'Owen, stop texting. I don't ever want to talk to you again. Delete my number.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She must... She must have changed her mind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Changed her mind about what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: About me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The text `is` pretty mean. She might be joking.
nodes.text_bbcode: The text [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] pretty mean. She might be joking.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm not accepting this. If she doesn't like me, then she has to--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `--'Tell me to my face?'` Are those not the words you shouted back at me during your latest escape attempt?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]--'Tell me to my face?'[/i][/color] Are those not the words you shouted back at me during your latest escape attempt?

nodes.text: Paige is in Principal Whitford's office. Brock looms behind her, his breathing audible.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Not going to answer? I'll refresh your memory. You were about to leap into the school dumpster from a second-story window!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I said, 'If you dive into that dumpster, you'll regret it!' And then you said, 'Why don't you tell me to my face?'

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, here I am, and you `are` going to regret it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, here I am, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] going to regret it!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're just lucky Brock caught you where he did.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Had you made it outside, your punishment would be far more severe.

nodes.title: The Show Must Go On
nodes.subtitle: Can Sam beat Andrew and win the scholarship?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Sam, $ZOE, and Kevin are sitting front and center at the stage production of 'Romeo and Juliet With Zombies: And Andrew'!
Onstage, Jenna as Juliet soliloquizes above Andrew as Romeo. Andrew lies still in a fake tomb, pretending to be dead.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `This... Is my sheath!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This... Is my sheath![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Jenna's about to plunge the prop dagger into her heart, Andrew lumbers up from the tomb he lays on...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Un... Uhnnn...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Un... Uhnnn...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: While Andrew makes zombie moans in iambic pentameter, $ZOE leans over to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I literally have no idea where the end of this play is going to go...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shhh! This is exactly the part I've been waiting to see...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `So plague taketh love... To its timely end!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So plague taketh love... To its timely end![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew shuffles over to Jenna and pretends to consume her brains...
And the curtain closes.
Applause resounds loudly through the theater.
Ms. Macbeth stands, excitedly bringing her hands together.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Bravo!
A few seats down, $ZOE, Sam, and Kevin stand up and head into the lobby of the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was `so` gruesomely realistic!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] gruesomely realistic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The part where Hannah says, `an undead plague upon both your houses`, was a pretty good line.
nodes.text_bbcode: The part where Hannah says, [color=#3b78e2][i]an undead plague upon both your houses[/i][/color], was a pretty good line.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And the way the zombies shambled after their victims and fed on their heads...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `So` surprisingly good.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] surprisingly good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, great.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You didn't like it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I `loved` it. I `love` zombie anything, really. But... It's `Andrew's play.` This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] it. I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] zombie anything, really. But... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Andrew's play.[/i][/color] This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And everyone was so into it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: His play wasn't `that` great...
nodes.text_bbcode: His play wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] great...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you're trying to make me feel better, $ZOE. It's okay that Andrew's play was successful.
There's a slow clap behind her, and Sam glares at Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Admitting your defeat already? You can always withdraw. It's never too late.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Andrew, how do you keep slithering up that way?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, `shrew!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam bites back whatever choice words she has to say to Andrew when she spots Ms. Macbeth walking over to them.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew, congratulations on a theatrical success!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why, thank you, Ms. Macbeth! I strive for excellent theater.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unlike `others` in my peer category...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlike [color=#e23b3b][i]others[/i][/color] in my peer category...

nodes.text: He sneers at Sam, and $ZOE puts her arm on Sam's hand to stop her cousin from growling.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, what did you think of the play?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I `probably` shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]probably[/i][/color] shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?

nodes.text: And elsewhere...
Paige says good-bye to Grandma Betty and steps out of Owen's house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A play? Owen's in a play? This sucks! Of all the stupid nights for him not to be home, right where I want him.
Sucking in a deep breath, Paige turns onto a main road...
And runs as fast as she can towards Twin Branches...
You are now playing as Andrew.
Andrew watches the play with incredulity.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She is actually pulling the role reversal thing off! That shrew and her stupid troupe are actually managing to perform a half decent play!
He looks over at Ms. Macbeth who is watching the play intently, stopping to scribble notes.
Glancing at the paper, Andrew can make out words like 'wonderful' and 'splendid!' written in the column.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I didn't come this far to see her win!
Right before the play's final scene, Andrew sneaks out of his seat...
...And slips backstage. He hides behind a curtain as Sam and $ZOE pass by.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did great out there! The best female Tybalt there ever was.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! I'm just glad that Spencer came out at the right time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Honestly, he never did get the entire putting the play out of order idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... But so far so good. Nothing's gone wro--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say it, $ZOE!
They walk past Andrew's hiding place and into the dressing room. Andrew walks out and nearly runs into Spencer stabbing his swords into imaginary objects...

nodes.title: Owen's Eleven
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen get close to Paige?

nodes.text: In the robotics room, the nerds (and Kimi) are huddled around a metallic mass of legs, joints, wires, and sensors.
Brendan, a senior nerd, holds up a beaker of sparkling apple cider. The rest follow suit, raising beakers of their own.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E. the robot is at long last ready to power on!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It must feel good. After all, you've been working on this project so much, it feels like we haven't seen you in forever!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Except in here, of course!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We're going to smoke the competition at Robo-Con over Spring Break! I can't wait to hoist the 1st place trophy over my head!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...I should probably start doing push ups.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's not get too cocky, fellas! After all, if you fly too close to the sun, you'll burn your hot dog buns!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Greek mythology sounds a lot weirder coming from you, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I'm just nervous... I feel like I'm t-t-tingling!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not your nerves! Your hand is brushing against an exposed wire!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Th-th-that explains everything!
Erik twitches involuntarily as he steps away from the wire.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I'll be in the nurse's office, boys! Let me know how it goes!
He wobbles out of the room! The nerds return their attention to the robot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What part of L.Y.L.E. did you work on, Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Special effects! Hey, you want to turn it on with me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure!
Kevin puts his hand on the switch, and Kimi puts her hand on top of his.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me be a part of--

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: We should `all` turn it on together!
nodes.text_bbcode: We should [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] turn it on together!

nodes.text: Soon, all the nerds have their hand on the switch.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Something special.
They flip the switch! The robot vibrates and hums and slowly begins to glow a bright green color.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, is it radioactive?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Nah. I added the color just 'cause it looks cool!
Suddenly, a monitor at the head of the robot swivels around!
You are now playing as L.Y.L.E...

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: I am L.Y.L.E. Reporting for duty.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sweet! It works!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's test the general knowledge feature first!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E... What animal has four legs and goes `'Moooooooooo'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: L.Y.L.E... What animal has four legs and goes [color=#e23b3b][i]'Moooooooooo'?![/i][/color]

nodes.prompt: What has four legs and goes 'Moo'?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What has four legs and goes 'Moo'?

nodes.text: Several hours later, at Monarch Prep...
Nestled in some bushes near the dorm building, Owen hunkers down, camouflaged all in black.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just gotta be patient, wait for Kimi's signal, and then climb the building to Paige's room!
In her car, idling outside the campus walls, $ZOE double-checks her phone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Alarm's set. Emily should be here in... Ten minutes.
At the school's edge, just above a gnarly patch of brambles, Emily laces her shoes up tight...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ready when you are, Kimi.
And climbing up the steps of Monarch Prep is Kimi, wearing a fashionable dress and a pair of pearl earrings.
At the top, she approaches Principal Whitford, noting the broom that lays against the front door.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just remember your name, remember your name, remember your name!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Abigail Weatherfrost! It's a pleasure to finally meet you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, that was easy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `wish` I could say it was a pleasure meeting you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]wish[/i][/color] I could say it was a pleasure meeting you!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me?! No one talks to me that way!
You are now playing as Paige.
Deep in the Butterfly Detention Center facility, Brock and Principal Whitford usher Paige down a long hallway.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back `willingly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back [color=#e23b3b][i]willingly.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brock looks down at her sadly.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: But. Girl. Run.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not like I have anywhere else to go...
They stop abruptly, pushing Paige in front of an imposing door.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, do you know where we are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In front of a door?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is our isolation room at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that you're in serious trouble. You've violated half a dozen school rules during your trip to the outside world.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And despite what your parents generously donate to our private paradise here, you won't be getting off unscathed. What do you say to that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I understand, Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What? No sarcastic remarks? No witty comments?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope you enjoyed that little taste of freedom because it's unlikely that you're going to see anything outside these gates in a long while.
Paige thinks of Owen holding $ZOE and pulling her close for that kiss... Paige balks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... `That's` something I never want to see again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] something I never want to see again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to be a problem from now on...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A likely story! What are you trying to pull?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Don't think that because you escaped once, you'll be able to escape a second time! This time around, I'll make sure that you don't make it past your dorm room door!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why not? Why should I trust you? What are you plotting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not plotting anything. It's just on the car ride back from Centerscore, I realized something...

options.label: There's nothing out there for me.

nodes.text: On the night of the Emerald Ball...
Principal Whitford escorts the well-dressed girls through the serpentine maze of corridors underneath the detention center...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This way, girls...
...And into a glittering room with high chandeliers. Sparkling juices bubble in crystal glasses, and canapes are served on silver platters.
All around the room, distinguished men and women from the school board as well as handsome young gentlemen mingle on the gilded floor.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome to the Butterfly Ballroom!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh, my goodness... `This` is what I've been missing this entire year!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, my goodness... [color=#3b78e2][i]This[/i][/color] is what I've been missing this entire year!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Food that's not gray! I'm so happy!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Do you `smell` that? That's `gold` in the air. We're surrounded by luxury!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]smell[/i][/color] that? That's [color=#3b78e2][i]gold[/i][/color] in the air. We're surrounded by luxury!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Surrounded by luxury? Who cares about that? I'm surrounded by `boys!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surrounded by luxury? Who cares about that? I'm surrounded by [color=#3b78e2][i]boys![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not for long...
Jessica frowns at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll see about that.
Whitford stops to address the girls.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Remember what I've said about `good behavior`, ladies. Now... On your way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember what I've said about [color=#3b78e2][i]good behavior[/i][/color], ladies. Now... On your way.

nodes.text: As the girls walk into the ballroom to mingle, Whitford puts a firm hand on Paige's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, I'd like to speak with you. Jessica tells me that you've had trouble adjusting since you... Returned to us. She seems quite concerned about you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is she? That's so `sweet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is she? That's so [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope her concerns are unfounded. I also hope isolation and being back this last week was enough to make you rethink your decisions.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal, honestly, you have nothing to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: How can I be so sure that you'll behave?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.title: The Debutante Dance, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen find Paige during Spring Break?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen...
It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called `'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called [b]'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.[/b]

nodes.text: With his other hand, he inspects and probes a tiny robot, laying lifeless on the table next to his lunch, which has long gone cold.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Come on! Please work this time!
He brings two wires together... Sparks shoot out every which way! The robot's eyes glow bright for a second, only to fade again.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You stupid thing!
Kimi and $ZOE arrive, with Emily wheeling Ben up behind them. They all sit down around Owen.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Robo-surgery doesn't look like it's going well.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, and in twenty minutes, I've gotta prove to the nerds that I'm competent enough to join the Robotics Club!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hope you do! Otherwise you'll never find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Man, I missed `one` awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, I missed [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's so simple, Ben! Owen just has to get good at robotics so he can join the Robotics Club so he can get into a hotel for Spring Break so he can find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `So` simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. When we snuck Owen into Monarch Prep, he found out that Paige is going to be at a Debutante Dance in a hotel near Centerscore Beach this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right, I remember someone unimportant telling me about that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And `someone's` going to break his other leg if he's not careful...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]someone's[/i][/color] going to break his other leg if he's not careful...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Anyway, I tried to get a hotel room, but every hotel is booked! Turns out there are a million different events going on this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Including `Robo-Con!` Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!
nodes.text_bbcode: Including [color=#e23b3b][i]Robo-Con![/i][/color] Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!

nodes.text: Ben does a little dance in his wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, `The Computition,` we get to stay at the hotel for `free!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, [color=#3b78e2][i]The Computition,[/i][/color] we get to stay at the hotel for [color=#3b78e2][i]free![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We do? Sweet! Free is my favorite price!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As soon as I heard that the Robotics Club has a hotel room, I asked Kimi if she could get me in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand... I'm caught up! How's studying going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of `some` use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?

nodes.text: Owen gestures sadly toward his robot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Turns out, pretty hard. This one-second lightbulb isn't going to cut it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! It's kind of cute to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The thing is... I've never wanted anything more than I do now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to talk to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To tell her that my kiss with $ZOE during the play was... Was exactly what it was, a stage-kiss and nothing more.
$ZOE nods her head, agreeing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to tell Paige how I really feel.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, man, Robotics 101... `Don't give up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man, Robotics 101... [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't give up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No offense, but I could use advice that's a little more...

nodes.prompt: I could use advice that's a little more...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I could use advice that's a little more...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
In the `Roundabout Hotel` ballroom...
nodes.text_bbcode: In the [b]Roundabout Hotel[/b] ballroom...

nodes.text: Paige is standing in a circle of girls that has formed around Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I've brought you all here to the Debutante Ball because you are the very best, the cream of the crop.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's a given.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What I expect of you is tip-top behavior. Represent Monarch Prep well today, and you may never have to use a paper napkin ever again.
The girls' ears perk up.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Everything I've taught you has all been in preparation for today.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The gentlemen you'll be meeting in just a few moments are, like you, unparalleled in manners and decorum.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And they are `all` wealthy. It's not uncommon for girls at this event to be offered extravagant gifts!
nodes.text_bbcode: And they are [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] wealthy. It's not uncommon for girls at this event to be offered extravagant gifts!

nodes.text: The girls chatter excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What kind of gifts?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Trips to exotic lands, priceless jewelry, luxury cars. I've seen it all.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In short, the Emerald Ball was training, but now you're in the big leagues.
Madisenn whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: This is kind of disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Really? You don't see it? Guys just giving us stuff even though they hardly know who we are?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wake up, Madisenn. That's life!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: No, it isn't. I mean, what about love?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft! Love? Love is just...
In the ballroom of the Debutante Dance, Owen, disguised as a waiter, has just been discovered by Paige!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Owen?! What do you think you're doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just trying to make an honest living. Which reminds me, you still haven't tipped me yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here's a tip... Go jump in the ocean. You'll fit right in with all the other slimy creatures.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Harsh. Even for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Deal with it. I'm `not` a Mary Sue, not like some people.
nodes.text_bbcode: Deal with it. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a Mary Sue, not like some people.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause that even remotely crossed my mind.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, a moment ago, when I was `playing hotel hopscotch,` I actually thought you might be happy to see me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, a moment ago, when I was [color=#e23b3b][i]playing hotel hopscotch,[/i][/color] I actually thought you might be happy to see me.

nodes.text: Paige glares at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I actually thought that you cared about me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? `I do!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]I do![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige

args.text: They walk down the hallway to Ms. Lee's office...
And $ZOE almost runs into Owen on his way out!
Hi, Owen. Is everything all right? You didn't drop out of fifth period science, did you?
No... We're still lab partners if you were worried...
I just wanted some answers. About Paige.
Was Ms. Lee helpful? She has a tendency to be... Uh...
She must have been in a good mood. She was surprisingly helpful.
Almost `too` helpful actually. I don't think she's supposed to show me another student's file, but she seemed really distracted by a phone conversation with her, uh... Drooly Love Muffin?
In a way, it just confirms what I already knew. Paige is gone. It's official. She's at Monarch Prep... Permanently.
As long as she's there, and I'm on Whitford's 'Bad Boy' list, then I won't be seeing her anytime soon.
If her parents wanted to keep us apart, they chose the right place.
At least there are holidays. She has to come home for those! And you'll see her then.
I'm not sure about that. Her mother has a tendency to ship her off to exotic places...
I guess I'll figure it out.
If you need any help, let me know.
Owen nods, but his mouth is set in a grim line.
I'll see you around, $ZOE. Bye, Sam.
Sam waves until Owen turns a corner. Then she puts a hand on $ZOE's shoulder.
I'm sorry... You're going to what? Are you seriously trying to get Paige back into his life?
Then helping him find Paige isn't a good idea. You should be...
Throwing yourself at him!|Spending time away from him!
$ZOE... You like him. And he likes Paige. It's going to `kill` you to keep on hanging out with him if he's hung up on her.
Come on, don't you think it's a little silly to be following him around, helping him find Paige?
No! It's not silly to, uh... To help him. And it's definitely not silly to drive him to Monarch Prep to go see her...
I see what you're getting at... I'm putting myself in the danger zone, I know...
And you don't hang out in the danger zone because it's `dangerous.`
But I can't turn my back on him either, Sam. I failed Autumn... I'm not failing him.
Feelings aside, all I want right now is to be his friend.
Paige is finally out of the picture. There's no one else here to confuse him.
Now go put on your best sequined bikini and jump out at him from inside a cake!
Uh... What? Why? Who would `do` that?
Um... No one. Definitely not something I ever did for Colt...
The point is... This is your opportunity!
Don't be ridiculous... I can't tell him how I feel.
Because Owen `really` likes Paige. And he and I aren't as close as we used to be.
Whatever I'm feeling for him now... I'm keeping to myself.
Being coy and not sharing your feelings never works.
Isn't that how you and Nick got back together? By forcefully denying your feelings for him?
No! That's not the same. Nick tricked me.
He `tricked` you? Into admitting your feelings.
Yeah, with his pretty words and his effeminate glasses. I still can't believe the skinny jeans thing works for me.
But what am I saying? This is your chance!
No, it's not. Right now, I just want to be his friend. And I want to help.
And besides, we shouldn't even be talking about me right now... It's about you! So let's go talk to Ms. Lee!
Before Sam can protest, $ZOE knocks on Ms. Lee's door and heads inside.
$ZOE and Sam walk into the office where Ms. Lee sits behind her desk, talking on her cell phone.
Ms. Lee holds up one finger and smiles into her phone.
I really `have` to go, Bruno. You be good now!
She ends her call, clears her throat, and turns to Sam and $ZOE.
Chloe! Jan! What are you doing here?
Oh, who cares about something so silly as names? Come in, sit down!
$ZOE and Sam take seats in her visitor's chairs.
I'm also doing very well, thank you for asking!
My mother told me that this day would `never` come. She used to say, 'Louisa, your life will never be fulfilling unless you become a wife and mother'...
But I skipped a step and adopted!
No! Are you crazy? Babies are just loud, crying factories! I can't stand crying.
That's why I adopted a dog! He's the love of my life.
Is that who you were talking to on the phone?
Yes. Isn't he precious? Of course, he can't really pick up the phone. He's a `dog!`
But I know listening to my voice on the answering machine calms his little dog heart down.
Uh, Ms. Lee, we're here to ask you a couple questions. Sam's applying for college--
College? At your age? Aren't you a bit... Over the hill?
How old do you think I am exactly?
Never you mind. There's all sorts at college. Or so I've been told.
Sam mouths 'What does that mean?' to $ZOE. $ZOE shrugs while Ms. Lee taps keys on the computer at her desk and pulls up Sam's file.
Ah, yes... Sam, you're the captain of the swim team and a mediocre student with no other accolades to her name...
We're `here` to ask about `scholarships` to help Sam out during the application process.
Oh, we have plenty of those!
Ms. Lee types into her computer until she finds the scholarship listings.
Let's see here... Luckily, there are thousands of academic scholarships that Sam can apply for, and a few for our more `remedial` students that she might even stand a chance at getting...
Sadly, all of the deadlines have already passed.
But luckily, there are several student-specific scholarships left.
It means only special students can qualify for them, and it's usually due to a specific quality. For instance, Amanda Applebee qualified for Redheads Against Books.
And Hector got a special scholarship for promising to exclusively use Punk Moose Mousse in his hair for the rest of his college career.
No! These are very serious scholarships. For instance, the Walrus Face Scholarship is very prestigious and hard to win, but they offer a generous amount.
For those whose faces look like a walrus's.
There's Stamp Fancy's Stamp Scholarship... You don't happen to have an obsession with stamps precipitated by a traumatic event in your childhood, do you?
Oh well. There's the Pi Scholarship... That's for people whose GPA is exactly a 3.14...
Didn't you just say that one?
No. The second one is for people who love to eat pie.
How many pie-eating competitions have you won?
Then you don't really like pie all that much... Do you?
Instead of reading through every listing, can we search by my traits or something?
Excellent! I'm glad you thought of it. It's like a game! Why don't you give me a set of unique traits that you have, and I'll see what I can find?
Oh yeah... That's a `good` quality in a woman these days...
I don't know if that's your `best` quality...
Hey, there's a scholarship for a `walrus face.`
Or... At least that's what everyone mistakes my anger for...
Hmmm... Interesting qualities. They sound... Familiar, like something I've read before...
She pulls up a page on her computer.
Ah, yes, the Shakespearean Society has a scholarship for `actors...`
I've never acted... But I can try.
There are some requirements, of course.
You have to be willing to study performing arts in the college of your choosing...
If it'll get me to college, I can do that.
Second, to qualify, you must write an essay about a performance you've done.
A little harder, but I'm sure I can do something by the end of the year.
And lastly, they're only offering it to actors or actresses who have performed in a production of `Romeo and Juliet.`
It's going to be hard to find a school or community center doing that play. I can't do that...

The drama club. They're performing Romeo and Juliet. And their tryouts are tomorrow!
No, Sam... Sometimes things just work out! Come on! We've got to get you ready for tryouts!
No need to be snippy. I'll find something. Even if Sam isn't `strictly` qualified for it...
Her long nails clatter on the keyboard as she searches...
There is something. The Shakespearean Society has a scholarship for `actors...`
Great news! I have `nothing` for you!
You won't have to go through the trouble of applying for college if you can't pay for it.
Sam is none of those qualities. She's smart, and creative, and intelligent... Is there anything for `that?`
Some good, some bad... Let's see if we can find something...

You know, like 'crazy' in a good way.

It's good of you to admit that. I didn't want to say anything, but I `had` noticed.

It's dinnertime in the 'Butterfly Detention Center' of Monarch Prep...
Paige sits unhappily and alone at a table with a white-linen tablecloth on it, buttering a fresh French baguette with a dull knife.
She briefly contemplates pocketing the butter knife in case it will help her later, when her friend Prissy slides into the padded chair next to her.
You look like you bit into 14 carat gold. What's wrong with you?
What do you think? My `mother` just `had` to ship me off here!
What's wrong with Monarch Prep? Don't tell me you got used to roughing it up with the commoners at that school...
They put me in the `lockdown` wing of Monarch Prep...
I can't leave the grounds, and I can't talk to anyone outside the school...
Paige thinks of how she never said good bye to Owen... And pushes it out of her head.
Let's just say I miss having my own phone...
Paige turns to Prissy with renewed interest.
Prissy continues to speak casually while lifting a water goblet to her lips.
Let's just say the `Queen Bee` wants you to have something.
I don't know if I want what she has to offer.
I think you dropped your napkin.
Paige reaches under the table under the pretense of picking her white linen napkin off the floor.
Under the table, Prissy passes her a small rectangular object that Paige slips into her pocket.
She'll let you know. In good time.
Prissy dabs at her mouth and leaves the table.
A few minutes later, Paige gets up and heads to her room...
Paige takes the contraband cell phone out of her pocket.
She turns it on, dials Owen's number, and hears a mechanical voice on the line...
...We're sorry. This account has insufficient funds to make an outgoing call. Please refill your account and try again...
You've got to be kidding me! I finally get a phone, and I don't have enough money to call Owen?!
She hurls the phone across the room and throws herself onto her bed.
How am I going to contact Owen now?
Will Paige ever contact Owen to tell him what's going on? Find out soon!

After the cast sheet is turned in, everyone streams out of the theater and heads home...
Everyone, that is, except for Kimi.
Kimi sits on the stage, swinging her legs as she looks out over the empty auditorium.
`O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...`
Great. `Now` I remember the stupid line...
She's just about to hop off when she hears the sound of squeaky sneakers behind her.
Hey, Kimi, what are you doing up here?
Oh, you know... I can never get enough of sitting in dark, lonely auditoriums by myself.
I'm sitting here because I figure this is the closest I'll ever get to being front and center onstage.
Might as well live it up.
Kevin sits down next to her, dangling his legs over the lip of the stage.
This seems pretty sweet to me.
Yeah well, it's probably sweeter if you're acting onstage instead.
Are you upset because you were passed over for Juliet?
Pretty much as obvious as a moose in a bikini.
It just seemed like it'd be a fun thing to do. It's an honor to get cast in something.
Not that anyone would come to see me after what happened right before Homecoming...
Turns out, when you put a bunch of guys' names in a spreadsheet and rate their personality, no one wants to be your friend.
But it was kind of nice to dream about.
Well, I'm sorry to hear that you didn't make the cut.
But you are the Nurse, aren't you?
And we all know that nurses are hotter than noble ladies...
Ha ha... If you say so...
And far away, in Monarch Prep's detention center...
Paige tries to put in another call on the contraband cell phone she acquired from another inmate...
For one brief second, Paige hears a click and thinks someone might have picked up...
But a disappointing automated voice chirps back at her instead.
I finally have a frikkin' cell phone, and it doesn't call out?!
She thinks of the girl that gave it to her and grinds her teeth.
That... That witch! No one does this to me!
She sits on her bed, cradling her head in her hands.
Or at least they never would have before...
Just which 'witch' is Paige talking about? And what happened to Paige since Valentine's Day? Find out soon in Surviving High School!

After a long, harrowing journey, Paige arrives on the doorstep of Owen's grandma's house.
Well, I'm barefoot, covered in scratches, caked in mud, and my dress has been torn to shreds...
I'll probably fit right in here!
She knocks on the front door.
Come on! Be home! Please be home!
Paige, dear! You look like something the cat threw up!
Where are my manners? Come in, and we'll get you warm! What would you like to eat?
Owen's grandmother shuffles her way down the hall...
I think I might have a dress that fits you!
Grandma Betty! I'm here to see Owen! Is he here?
Owen's grandmother shuffles her way back.
Oh darling, he's not here. He's in the play tonight, didn't you know?
I've been a little... Out of the loop...
I was on my way there myself, but the doctor... `Cough...` The doctor said I shouldn't overexert myself, and now I don't know...
If... If you're going there later, could you tell him that I tried my best to make it?
Owen is such a good kid, so handsome and kind, and the last thing any lady would ever want to do is not be there for him...
What'd you say? I couldn't quite hear you, dear!
Never mind. Just... Sure, I'll tell him...
Paige steps out of Grandma Betty's house, she takes a deep breath, and runs as fast as she can toward Twin Branches...

Earlier, at the end of Sam's production...
Paige opens the doors to the theater, looks onstage, and sees Owen embracing $ZOE on a balcony.
`Good night, good night! Parting is such sweet sorrow...`
`That I shall say good night till it be morrow...`
Paige watches $ZOE with her perfect hair and her perfect makeup and her `perfect` dress stand on her toes...
Owen pulls $ZOE into a tender, loving, and powerful kiss, his hands coming up to sweetly cup $ZOE's face.
This might be a play, but...
But that is `not` how you fake kiss a girl!
Owen and $ZOE continue to kiss with such a fierce passion that Paige can feel something crumbling inside her.
All at once, the energy rush she'd gotten from escaping from Monarch Prep, the hope she'd held running all the way here... Dissolves into nothing.
She hunches over as if punched.
He... He kissed her... Like... Like he kissed me! It's like I never existed!
And just as suddenly, the sadness ebbs, replaced with anger!
Well, it sure didn't take him `long` to `forget!`
Enraged, Paige turns on her heel and storms out of the auditorium, oblivious to the audience members rising up around her to applaud the end of the play.
The roar in her ears is not the sound of people clapping in response to the play.
And isn't it just `convenient` that $ZOE and Owen are cast as the romantic leads?! Ugh!
Paige strides out of the lobby, fuming!
Only a couple months, and he has the `nerve` to move on!
After everything he said to me on Valentine's Day...
After everything I've gone through for him!
She pushes open the auditorium doors, her feet thumping.	As she heads out of the school's parking lot, Paige shakes her fist at the night sky.
Paige has no sooner stepped onto the street when a bright set of headlights shines on her, blinding her and making her stumble back.
When her eyes adjust, she finds a familiar face in front of her.
Paige backs up, but bumps into Brock! There's a sad look on Brock's face as he puts one large hand on her shoulder.
That's right, Brock. There's no use running, Paige. We tracked you here. We can do it again.
What will happen with Paige now? Will Owen ever get to clear things up with her? Find out soon in Surviving High School!

Once again, the nerds (and Kimi) are huddled in the robotics room over L.Y.L.E.
Is anybody nervous about the missing piece?! Last time, it went berserk `with` the missing piece!
So? Maybe that's the piece that caused it to go berserk!
Or maybe it's the piece that kept it from annihilating the entire school!
Should we be wearing protective suits or something?
Well, let's turn it on and find out!
Kevin reaches his hand out for the switch, but both Dex and Brendan are there to stop him!
As they wrestle with each other, Ben slowly wheels himself into the room.
The nerds freeze in their fighting positions, Kevin's elbow lodged in between Brendan's teeth.
Are you biting my elbow? Or am I elbowing your teeth?
I'm so embarrassed to be here!
Ben flips the missing piece he found in the hallway at the nerds. They clumsily fumble it.
Sorry. Forgot that you're not athletes.
What brings you around these parts, Benjamin?
I was thinking about re-joining Robotics Club...
Of course you can join! I mean, you pretty much founded this club! If Science Club never existed, we never would have had Robotics Club!
Welcome back! Any thoughts on how we can fix L.Y.L.E.?
You know, I overheard you talking and this piece shouldn't have any bearing on the robot's behavior.
Just because Ben says something about robots doesn't make it true!
The other nerds stare at Dex for a moment.
Okay, it sounded stupid coming out of my mouth!
Maybe there's something simple with L.Y.L.E.'s programming that's just being overlooked.
As Ben gets to work on fixing L.Y.L.E., he looks over toward the open doorway at Emily standing there.
He winks at her, and she smiles.

A few days after Paige has been cleared to go to Centerscore Beach...
The girls of Monarch Prep gather in Paige's room. Paige reclines on her bed, drinking a smoothie the color of a Brazilian sunset.
Ah, this is the life I've been missing... It's nice to be back at the top.
We're glad to have you back. I can't believe that things have changed so much around here with you as Perfect.
Yeah... Well, it's amazing what you can get away with when your parents are willing to pad your bank account again...
And also when you're willing to generously donate to Whitford's personal funds...
I'm surprised Jessica didn't do it actually. It's like she enjoyed being in a police school.
Speaking of... How did you do it? How did you set her up like that?
Please, Prissy. It was pretty obvious she was giving me that phone to get me in trouble.
There's no reason for her to give it to me otherwise. Especially after she already knew I wasn't going to stay good under her thumb.
And since I was pretty confident she'd do something the night of the ball, I turned the tables on her.
The night before the Emerald Ball...
Paige opens her window and jumps onto the gutter pipe running along the roof of the facility.
And to think, if I'd never tried to escape for `him`, I wouldn't have known which window was Jessica's...
She shimmies along the pipe until she hovers outside Jessica's window. She rams her shoulder into the pane, forcing the shoddily crafted window open.
Inside, she drops into the room, takes the phone from her pocket, and opens the desk drawer. Before putting the phone inside, she admires her handiwork.
An incriminating phone with texts from Ryan. It's a good thing I know his stupid number from his trying to give it to me so many times...
She moves to drop the phone inside the desk when she sees a bottle of glittery nail polish. She nearly laughs with delight.
This is just getting more and more perfect! It's just one more nail in her coffin...
Opening the polish, she paints the initials 'J.B.' on the back of the phone. Waving it around a few times to set it, she shoves the phone in the desk, hops out the window, and closes it behind her.
Good bye, Jessica... Out with the old, and in with the new...
Back in the present, Paige laughs.
Whoa. Remind me not to cross you.
But on to more important matters...
Whitford's letting me bring `one` lucky lady to go to the Debutante Ball at Centerscore Beach...
Come on, Caroline. The second girl is `me.`
So which one of us are you taking?
Because I've been wanting the chance to tan on a beach in, like, forever!
Who said anything about you guys?
Who I take all depends entirely on what you can promise me.
I'm not talking contraband items. We can deal in those later. I'm talking super serious favors.
I have these tickets to a exclusive fashion show!
Ugh, Caroline. Fashion shows are so last year.
And I only take tickets to `super` exclusive events. Next!
I have super-exclusive backstage tickets to a red-carpet event...
I don't want to have a good dress `or` a date for that.
My mom is sending me some real soft-skinned leather products...
My father offered us the use of his boathouse during the summer...
Boathouse? Why should I be impressed by a dinky little boathouse?
It's on my dad's private resort island.
Sounds like Paige is having a lot of fun! And that's your bonus scene!
What will happen when Paige goes to the Debutante Ball? Find out soon on Surviving High School!
