The intelligence portion of the competition has just wrapped up, and the nerds are happy with the results!
I'm just happy he didn't say 'Michigan cow butt'!
Ben, how are the battle configurations?
They should be ready to go soon!
Kimi approaches Kevin and pulls him aside...
Did you hear? We just might win this thing!
I'm really happy for you! Do you... Maybe want to celebrate?
Sure! What'd you have in mind?
I was thinking maybe we could go to this fancy restaurant that overlooks the ocean.
Really? That's very generous of you!
Don't worry about it. I hear the food is good, and the ambience is romant--
I'm not sure. Why? Are you allergic to seafood?
No, I love seafood, but Dex has some pretty bad allergies.
Hey, guys, Kimi's offered to take all of us to a fancy restaurant to celebrate tomorrow night!
Uh, listen we need to talk about--
Suddenly L.Y.L.E. starts spinning out of control!
Don't look at me! Even though I'm the expert!
Where's Owen? He's supposed to be supervising us!
He, uh, might not be here for a while, guys!
We need to move L.Y.L.E.! Where's Owen?
He, uh, might not be here for a while, guys!
L.Y.L.E. starts spinning around even faster!
How are we supposed to move our super huge robot, when Owen, our super huge robot-lifter, isn't here?!
We need to make a robot to lift this robot!
I'm back! Whoo! Too much running for one day!
I did! Long story short! He used the club so he could find the girl he loves!
He feels bad about it, but he's still out there, trying to woo her... Ensnared by love's downy-soft net.
That's okay! We don't need him!
L.Y.L.E. begins to rattle along the convention center floor.
I'll try to reach the off switch!
No, I'll go for it! You try to pull out the wires connected to its motor!
Guys, we held a vote, remember! I'm the one who powers L.Y.L.E. off and on!
As the nerds bicker, L.Y.L.E. moves farther and farther away from them!
The nerds turn back to see L.Y.L.E. whip around a corner!
It is so hot. Or is it me? I think it is me. Sorry.
We need you, Owen! Get back here!

And the third-place winner in the `Computition...`
The Twin Branches Robotics Club for their robot, L.Y.L.E.!
It's not first, but I'll take it!
Some are born great, some do great things, and others have greatness thrust upon them!
Well, greatness, keep on thrusting my way!
Brendan holds up their trophy... And hands it to Ben.
What? I didn't really do much. I mean, L.Y.L.E. got kinda crushed in the battle competition.
True, true. But he also landed some sweet blows that Shock'N'Saw never, uh, `saw` coming.
Besides... There wouldn't even be a Robotics Club if it weren't for you.
Ben takes the trophy, his voice cracking.
Thanks. Ahem, I mean, thanks. L.Y.L.E. deserves some credit too. Don't you, L.Y.L.E.?
Trying not to cry. Is someone cutting onions?
As the rest of the nerds celebrate, Emily crouches down next to Ben.
Really nice. You know, when I get out of this wheelchair, I think I might make a few changes.
I don't know yet. All I `do` know is that I don't want to be just a nerd or just a basketball player...
Hey, I'll support you with whatever you do. As long as you don't get a makeover...
Heh. Pretty sure I'm all done with those.
Emily gives Ben a big kiss. While the nerds celebrate, Kevin pulls Kimi aside.
Hey, Kimi, can I talk to you for a second?
I know that you've been trying to spend more time with me lately...
Kimi can feel her heart quicken.
Of course. I'd have to be completely blind not to notice.
So, I was thinking we could go grab some dessert together to celebrate!
Yeah, why are you so skeptical? It's not like we don't consider you a part of the club.
The guys all think you're cool.
Kevin calls out to the other nerds.
Hey, guys! Kimi's down for dessert!
Of course. This is my life now.
As everyone gathers in the parking lot...
Oh, she texted me. She said to go on ahead. I think she's off on the beach getting some alone time...
The nerds pile into Kevin's van and drive off!
And on the beach, $ZOE is walking along the shore by herself...
Nearby, college kids play beach volleyball by the light of the moon.
Up ahead, nerds from Robo-Con debate the most efficient way to make a s'more.
I'm going to be graduating soon...
It's kind of exciting and scary all at once...
I guess the real question is, 'What college should I--
She nearly trips over a guy lying down on a beach towel!
Howard?! Ohmygosh! What are you doing here?
I'm back for Spring Break! I... I--
Howard breaks into laughter! Soon, $ZOE joins him.
I can't believe this is happening! What are the odds?!
Hee hee! I don't know, but I'm... I'm happy to see you!
Howard scoots over and makes room on his towel for $ZOE to sit.
And then, Autumn tells me that she's going to this awesome art school!
What? Crazy! What are you going to do about Lindsay?
I don't know... I'm almost more worried about owing Wes favors.
Do you want me to beat him up? Because... It `sounds` like you want me to beat him up for you.
So then I'm running as hard as I can, trying to avoid this giant chicken mascot, and Manny says to me...
'There's got to be an easier way to avoid the Freshman 15 than this!'
For the thousandth time, I'm not in college yet!
Heh. I keep forgetting how I'm older, wiser, and infinitely cooler than you!
So then, Owen and I had to fill in as Romeo and Juliet!
Yeah, but I just thought about... Er, I just tried not to think about it.
You helped Sam win that scholarship. That's what's important.
As the night gets late, Howard smiles at her.
So are you thinking about applying to Kingston?
Are you kidding? College is pretty much the reason I tripped over you. It's `all` I'm thinking about now!
I didn't mean college in general... I meant specifically Kingston.
Oh... Yeah, I'm going to apply.
It would be... Well, I'll just say I'd be really happy.
The two of them stay like that, talking, content, well into the night.

Brock pats her down, and the flower goes undetected.
She flops down on the bed and takes out the flower Owen gave her. She brings it to her nose, smelling it.
Score Up!

For one second, she's transported back to the flower shop that afternoon...
Owen hands Paige the flowers.

nodes.text: Here you go. Sometimes all you have to do is ask.

nodes.text: Thank you... They're even more beautiful now that I own them.

nodes.text: Take her back to her room. In the morning, we'll figure out a way to teach this nasty thief not to take what isn't hers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, my beautiful Owie-Glowie, there you are! Here's a million cupcakes I baked to celebrate our anniversary!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Each one has a unique frosting image of a memory of us together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This one is us at the state football game together!

nodes.text: And this one is us waving goodbye to Paige when she got stuck in the Butterfly Detention Center!

nodes.text: I can't believe she actually thought you liked her!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I thought I did...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you showed me how wrong I was!
$ZOE turns to Paige, who is now looking into the window, and winks at her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Deal with it!

He leans in closer to her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Noooooooooooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Noooooooooooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She pounds on the glass, but try as she might, she can't stop them from kissing!
She wakes up in a cold sweat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's... That's it, then. I'm stuck here. $ZOE won.
As Paige huddles under her blanket, trying to go back to sleep, she knows...

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock.
Principal Whitford calls from the top of the hill.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Brock?! Where'd you go?! Have you found her yet?!
